+# Nightly learning extraction
+
+This batch runner selects recent Claude session JSONL files, skips processed
+sessions unless forced, extracts learning records, writes them to the database
+when enabled, then marks the session processed.
+
+**Code owners:** processed-state handling in
+[`already_processed`](../../claude/scripts/nightly-learning-extractor.py#L79),
+[`mark_processed`](../../claude/scripts/nightly-learning-extractor.py#L89),
+and processing loop in [`main`](../../claude/scripts/nightly-learning-extractor.py#L245).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> SelectSessions
+    SelectSessions --> Done: no recent sessions
+    SelectSessions --> Connect: sessions found and not dry-run
+    SelectSessions --> Process: dry-run or DB connection ready
+    Connect --> Failed: database unavailable
+    Connect --> Process: database connection established
+    Process --> SkipProcessed: already processed and force is false
+    Process --> MarkShort: transcript shorter than 200 characters
+    Process --> Extract: transcript long enough
+    Extract --> MarkNoOutput: Claude returns no output
+    Extract --> Store: parse learning records
+    Store --> MarkProcessed: insert records or dry-run
+    MarkShort --> Process: another session remains
+    MarkNoOutput --> Process: another session remains
+    MarkProcessed --> Process: another session remains
+    SkipProcessed --> Process: another session remains
+    Process --> Done: no sessions remain
+    Done --> [*]
+    Failed --> [*]
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| SelectSessions | Run starts | No session mtime is within lookback | Exit without opening the database. |
+| Connect | Sessions found | Not dry-run | Open the DB; connection/import failure exits before processing. |
+| Process | Session selected | Already processed and `--force` absent | Skip it. |
+| Process | Transcript extracted | Fewer than 200 characters | Mark processed without calling Claude. |
+| Extract | Claude call | Empty output or call failure | Mark processed and continue. |
+| Extract | Valid output parsed | DB enabled | Insert each learning with conflict-ignore behavior, commit, then mark processed. |
+| Extract | Valid output parsed | Dry-run | Do not write DB; mark processed after this run. |
+| Any session | Processing completes | More sessions remain | Continue until `--max-sessions` reached. |
+
+Empty model output and short transcripts are treated as processed. `--force`
+reprocesses session names, but deduplication in the database still uses
+`ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`.

+# Nightly Claude session sync
+
+This scheduled script turns recent Claude transcripts into Obsidian session
+notes, then snapshots Conductor worktrees and syncs their rules. The note file
+is the next-run signal: a real summary is skipped, while a placeholder is
+eligible for another summary attempt.
+
+**Code owner:** main session loop in
+[`nightly-session-sync.sh`](../../claude/scripts/nightly-session-sync.sh#L121),
+with summary generation beginning at [line 83](../../claude/scripts/nightly-session-sync.sh#L83).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> ValidateKey
+    ValidateKey --> Enumerate: API key present
+    ValidateKey --> Failed: API key absent
+    Enumerate --> Candidate: recent transcript found
+    Enumerate --> Snapshot: no candidates remain
+    Candidate --> Skip: subagent, too few messages, or existing real summary
+    Candidate --> Summarize: eligible transcript
+    Summarize --> WriteNote: summary succeeds
+    Summarize --> WritePlaceholder: summary fails or conversation is empty
+    WriteNote --> Candidate: next transcript
+    WritePlaceholder --> Candidate: next transcript
+    Skip --> Candidate: next transcript
+    Snapshot --> SyncRules: snapshot phase completes
+    SyncRules --> Done: rule sync attempted
+    Done --> [*]
+    Failed --> [*]
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| ValidateKey | Script starts | API key absent | Log error and exit 1. |
+| Enumerate | Recent JSONL files found | File is under subagent path | Skip. |
+| Candidate | Message count computed | Fewer than five user/assistant messages | Skip. |
+| Candidate | Target note inspected | A real summary already exists | Skip. |
+| Summarize | Transcript extracted | API returns summary | Write session note and increment success counts. |
+| Summarize | API fails or transcript is empty | No summary text | Write placeholder note; because it is not a real summary, a later run retries. |
+| Snapshot | Session loop finishes | Candidate set exhausted | Invoke Conductor snapshot hook for each matching worktree; ignore per-worktree errors. |
+| SyncRules | Snapshot phase ends | Always | Invoke external sync script; ignore its failure and finish. |
+
+The script has no separate durable run record. Session notes are the only
+per-session idempotency guard.

+# Post-build panel reminder gate
+
+The active Bash PostToolUse hook emits a reminder only for a successful,
+non-trivial, non-documentation commit that has not opted out in its commit
+message. It does not schedule or run a panel itself.
+
+**Code owners:** registration in
+[`claude/settings.json`](../../claude/settings.json#L193) and
+[`post-build-panel-trigger.sh`](../../claude/hooks/post-build-panel-trigger.sh#L12).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> InspectEvent
+    InspectEvent --> Ignore: command is not git commit or command failed
+    InspectEvent --> Ignore: previous commit unavailable or diff empty
+    InspectEvent --> Ignore: fewer than two files and fewer than twenty insertions
+    InspectEvent --> Ignore: docs/config-only changes
+    InspectEvent --> Ignore: commit message opts out
+    InspectEvent --> Reminder: successful qualifying commit
+    Ignore --> [*]: continue without reminder
+    Reminder --> [*]: emit /post-build-panel reminder
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| InspectEvent | Bash result arrives | Command is not `git commit` or exit code is nonzero | Return continue without reminder. |
+| InspectEvent | Commit diff read | No parent commit or empty file list | Return continue without reminder. |
+| InspectEvent | Diff measured | Fewer than two files and fewer than twenty insertions | Treat as trivial and skip. |
+| InspectEvent | Paths classified | Every change is documentation/config-only | Skip. |
+| InspectEvent | Commit message read | Contains skip-panel, skip-audit, wip, or no-review | Skip. |
+| InspectEvent | All guards pass | Successful non-trivial change includes non-documentation path | Emit reminder to run `/post-build-panel`. |
+
+This is a stateless one-event gate; it does not store panel completion status.

+# Claude PostToolUse tracking
+
+The active shell hook appends build/test outcomes to a branch-keyed JSONL log
+and records edited source files, affected repos, and candidate build/typecheck
+commands in a per-session cache.
+
+**Code owners:** active `PostToolUse` registration in
+[`claude/settings.json`](../../claude/settings.json#L183),
+[`post-tool-use-tracker.sh`](../../claude/hooks/post-tool-use-tracker.sh#L11),
+and build outcome append at [line 74](../../claude/hooks/post-tool-use-tracker.sh#L74).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> ReadToolEvent
+    ReadToolEvent --> BuildAttempt: Bash event matches build/test command
+    ReadToolEvent --> EditRecord: Edit/Write/MultiEdit with source path
+    ReadToolEvent --> Ignore: unsupported tool, missing path, or markdown edit
+    BuildAttempt --> AttemptLogged: known pass or fail
+    BuildAttempt --> Ignore: exit status remains unknown
+    EditRecord --> EditLogged: append file history and update unique repo/command cache
+    AttemptLogged --> [*]
+    EditLogged --> [*]
+    Ignore --> [*]
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| ReadToolEvent | PostToolUse arrives | Tool is Bash and command matches build/test patterns | Resolve exit code from hook fields, then transcript fallback if unknown. |
+| BuildAttempt | Exit resolved | Code is zero or known nonzero | Append `build_pass` or `build_fail` JSONL row under current branch. |
+| BuildAttempt | Exit unresolved | `unknown`/`null` after fallback | Do not append an attempt. |
+| ReadToolEvent | Edit/Write/MultiEdit arrives | Non-Markdown file maps to a known repo | Append edit line; append unique repo and build/typecheck commands to cache. |
+| ReadToolEvent | Other tool or unsupported edit | Guard fails | Exit without state update. |
+
+The Python tracker file is an unregistered duplicate in the current settings;
+the active owner is the shell hook.
+
+The [per-session cache](../../claude/hooks/post-tool-use-tracker.sh#L119)
+lives at `${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/claude-tsc-cache/${session_id:-default}`, rather
+than in the project's `.claude/tsc-cache` directory. The PreCompact summary
+reader uses the same temporary cache location.

+# Poteto decision gates
+
+Gates are persisted as open or resolved records. Parking an existing ID
+replaces it with an open record, including when the old record was resolved.
+
+**Code owner:** gate methods in
+[`openStore`](../../runtime/codex/skills/poteto-mode/scripts/orch/store.ts#L1501);
+CLI commands in [`orch.ts`](../../runtime/codex/skills/poteto-mode/scripts/orch/orch.ts#L434).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> Absent
+    Absent --> Open: gate park / save question, choices, default
+    Open --> Open: gate park same ID / replace record
+    Resolved --> Open: gate park same ID / reopen with new question
+    Open --> Resolved: gate resolve existing ID / save answer
+    Resolved --> Resolved: gate resolve existing ID / replace answer
+    Open --> Error: resolve unknown ID
+    Resolved --> Error: resolve unknown ID
+    Error --> [*]
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| Absent | `gate park` | Required ID, question, options, and default are present | Create open gate. |
+| Open or Resolved | `gate park` | Same ID exists | Replace the record with a fresh open gate; prior answer is removed. |
+| Open or Resolved | `gate resolve` | ID exists | Store supplied answer and mark resolved. |
+| Any state | `gate resolve` | ID does not exist | Raise not-found error. |
+
+`gate list` returns only open rows. The code does not require a gate to be
+open before resolving it.

+# Poteto frontier snapshot
+
+`frontier.set` stores a generation-numbered snapshot of GitHub PRs and the
+lowest open PR. It refreshes a view; it does not advance PRs through a merge
+lifecycle.
+
+**Code owner:** frontier methods in
+[`openStore`](../../runtime/codex/skills/poteto-mode/scripts/orch/store.ts#L1552)
+and [`orch.ts`](../../runtime/codex/skills/poteto-mode/scripts/orch/orch.ts#L475).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> Snapshot
+    Snapshot --> Resolving: frontier.set / resolve current PR list
+    Resolving --> Refused: duplicate or mismatched pinned PR list
+    Resolving --> Snapshot: resolution and optional pin check pass / generation + 1, replace snapshot
+    Snapshot --> Snapshot: frontier.show / return current snapshot
+    Refused --> [*]
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| Snapshot | `frontier.set` | Store writable, repo and forge valid | Resolve current PRs. |
+| Resolving | Optional `--prs` pin supplied | Duplicates or actual PR list differs | Raise error; keep previous snapshot. |
+| Resolving | Resolution and pin pass | Any valid PR result | Save generation plus one, PR rows, and first open PR or `null`. |
+| Snapshot | `frontier.show` | Store open | Return current JSON snapshot without changing it. |
+
+The actual queued PR progression is owned by
+[watch-pr queued-stack](watch-pr-queued.md).

@@ -0,0 +1,34 @@
+# Poteto inbox
+
+The inbox is a file-backed pointer queue. Draining atomically swaps the inbox
+directory, creates a new one, then removes the drained directory and returns
+the rows.
+
+**Code owner:** inbox methods in
+[`openStore`](../../runtime/codex/skills/poteto-mode/scripts/orch/store.ts#L1449);
+CLI in [`orch.ts`](../../runtime/codex/skills/poteto-mode/scripts/orch/orch.ts#L385).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> Empty
+    Empty --> Queued: inbox.push / atomically write one pointer file
+    Queued --> Queued: inbox.push / append another pointer file
+    Empty --> Draining: inbox.drain / rename directory aside
+    Queued --> Draining: inbox.drain / read rows then rename directory aside
+    Draining --> Empty: create replacement inbox, remove drained directory, return rows
+    Draining --> Queued: replacement mkdir fails / rename drained directory back and throw
+    Empty --> Empty: inbox.peek or count / read only
+    Queued --> Queued: inbox.peek or count / read only
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| Empty or Queued | `inbox.push` | Store initialized and pointer fields valid | Write one uniquely named TSV pointer file. |
+| Empty or Queued | `inbox.drain` | Store is writable | Read pointers, rename inbox to a unique drain directory, then create a new inbox. |
+| Draining | New inbox created | Directory swap succeeds | Delete drained directory and return the rows captured before swap. |
+| Draining | New inbox creation fails | Rename-back succeeds | Restore original directory and throw. |
+| Empty or Queued | `peek` or `count` | Store open | Read queue without draining it. |
+
+There is no acknowledgement stage. A process crash after renaming the inbox
+but before creating its replacement has no recovery transition in this store
+implementation.

@@ -0,0 +1,36 @@
+# Poteto store lock
+
+Opening the store is lazy: reads need no lock. `init` and writes acquire one
+exclusive PID lock; `close` releases it only while this process still owns it.
+
+**Code owners:** [`acquireLock`](../../runtime/codex/skills/poteto-mode/scripts/orch/store.ts#L382),
+write acquisition in [`openStore`](../../runtime/codex/skills/poteto-mode/scripts/orch/store.ts#L1272),
+and release at [`close`](../../runtime/codex/skills/poteto-mode/scripts/orch/store.ts#L1658).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> Unlocked
+    Unlocked --> Unlocked: read-only operation / no lock acquired
+    Unlocked --> Locked: init or write; lock file created with exclusive open
+    Unlocked --> Locked: existing PID is dead / stale owner removed and takeover succeeds
+    Unlocked --> Locked: force option / existing owner replaced
+    Unlocked --> Refused: live owner exists and force is false
+    Locked --> Locked: further writes reuse this process's lock
+    Locked --> Unlocked: close and lock file still names this PID / unlink lock
+    Locked --> Closed: close and no owned lock remains
+    Refused --> [*]
+    Closed --> [*]
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| Unlocked | Read | Store open | Read files without acquiring an exclusive lock. |
+| Unlocked | `init` or write | Store directory exists for write; lock is free | Create the lock file with `open(..., "wx")`. |
+| Unlocked | Lock already exists | Holder PID is dead | Notify stale-lock callback, remove old lock, and retry creation. |
+| Unlocked | Lock already exists | `force` enabled | Notify stolen-lock callback, remove lock, and retry creation. |
+| Unlocked | Lock already exists | Holder is live and `force` is false | Raise `UserError`; do not write. |
+| Locked | `close` | Lock file still names this process | Remove lock, then mark store closed. |
+| Locked | `close` | Lock no longer names this process | Do not remove another owner's lock; mark this handle closed. |
+
+If takeover races with another writer, the retry sees the new lock and raises
+`UserError`. Read operations remain available without the write lock.

+# Poteto unit records
+
+`units.add` creates a pending unit. `units.set` updates that row, but accepts
+any non-empty state string and imposes no transition graph or terminal-state
+rule.
+
+**Code owner:** unit methods in
+[`openStore`](../../runtime/codex/skills/poteto-mode/scripts/orch/store.ts#L1312);
+CLI surface in [`orch.ts`](../../runtime/codex/skills/poteto-mode/scripts/orch/orch.ts#L296).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> Absent
+    Absent --> Pending: units.add / reject duplicate ID
+    Pending --> AnyState: units.set with non-empty state
+    AnyState --> AnyState: units.set with non-empty state
+    Pending --> Error: set unknown ID or blank state
+    AnyState --> Error: set unknown ID or blank state
+    Error --> [*]
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| Absent | `units.add` | ID and track are non-empty; ID is not already present | Append a row with `state: "pending"` and blank branch/PR/SHA. |
+| Pending or any existing state | `units.set` | ID exists; state is non-empty | Replace state with caller-provided text; preserve fields not supplied. |
+| Any state | `units.set` | ID is absent or state is blank | Raise an error; no row transition. |
+
+Names such as `running`, `passed`, or `blocked` are caller conventions. The
+store does not validate them or prevent reopening a terminal-looking state.

+# Prompt extraction
+
+The SessionEnd prompt extractor scans synced project sessions for
+`SAVE_PROMPT:` markers. It tracks processed session basenames and extracted
+prompt names in a local JSON file.
+
+**Code owners:** active SessionEnd registration in
+[`claude/settings.json`](../../claude/settings.json#L267), state read/write in
+[`loadProcessedState`](../../claude/hooks/prompt-extractor/extract.ts#L40),
+and scan loop in [`main`](../../claude/hooks/prompt-extractor/extract.ts#L125).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> LoadState
+    LoadState --> Done: projects directory absent / ask for sync
+    LoadState --> Scan: project sessions available
+    Scan --> SkipKnown: basename already in processedFiles
+    Scan --> Extract: new file
+    Extract --> SkipPrompt: prompt name already extracted
+    Extract --> CreatePrompt: new SAVE_PROMPT marker
+    CreatePrompt --> MarkFile: prompt note written and name recorded
+    SkipPrompt --> MarkFile: file scan complete
+    MarkFile --> Scan: another file remains
+    MarkFile --> Save: no files remain
+    SkipKnown --> Scan: another file remains
+    SkipKnown --> Save: no files remain
+    Save --> Done: write lastRun and processed state
+    Done --> [*]: return continue=true
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| LoadState | Hook starts | Processed file missing or invalid JSON | Start with empty processed lists. |
+| LoadState | Projects directory absent | No synced sessions available | Return a sync instruction without updating state. |
+| Scan | Session basename already processed | Match found in `processedFiles` | Skip the file. |
+| Scan | New session file | File is readable | Search content for prompt markers. |
+| Extract | Marker found | Prompt name already recorded | Skip creating a duplicate note. |
+| Extract | Marker found | Prompt name is new | Write prompt markdown note and append its name. |
+| MarkFile | File scan ends | New file was examined | Add basename to processed list. |
+| Save | All files scanned | Any results | Write `lastRun`, `processedFiles`, and `extractedPrompts`. |
+
+The deduplication key is a basename, not a full project-relative path. This
+chart records that implementation detail; it does not establish that two
+projects cannot contain the same basename.

+# Qwen API request retries
+
+This chart covers the Qwen worker's request retry and output-validation path.
+
+**Code owner:** [`qwen-worker.sh`](../../runtime/codex/scripts/qwen-worker.sh#L246).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> Request
+    Request --> RetryWait: retryable transport/status/body failure and attempt <= RETRIES
+    Request --> Interpret: successful HTTP response or non-retryable response
+    RetryWait --> Request: delay expires / exponential delay capped at RETRY_MAX_DELAY
+    Interpret --> Complete: usable content and finish reason accepted
+    Interpret --> Failed: curl/HTTP/provider error, truncation, or missing final text
+    Complete --> [*]
+    Failed --> [*]
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| Request | Curl and provider response collected | Retryable transport, HTTP status, or provider message and `attempt <= RETRIES` | Sleep, double delay up to its configured cap, then request again. |
+| Request | Response collected | Non-retryable failure or retries exhausted | Exit with the provider or curl failure. |
+| Request | 2xx response collected | Body has a retryable provider error and retry budget remains | Retry using bounded exponential backoff. |
+| Interpret | Response parsed | `finish_reason` and content pass validation | Emit content and exit 0. |
+| Interpret | Response parsed | Truncated response, empty text, or API error | Exit nonzero with the failure. |
+
+With the default retry count of three, the loop permits up to four total
+requests. Retry settings and response validation are owned by this script.

+# Build-failure reaction queue
+
+The active PostToolUse collector writes failed build/test reactions to a
+pending directory. The active UserPromptSubmit injector consumes matching
+branch entries into a processed directory, up to three per prompt.
+
+**Code owners:** active event registrations in
+[`claude/settings.json`](../../claude/settings.json#L183),
+producer [`reaction-collector.sh`](../../claude/hooks/reaction-collector.sh#L9),
+and consumer [`reaction-injector.py`](../../claude/hooks/reaction-injector.py#L63).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> NoReaction
+    NoReaction --> Pending: recognized build/test command has known nonzero exit
+    NoReaction --> NoReaction: non-build command, success, or unknown exit
+    Pending --> Pending: prompt branch differs / leave file queued
+    Pending --> Processed: malformed JSON / move aside
+    Pending --> Processed: branch matches or is unavailable / inject message and move aside
+    Processed --> [*]
+    Pending --> Pending: prompt already consumed three reactions / remaining files wait
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| NoReaction | Bash tool completes | Command matches build/test patterns and exit code is known nonzero | Write JSON with command, output, branch, session, and recent edited-file context. |
+| NoReaction | Bash tool completes | Non-build command, success, or exit code unknown | Do not create reaction. |
+| Pending | User prompt submitted | Reaction JSON malformed/unreadable | Move file to processed without injecting it. |
+| Pending | User prompt submitted | Reaction branch differs from current branch | Keep file pending. |
+| Pending | User prompt submitted | Branch matches, or either branch is unavailable | Inject reaction and move file to processed. |
+| Pending | User prompt submitted | Three messages already injected | Stop; later sorted files remain pending. |
+
+`post-tool-use-tracker.sh` supplies edited-file history used to enrich producer
+records; its event log has a separate chart in
+[post-tool-use tracking](post-tool-use-tracking.md).

+# Reflect learning-count nudge
+
+The active SessionStart hook reads the last completed `/reflect` timestamp,
+counts newer archived session learnings, and prints a reminder at five or
+more. `/reflect` resets the timestamp after generating its report.
+
+**Code owners:** active registration in
+[`claude/settings.json`](../../claude/settings.json#L75), counter read in
+[`reflect-nudge.py`](../../claude/hooks/reflect-nudge.py#L27), and reset in
+[`reflect-reweave.py`](../../claude/scripts/reflect-reweave.py#L610).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> ReadCheckpoint
+    ReadCheckpoint --> Count: state file absent or timestamp loaded
+    Count --> Quiet: database unavailable or driver missing
+    Count --> Quiet: unreviewed learning count below 5
+    Count --> Nudge: unreviewed learning count is at least 5
+    Nudge --> ReadCheckpoint: /reflect completes / save new last_reflect time
+    Quiet --> [*]
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| ReadCheckpoint | Session starts | State missing or invalid | Use Unix epoch as last reflection time. |
+| Count | Database query succeeds | Count is below five | Print no reminder. |
+| Count | Database query succeeds | Count is at least five | Print reminder to run `/reflect`. |
+| Count | Driver import or database connection/query fails | Error caught by hook | Print no reminder; do not change checkpoint. |
+| Nudge | `/reflect` report completes | Reflect command reaches checkpoint write | Save current UTC time as `last_reflect`. |
+
+The nudge does not update its own checkpoint, so it can repeat until the
+reflect command writes one.

+# Runtime web-search backend retries
+
+The Codex runtime web-search entrypoint checks its cache, then tries enabled
+backends in order. Each backend gets two attempts with a short randomized wait
+after an empty result or exception.
+
+**Code owners:** backend retry in
+[`call_backend`](../../runtime/codex/scripts/web-search.py#L243) and backend
+selection/cache in [`search`](../../runtime/codex/scripts/web-search.py#L314).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> CacheLookup
+    CacheLookup --> Cached: fresh valid cache and cache enabled
+    CacheLookup --> BackendOne: cache miss or --no-cache
+    BackendOne --> Results: backend returns results
+    BackendOne --> Wait: empty result or exception on attempt one
+    Wait --> BackendTwo: randomized 0.4-1.2s delay
+    BackendTwo --> Results: backend returns results
+    BackendTwo --> NextBackend: empty result or exception
+    NextBackend --> Results: a later backend returns results
+    NextBackend --> Empty: all configured backends exhausted
+    Results --> Done: optional cache write
+    Cached --> Done
+    Empty --> Done
+    Done --> [*]
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| CacheLookup | Query starts | Cache enabled and entry is fresh/valid | Return cached results and backend. |
+| CacheLookup | Cache miss or bypass | Query needs live search | Try enabled backends in order. |
+| BackendOne | Backend call | Results non-empty | Return results and optionally cache them. |
+| BackendOne | Backend call | Empty result or exception | Wait a random 0.4–1.2 seconds, then call same backend once more. |
+| BackendTwo | Second attempt ends empty or throws | Another backend remains | Continue with next backend. |
+| NextBackend | No backend remains | Every backend produced no results | Return empty result list and no backend name. |
+
+The code retries the same backend once, regardless of whether the failure is
+an exception or an empty result. It does not persist retry state.

+# Claude session metrics capture
+
+The active Stop hook parses a transcript and branch build-attempt log, then
+replaces one SQLite row per session and rebuilds that session's tool-usage
+rows.
+
+**Code owners:** active registration in
+[`claude/settings.json`](../../claude/settings.json#L217), transcript parsing
+in [`session-metrics.py`](../../claude/hooks/session-metrics.py#L55), and
+idempotent storage in [`store_metrics`](../../claude/hooks/session-metrics.py#L251).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> ReadHookInput
+    ReadHookInput --> Done: transcript path absent or missing
+    ReadHookInput --> InitializeDB: transcript exists
+    InitializeDB --> Parse: schema ready
+    Parse --> Store: transcript counters and build attempts collected
+    Store --> Done: replace session row, rebuild tool rows, commit
+    Done --> [*]: return continue
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| ReadHookInput | Stop event arrives | Malformed/empty input | Use default session identifier and available environment paths. |
+| ReadHookInput | Transcript checked | Missing path or file | Return without database write. |
+| InitializeDB | Transcript exists | Directory/database writable | Create schema if needed. |
+| Parse | Transcript read | JSONL events parse | Count messages, tool calls/errors, modified files, subagents, and duration; read build attempts from current branch log. |
+| Store | Metrics computed | Session ID supplied | `INSERT OR REPLACE` session row, delete old tool rows, insert current rows, commit. |
+
+The database key makes a repeated Stop capture replace the same session row;
+the table writes occur in one SQLite transaction after parsing.

+# Claude session-monitor status projection and watch loop
+
+The monitor classifies each session from a bounded tail of JSONL events. With
+`--watch`, it refreshes the snapshot every five seconds until Ctrl+C. It does
+not persist the classification.
+
+**Code owners:** status projection in
+[`classify_session`](../../claude/scripts/session-monitor.py#L72), and CLI
+watch loop in [`main`](../../claude/scripts/session-monitor.py#L307).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> Snapshot
+    Snapshot --> Unknown: no events or no parseable state
+    Snapshot --> Idle: last activity older than 120 seconds
+    Snapshot --> WaitingInput: latest meaningful event is user/system or completed text
+    Snapshot --> Generating: assistant thinking, streaming, or recent text
+    Snapshot --> ToolUse: latest assistant block is tool_use
+    Unknown --> Snapshot: next five-second refresh
+    Idle --> Snapshot: next five-second refresh
+    WaitingInput --> Snapshot: next five-second refresh
+    Generating --> Snapshot: next five-second refresh
+    ToolUse --> Snapshot: next five-second refresh
+    Snapshot --> [*]: one-shot output or Ctrl+C in watch mode
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| Snapshot | Session files scanned | No events in bounded tail | Report `unknown`. |
+| Snapshot | Recent timestamp evaluated | Last event is older than 120 seconds | Report `idle`. |
+| Snapshot | Latest meaningful event inspected | User/system event, or assistant text followed by trailing event or older than ten seconds | Report `waiting_input`. |
+| Snapshot | Latest assistant content inspected | Thinking, empty stream, or recent assistant text | Report `generating`. |
+| Snapshot | Latest assistant content inspected | Last block is `tool_use` | Report `tool_use` with tool details. |
+| Any projection | Refresh or interrupt | `--watch` enabled | Clear and recompute after five seconds; Ctrl+C exits. |
+
+These are snapshots derived from recent events, not persisted transitions.
+Some status-writing hooks referenced by the environment are stored under
+`~/dotfiles` and are outside this repository.

+# Session vault note lifecycle
+
+SessionEnd writes a metadata stub only when today's note is absent. The
+nightly sync enriches that same note when it has no real summary; a real
+summary is preserved on later syncs.
+
+**Code owners:** active SessionEnd handler
+[`session-to-obsidian.sh`](../../claude/hooks/session-to-obsidian.sh#L8),
+and scheduled enrichment in
+[`nightly-session-sync.sh`](../../claude/scripts/nightly-session-sync.sh#L159).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> NoNote
+    NoNote --> Stub: SessionEnd / create metadata note
+    Stub --> RealSummary: nightly sync generates real summary and overwrites target
+    Stub --> Placeholder: nightly sync cannot summarize / overwrite with failure placeholder
+    Placeholder --> RealSummary: later nightly run retries summary and succeeds
+    Placeholder --> Placeholder: later nightly run retries and still fails
+    RealSummary --> RealSummary: later nightly sync / has_real_summary skips overwrite
+    Stub --> Stub: SessionEnd sees existing file / preserve it
+    Placeholder --> Placeholder: SessionEnd sees existing file / preserve it
+    RealSummary --> RealSummary: SessionEnd sees existing file / preserve it
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| NoNote | SessionEnd | Destination absent | Write metadata stub with “in progress” placeholder. |
+| Any existing note | SessionEnd | Destination exists | Do not overwrite. |
+| Stub or Placeholder | Nightly sync | Target has no real summary | Generate summary and replace note; on failure write placeholder. |
+| RealSummary | Nightly sync | Summary bullets pass `has_real_summary` | Skip note so the summary remains unchanged. |
+
+Both producers use the same project folder, date, and eight-character session
+ID naming rule.

+# Statechart generation and publication
+
+`statechart.mjs` accepts a TLA+ spec or Mermaid chart, checks it, renders
+artifacts in a temporary work folder, and replaces the output directory only
+after input fingerprints and output ownership checks pass.
+
+**Code owners:** [`fromSpec`](../../runtime/codex/skills/statechart/scripts/statechart.mjs#L877),
+[`fromChart`](../../runtime/codex/skills/statechart/scripts/statechart.mjs#L910),
+[`finish`](../../runtime/codex/skills/statechart/scripts/statechart.mjs#L652),
+and transactional [`publish`](../../runtime/codex/skills/statechart/scripts/statechart.mjs#L758).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> SelectMode
+    SelectMode --> SpecInput: from-spec
+    SelectMode --> ChartInput: from-chart
+    SpecInput --> Scaffold: map missing / write scaffold and stop
+    SpecInput --> Check: spec, config, and map available
+    ChartInput --> GenerateSpec: generated TLA+ module absent
+    ChartInput --> Check: generated module already present
+    GenerateSpec --> Check: write TLA+, config, and map
+    Check --> Refused: invalid input, missing tool, or broken model contract
+    Check --> Draw: TLC checks pass or expected breaks match
+    Draw --> Compare: from-chart
+    Draw --> ValidateInputs: from-spec
+    Compare --> ValidateInputs: compare generated overview with source chart
+    ValidateInputs --> NotPublished: any input fingerprint changed
+    ValidateInputs --> Stage: inputs unchanged
+    Stage --> Refused: output contains files this command does not own
+    Stage --> Swap: copy new output beside destination and recheck ownership
+    Swap --> Published: new output installed / remove previous output
+    Swap --> Restored: publish fails and previous output is restored
+    Swap --> NotPublished: rollback also fails / preserve recovery location
+    Published --> [*]
+    Restored --> [*]
+    NotPublished --> [*]
+    Refused --> [*]
+    Scaffold --> [*]
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| SpecInput | Map lookup | Map absent | Write a scaffold and stop before TLC so code labels can be filled in. |
+| ChartInput | Spec lookup | TLA+ module absent | Generate module/config/map from the Mermaid chart; then check it. |
+| Check | TLC completes | Required outcomes match expectations | Draw charts and stories in temporary work area. |
+| Check | TLC/model validation fails | Contract not satisfied | Stop; no output publication. |
+| Draw | Finish | Inputs changed during analysis | Refuse publication and leave previous output as-is. |
+| Stage | Output directory inspected | Foreign files exist | Refuse replacement because publication swaps the whole directory. |
+| Stage | Output is owned | Input fingerprints still match | Copy candidate output to a sibling staging folder and recheck. |
+| Swap | Replace succeeds | Old output was safely moved aside | Install candidate and remove old copy. |
+| Swap | Replace fails | Old output can be moved back | Restore old output and report failure. |
+| Swap | Rollback fails | Old output cannot be restored | Preserve recovery folder and report that state. |
+
+This chart records the CLI's control flow. No TLC or renderer was run during
+this inventory.

+# All-project session sync
+
+`sync-all-sessions.sh` processes configured project paths in order: invoke
+SpecStory, copy new session notes, create missing project indexes, split large
+sessions, then run prompt extraction.
+
+**Code owner:** project loop in
+[`sync-all-sessions.sh`](../../claude/scripts/sync-all-sessions.sh#L11),
+with final split/extract steps beginning at [line 93](../../claude/scripts/sync-all-sessions.sh#L93).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> ProjectList
+    ProjectList --> SyncProject: another configured path remains
+    ProjectList --> SplitSessions: all paths processed
+    SyncProject --> ProjectList: path absent or operations finish
+    SyncProject --> ProjectList: SpecStory/copy failures are ignored
+    SplitSessions --> ExtractPrompts: split command succeeds
+    SplitSessions --> Failed: split command fails under set -e
+    ExtractPrompts --> Done: prompt extractor returns success
+    ExtractPrompts --> Failed: prompt extractor fails under set -e
+    Done --> [*]
+    Failed --> [*]
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| ProjectList | Configured project path examined | Directory absent | Skip path. |
+| ProjectList | Configured project path examined | Directory exists | Create vault folders, run SpecStory, copy session markdown with `cp -n`, create index only if missing. |
+| SyncProject | SpecStory or copy command fails | Commands are guarded with `|| true` | Continue to next project. |
+| ProjectList | No configured paths remain | All project calls returned | Print project counts and run split step. |
+| SplitSessions | Split command succeeds | Exit status zero | Invoke prompt extractor. |
+| SplitSessions or ExtractPrompts | Command fails | `set -e` active | Exit immediately; later steps do not run. |
+
+This pipeline has no run checkpoint of its own. Copies are idempotent by
+destination filename; split and prompt extraction have their own file/state
+rules.

+# Watch PR queued stack
+
+The queued runner first refreshes a whole stack, then polls only the lowest
+unmerged frontier between scheduled sweeps. It advances only when the previous
+frontier is observed merged.
+
+**Code owners:** queue planning and snapshots in
+[`planQueue`](../../runtime/codex/skills/poteto-mode/scripts/watch-pr/policy.ts#L535),
+[`applyQueueSnapshot`](../../runtime/codex/skills/poteto-mode/scripts/watch-pr/policy.ts#L574),
+[`evaluateQueue`](../../runtime/codex/skills/poteto-mode/scripts/watch-pr/policy.ts#L644),
+and [`runQueued`](../../runtime/codex/skills/poteto-mode/scripts/watch-pr/policy.ts#L707).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> Sweep
+    Sweep --> Evaluate: every non-merged PR has a fresh snapshot
+    Evaluate --> Complete: every queued PR is merged
+    Evaluate --> Blocked: any stack-wide merge blocker
+    Evaluate --> Advance: prior frontier became merged; next open PR exists
+    Evaluate --> Waiting: frontier still pending checks or stack merge is queued
+    Evaluate --> TimedOut: timeout reached with unmerged PRs
+    Advance --> Sweep: emit frontier advance and refresh stack
+    Waiting --> FrontierPoll: polling interval elapses before next whole-stack sweep
+    FrontierPoll --> Evaluate: refresh current lowest unmerged PR
+    FrontierPoll --> Sweep: scheduled sweep is due
+    Complete --> [*]
+    Blocked --> [*]
+    TimedOut --> [*]
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| Sweep | Queue state created or sweep due | Non-merged PRs remain | Read each non-merged PR in queue order and require a complete sweep before evaluation. |
+| Evaluate | Snapshot set complete | All PRs merged | Return terminal complete verdict. |
+| Evaluate | Snapshot set complete | Any conflict, review thread, failed check, or merge gate | Return terminal blocker verdict. |
+| Evaluate | Frontier changed | Old frontier is now merged and next open PR exists | Update frontier and emit `ADVANCE`. |
+| Evaluate | Frontier not ready | Pending checks or merge queue; timeout not reached | Emit waiting when wait key changes, then sleep. |
+| Evaluate | Frontier not ready | Run deadline reached | Return terminal queued-stack timeout. |
+| Waiting | Interval elapses | Whole-stack sweep is not due | Poll only current frontier. |
+| FrontierPoll | Snapshot applied | Sweep time reached | Start a new whole-stack sweep before further evaluation. |
+
+Query retries and status-query blockers are shared with the simple runner's
+[`pollUntilTerminal`](watch-pr-simple.md).

+# Watch PR simple and stack runner
+
+This runner polls a single PR or ordinary stack until the status-only response,
+a blocker, readiness, query failure, or deadline ends the run.
+
+**Code owners:** [`pollUntilTerminal`](../../runtime/codex/skills/poteto-mode/scripts/watch-pr/policy.ts#L365),
+[`runSimple`](../../runtime/codex/skills/poteto-mode/scripts/watch-pr/policy.ts#L417),
+and classification in [`classifyPr`](../../runtime/codex/skills/poteto-mode/scripts/watch-pr/policy.ts#L218).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> ReadStatus
+    ReadStatus --> StatusOnly: statusOnly requested
+    ReadStatus --> Blocked: conflict, review-thread, failing-check, or merge-gate blocker
+    ReadStatus --> Ready: PR ready/merged, or entire ordinary stack clear
+    ReadStatus --> Waiting: pending checks and no blocker
+    ReadStatus --> RetryWait: retryable status query error below error limit
+    ReadStatus --> QueryBlocked: non-retryable error or max query errors reached
+    Waiting --> ReadStatus: interval elapses before deadline
+    Waiting --> TimedOut: deadline reached with pending checks
+    RetryWait --> ReadStatus: bounded backoff elapses before deadline
+    RetryWait --> TimedOut: deadline reached while status unavailable
+    StatusOnly --> [*]
+    Blocked --> [*]
+    Ready --> [*]
+    QueryBlocked --> [*]
+    TimedOut --> [*]
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| ReadStatus | Snapshot read | Status-only mode | Return terminal status snapshot. |
+| ReadStatus | Snapshot classified | Conflict, unresolved review thread, failing check, or merge gate | Return a terminal blocker verdict. |
+| ReadStatus | Snapshot classified | Ready or merged | Return terminal ready verdict. |
+| ReadStatus | Snapshot classified | Open PR has pending checks and no blocker | Emit waiting state and sleep for polling interval. |
+| ReadStatus | Query throws | Retryable and below `maxQueryErrors` | Emit retry notice and sleep with exponential backoff capped at 300 seconds. |
+| ReadStatus | Query throws | Non-retryable or max errors reached | Return terminal status-query blocker. |
+| Waiting or RetryWait | Deadline check | Deadline elapsed | Return terminal timeout verdict. |
+
+The simple runner rejects `queued-stack` mode; that progression is a separate
+machine in [watch-pr queued stack](watch-pr-queued.md).

@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+# XERJ source snapshot publication
+
+`export_snapshot` validates a full Git commit and a new output path, scans and
+filters tree entries, copies verified blobs, then writes `.snapshot.json` as
+the final receipt. A failure after directory creation can leave a partial
+output without a receipt; because the output now exists, rerunning to that
+path is refused.
+
+**Code owners:** output validation in
+[`validate_output_path`](../../scripts/xerj_snapshot.py#L353), export flow in
+[`export_snapshot`](../../scripts/xerj_snapshot.py#L368), and receipt write at
+[line 475](../../scripts/xerj_snapshot.py#L475).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> Validate
+    Validate --> Refused: repository, full commit SHA, or new output path invalid
+    Validate --> ScanTree: all inputs pass and commit resolves
+    ScanTree --> Refused: Git/tree/read validation fails
+    ScanTree --> CreateOutput: exclusions, sensitive-content checks, and collision checks finish
+    CreateOutput --> ExportBlobs: create private output directory
+    ExportBlobs --> Partial: blob read, digest, path, or write fails
+    ExportBlobs --> Receipt: every eligible file written and executable mode restored
+    Receipt --> Published: write .snapshot.json last
+    Published --> [*]: return receipt and totals
+    Partial --> [*]: report error; partial directory remains without receipt
+    Refused --> [*]: return error before output creation
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| Validate | CLI starts | Repo is valid, commit is full SHA, output absent, parent exists, output outside worktree | Resolve commit, load exclusions, and read tree. |
+| ScanTree | Tree entry examined | Path/mode/type/size or exclusion pattern rejects it | Record exclusion. |
+| ScanTree | Candidate file read | Content is safe and no output-path collision exists | Record size, object ID, and digest for export. |
+| CreateOutput | Scan complete | Eligible set finalized | Create output directory with mode 0700. |
+| ExportBlobs | Blob copied | Blob size and digest match scan | Create file exclusively, preserve executable mode, append export receipt data. |
+| ExportBlobs | Any write or integrity failure | Output directory already exists | Stop; leave partial output in place without `.snapshot.json`. |
+| Receipt | All files exported | Export/exclusion totals sorted | Write `.snapshot.json` with exclusive create as final publication step. |
+
+The output is not installed by rename: its existence is reserved before blob
+copying, and the receipt is the completion marker.

@@ -0,0 +1,39 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+import json
+import math
+import sys
+
+import board_resources
+
+
+def host_reading():
+    before = board_resources.collect(include_board=False)
+    after = board_resources.collect(include_board=False)
+    fields = ("sampled_at", "total_bytes", "available_bytes", "cores", "load1", "load5",
+              "pressure", "free_percent", "swap_used_bytes", "swapouts", "page_size",
+              "compressor_bytes", "disk_wait_ratio")
+    for sample in (before, after):
+        if sample.get("complete") is not True or sample.get("errors"):
+            raise ValueError("Incomplete host reading")
+        if any(type(sample.get(key)) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(sample[key])
+               or sample[key] < 0 for key in fields):
+            raise ValueError("Invalid host reading")
+    gap = after["sampled_at"] - before["sampled_at"]
+    if not 0 < gap <= 2 or after["page_size"] != before["page_size"] or after["swapouts"] < before["swapouts"]:
+        raise ValueError("Unknown swap baseline")
+    swap_growth = max(0, after["swap_used_bytes"] - before["swap_used_bytes"]) / gap
+    swapout_rate = (after["swapouts"] - before["swapouts"]) * after["page_size"] / gap
+    compressor_growth = max(0, after["compressor_bytes"] - before["compressor_bytes"]) / gap

bundles.description:
Improve the board slot governor that LMW-4 installed (PR #72 and its fix; log at ~/.multica-codex/board-governor.jsonl). Keep it small and extend the existing governor; do not add a second one.

1. Adaptive limit (AIMD, as in Netflix concurrency-limits): grow the slot count by one at a time only after a sustained healthy window (load per core, memory pressure, swap and compressor growth, board response time all good), and cut it multiplicatively on pressure (for example halve on high disk wait or memory pressure, to zero on emergency). Replace fixed thresholds where they cause the limit to stick, such as the current hold at 7 with reason pressure_or_reserve while load is around 8 on 14 cores.
2. Start gate (as in GNU parallel --memfree and make -l): before the board starts a new agent, require free memory above a floor plus the per-agent cost (about 2 GB and 0.8 cores from the live readings), and load below a ceiling; otherwise the task stays queued.
3. Waiting agents: make the explicit-wait path the default for long waits (waiting on another task, a PR merge, a deploy window, a reset), so waiting agents release their slot. Document how an agent should wait in the wiki how-to and worker instructions.
4. Read the AGPL-free ideas only; do not copy code from Netflix concurrency-limits or other projects.

Prove it on the live board: a log excerpt showing the limit rising one slot at a time after a healthy window, falling on a real or simulated pressure spike, a start held back by the memory gate, and a waiting agent releasing its slot so a queued task starts. Install without interrupting running agent sessions.

## Safety first (Shyam, 2026-10-27 02:00 UTC)
The governor should flex the slot count on the fly, but it must never let the Mac overload. Tonight it raised slots to 9 while the load average was 194 (reason 'sustained_load'), earlier raised 7 to 8 under 'emergency_pressure_incomplete', and the Mac had to be force-restarted after CPU and memory hit 100%. The Coordinator has paused it (launchctl bootout of ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.shyam.board-governor.plist) and set board.agents to 4 by hand.
Hard rules:
- It may never raise the limit while any pressure signal is bad (load per core, memory pressure, swap or compressor growth, disk wait, board response time), and any error, timeout or missing reading means hold or lower, never raise.
- On critical pressure it lowers immediately and also acts on running work (pause or stop the newest heavy jobs) instead of only blocking new starts; coordinate with LMW-7's backstop so there is one mechanism, not two.
- It never sets the limit above a ceiling derived from cores and memory, and never above what the last healthy window supports.
Prove it before turning it back on: replay tonight's real readings from ~/.multica-codex/board-governor.jsonl (load 117 to 361) and show it would have lowered every time; run a controlled stress test that pushes load and memory up and show it pulls back before the Mac is unresponsive; then re-enable it with launchctl bootstrap and show a live log of it raising one slot at a time when healthy.

## Priority and deadlines (Shyam, 2026-10-27 02:40 UTC)
Tonight the order of work depended on the Coordinator stopping and re-delegating tasks by hand to move the critical one forward, and the deploy for the 13:30 UTC open waited about 6 hours across two restarts.
- Priority: support a per-task priority (and an optional deadline) so open-critical work starts first; check first whether the board already has a priority or ordering setting, and use it instead of building one. If the board needs a change, write the upstream issue or PR text for eliasstravik/herdr-projects; do not patch the installed plugin.
- Reserved slot: keep one slot for the highest-priority task whenever it is ready, so it never waits behind lower-priority work.
- Cap on running work: when the limit drops below the number of running agents, pause the lowest-priority heavy agents first (keep their work), instead of only blocking new starts.
- Wait visibility: log each task's wait time and cause (slot, review, merge, dependency, human) so the Coordinator can report the longest wait and its deadline every 15 minutes.
Prove it on the live board: a high-priority task added behind four queued ones starts first, and a cap drop pauses the lowest-priority heavy agent.

## Bug found (2026-10-27 03:50 UTC)
The explicit wait does not work from a board agent: SRW-41 ran 'herdr-projects wait SRW-41 --until ... --reason ...' (and with SRW-41) and got exit 1, 'wait can only be used by SRW41 own agent', from inside its own board session. So agents cannot release a slot while waiting and fall back to ending their turn or polling. Fix or work around this (find how the board identifies the owning agent, for example an environment variable missing from codex sessions), and prove a real board agent can wait and give its slot to a queued task. Also: a task whose agent process is gone must not keep its slot (LMW-4's dead session held one for about 3 hours).

## Next steps (Coordinator, 2026-10-27 15:45 UTC; restarted on Claude after a stuck Cursor message)
1. Put main's load backstop back live: the running copy differs from main (it adds REQUEST_TTL_SECONDS and request-curtail handling, unmerged). Run main's load_backstop.py install then resume (LMW-14's backup is ~/.multica-codex/load-backstop.backup-20261027T074117), keep agents alive, confirm with cmp against main. Install new versions only after their PR merges; add the main-only install check you started.
2. Recalibrate the memory gate: today tasks idled on 'memory pressure' while 43 to 46 percent of memory was free and load was 6 to 8. Base the gate on free memory, swap growth and load per core, not the macOS pressure level alone. Pass test: no task waits on memory while more than 30 percent is free, and the replay of the overnight overload still throttles every time.
3. Fix the remaining review findings, prove live safety, then turn the governor on and end your turn.

## Hand off now (Coordinator, 17:10 UTC; restarted on pi after a stuck omp message)
The priority memory-gate fix is committed (2afc936) and the premature-resume fix (4d5eede); the closing note is written. Check the branch is pushed and the replay proof still passes on current main, then end your turn so the board reviews and merges it. Do not start new work in this round.

## Scope for this task (Coordinator, 2026-10-27 20:10 UTC; replaces the proof list above)
Seven reviews failed on two things this task cannot do from llmwiki: (a) an atomic memory and load gate inside the board's own start and wake path, which is upstream issue eliasstravik/herdr-projects#418, and (b) live acceptance, which needs the governor installed from merged main. Both move out of this task.
Done for this task: the governor code, the replay of the overnight overload (every reading lowers or holds), the critical-pressure curtail through LMW-7's backstop, and the bounded stress test, merged with the governor left turned off. The closing note lists the open live checks and links #418. Live acceptance is a separate follow-up after this merges.

+# Runtime state charts
+
+These charts describe first-party executable lifecycle owners found in the
+repository. Each chart links to the code that performs the transition. A chart
+records control flow; it does not prove that an execution reached a state.
+
+## Inventory basis
+
+The inventory starts at baseline `cf4323f61f8b6d7f1f491edc2d15ae834d9dc872`.
+The direct worker supervisor chart also reflects fix commit `a793122`: a
+missing circuit file bootstraps fresh state; malformed, non-object,
+unreadable, or un-lockable existing state refuses dispatch. The associated
+formal and replay model is in `4eba0bb`.
+
+The source changes introduced by main commit `20798c7` have been reconciled
+through main commit `ecd3314`: load-backstop pressure/job and service
+charts are added; SessionStart now covers handoff-first loading and legacy
+fallback; both PreCompact writers and PostToolUse tracking reflect the
+merged task-local handoff/cache paths.
+

+## Coverage boundary and exceptions
+
+The inventory includes executables that persist control or publication
+state, gate later actions, retry provider work, poll until a terminal result,
+supervise a repeating service, or run an ordered batch sync. A script that
+only adapts one hook event, formats output, or performs a one-shot transform
+without a retry, gate, sync, or publication step is not a lifecycle machine
+under that rule.
+
+| Exception | Why it is not a charted lifecycle machine |
+|---|---|
+| Named worker wrappers such as `direct-codex-worker.sh`, `codex-worker.sh`, `luna-worker.sh`, `terra-worker.sh`, and provider launchers | They select arguments and hand off to the charted supervisor or provider request owner; they do not retain a second lifecycle. |

+| `claude/hooks/src/compiler-in-the-loop-stop.ts`, legacy continuity scripts, and `claude/hooks/auto-handoff-stop.py` | Not registered by the current `claude/settings.json`; the active v4.7 stop gate is charted. |
+| `claude/scripts/synthteam-persona-refresh.sh` | Operates on the separate Synthteam home and skill tree; outside the llmwiki-owned lifecycle boundary. |
+| One-shot CLI smoke/verification scripts | Verification procedures rather than production lifecycle owners. |

+
+The active Claude hook registry uses `~/dotfiles` paths as aliases to the
+canonical llmwiki checkout; those handlers are included above. The following
+active handlers are deliberately listed as exceptions because they make one
+event-level decision and do not retain a lifecycle state:

+| [`ttsr.py`](../../claude/hooks/ttsr.py#L16) | Reads prompt triggers and injects matching rules; it does not write state or retry. |

+launches a cached Claude HUD plugin. That package is outside this repository;
+the Stop hook's read of its temporary context-percentage file is charted, but

+
+Older Claude Fusion worker and MCP copies are inactive: current
+[`claude/rules/core.md`](../../claude/rules/core.md#L25) retires those commands.
+Codex Fusion owners remain active and are charted above.
+
+## Registered owner without tracked implementation
+
+`claude/settings.json` registers
+[`subagent-stop-continuity.sh`](../../claude/hooks/subagent-stop-continuity.sh).
+The wrapper changes directory to `~/.claude/hooks` and invokes
+`dist/subagent-stop-continuity.mjs`. That implementation and a corresponding
+source file are not tracked in this worktree, so its intended ledger/cache
+lifecycle cannot be charted from repository code. The runtime target may be
+built or installed separately; the missing worktree file does not prove a
+live failure. Recover its source ownership on the next inventory pass.
+
+## Updating after the baseline
+
+For this inventory, the code baseline is
+`cf4323f61f8b6d7f1f491edc2d15ae834d9dc872`; the direct-supervisor behavior
+delta is `a793122`. On later runs, find the latest commit that changed a chart,

+git log --oneline "$CHART_BASE"..HEAD -- \

+# Board governor decision
+
+Each tick consumes a resource sample plus persisted timing and cost estimates,
+then computes a target worker limit. Incomplete observations never become a
+zero count.
+
+**Code owners:** [`decision`](../../runtime/codex/scripts/board_governor.py#L65)
+and [`tick`](../../runtime/codex/scripts/board_governor.py#L216).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> Sample
+    Sample --> HoldRunning: incomplete emergency pressure / clear timing history
+    Sample --> LoadOnly: incomplete sample with usable CPU/load data
+    Sample --> Measure: complete sample
+    LoadOnly --> HoldRunning: sustained overload
+    LoadOnly --> HoldCurrent: overload not sustained
+    Measure --> Reduce: pressure, sustained overload, or no memory headroom
+    Measure --> HoldCurrent: process census incomplete
+    Measure --> CostKnown: complete census and learned resource costs exist
+    Measure --> Calibrate: zero running workers, zero current limit, healthy capacity, unknown cost
+    CostKnown --> Reduce: fit below current limit
+    CostKnown --> GrowWait: fit above current limit and CPU not overloaded
+    CostKnown --> HoldCurrent: fit not above current, or CPU overloaded
+    GrowWait --> IncreaseOne: healthy headroom persists for growth hold
+    GrowWait --> HoldCurrent: next sample breaks health or continuity
+    Calibrate --> IncreaseOne: healthy calibration interval elapsed
+    Calibrate --> HoldCurrent: health condition breaks
+    Reduce --> [*]: target no higher than running count
+    HoldRunning --> [*]: target is running count
+    HoldCurrent --> [*]: preserve safe current/running limit
+    IncreaseOne --> [*]: target increases by one, never below running count
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| Sample | Emergency pressure is incomplete | `pressure` indicates critical level and sample is incomplete | Clear healthy/overload continuity and target the known running count. |
+| Sample | Other incomplete sample | CPU/load data exists but full resource data is missing | Use CPU-only sustained-overload check; hold when not sustained. |
+| Measure | Complete resource sample | Machine capacity and pressure validate | Smooth load and available memory; update measured costs only from a complete matching process census. |
+| Measure | Unsafe pressure or exhausted headroom | Pressure, sustained overload, or memory headroom is zero | Target running count and reset healthy-growth timer. |
+| Measure | Census incomplete | No safe full cost/capacity comparison | Hold; missing process costs are not treated as zero. |
+| CostKnown | Capacity fits fewer workers | Fit is below current limit | Reduce target to fit. |
+| CostKnown | Capacity has durable spare headroom | Fit exceeds current and CPU is not overloaded | Wait through growth hold, then increase one. |
+| Calibrate | No workers and no learned cost | Current and running are zero, healthy CPU headroom exists | After growth hold, set one calibration probe. |
+
+The tick applies a computed target only after checking the live limit again,
+clamping it to the current running count, writing it, and verifying readback.
+See [service control](board-governor-service.md) for the LaunchAgent lifecycle.

+# Board governor service control
+
+The governor is a LaunchAgent that runs one tick every 60 seconds. Installing
+the files does not start the service; `resume` bootstraps it.
+
+**Code owners:** [`install`](../../runtime/codex/scripts/board_governor.py#L253)
+and CLI actions in
+[`main`](../../runtime/codex/scripts/board_governor.py#L365).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> Absent
+    Absent --> Installed: install on macOS with expected heavy helper / copy code and write plist
+    Installed --> Running: resume / enable label and bootstrap LaunchAgent
+    Running --> Running: scheduled interval / execute one governor tick
+    Running --> Paused: pause / disable label and bootout job
+    Paused --> Running: resume / enable and bootstrap job
+    Installed --> Installed: status / report launchctl state
+    Running --> Running: status / report launchctl state
+    Paused --> Paused: status / report launchctl state
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| Absent | `install` | macOS and expected `heavy` helper are present | Copy governor code/config as needed and write a LaunchAgent plist with `StartInterval: 60`; leave it stopped. |
+| Installed or Paused | `resume` | LaunchAgent can be enabled and bootstrapped | Start repeating 60-second ticks. |
+| Running | Scheduled tick | LaunchAgent remains loaded | Run the single-tick decision and apply path. |
+| Running | `pause` | LaunchAgent commands succeed | Disable and unload job; leave the last board limit unchanged. |
+| Any installed state | `status` | `launchctl print` succeeds | Report launchd's current service state. |
+
+`simulate` and `verify-board` are separate diagnostic commands; they do not
+belong to this live service lifecycle.

+# Braintrust session and turn tracing
+
+The active plugin hooks share per-session state. SessionStart creates a root
+span; prompts create turn spans; tool events attach tool spans; Stop parses
+new transcript lines and closes the turn; SessionEnd closes any leftover turn
+and logs session completion.
+
+**Code owners:** hook registration in
+[`claude/settings.json`](../../claude/settings.json#L72), per-session JSON
+helpers in [`common.sh`](../../claude/plugins/braintrust-tracing/hooks/common.sh#L42),
+and active event handlers:
+[`session_start.sh`](../../claude/plugins/braintrust-tracing/hooks/session_start.sh#L20),
+[`user_prompt_submit.sh`](../../claude/plugins/braintrust-tracing/hooks/user_prompt_submit.sh#L80),
+[`post_tool_use.sh`](../../claude/plugins/braintrust-tracing/hooks/post_tool_use.sh#L44),
+[`stop_hook.sh`](../../claude/plugins/braintrust-tracing/hooks/stop_hook.sh#L44),
+[`session_end.sh`](../../claude/plugins/braintrust-tracing/hooks/session_end.sh#L20).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> NoRoot
+    NoRoot --> RootReady: SessionStart / create root and persist project/session IDs
+    NoRoot --> RootReady: UserPromptSubmit / create root if absent
+    RootReady --> TurnOpen: UserPromptSubmit / create turn span and reset turn counters
+    TurnOpen --> TurnOpen: PostToolUse with current turn / create child tool span
+    TurnOpen --> TurnClosed: Stop with transcript / create LLM spans, finalize turn, save cursor
+    TurnOpen --> TurnClosed: next prompt arrives before prior Stop / reconcile prior turn first
+    TurnOpen --> SessionEnded: SessionEnd / finalize open turn, log session, launch learning extraction
+    TurnClosed --> TurnOpen: next UserPromptSubmit / increment turn count and create next turn
+    TurnClosed --> SessionEnded: SessionEnd / log session and launch learning extraction
+    SessionEnded --> [*]
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| NoRoot | SessionStart | Tracing enabled and requirements available; no root ID exists | Create root span and save root/project IDs and counters. |
+| NoRoot or RootReady | User prompt submitted | Session and project context available | Create root if needed; close a still-open prior turn; create new turn span and reset tool count. |
+| TurnOpen | Tool completes | Current turn and project IDs exist | Create a child tool span and increment tool counter. |
+| TurnOpen | Stop event | Current turn and transcript exist | Process transcript after `turn_last_line`, emit LLM spans, finalize turn, set new cursor and clear current turn ID. |
+| TurnOpen | Stop event | No current turn or transcript | Log/skip; persisted turn can remain open for later reconciliation. |
+| TurnOpen | SessionEnd | Root/project exist | Finalize open turn, clear current turn ID, log session summary, and start learning extraction in background. |
+| Any state | Tracing disabled or requirements missing | Hook setup check fails | Return without blocking Claude. |
+
+The transcript cursor and turn ID are durable, but the hooks do not use a
+transaction across remote span writes and local state updates. SessionEnd and
+the next prompt provide reconciliation for an open turn.

+# Claude PreCompact continuity writer
+
+This is the TypeScript PreCompact hook invoked by
+`pre-compact-continuity.sh`. It loads the newest continuity ledger, and on
+automatic compaction may write a handoff or append a short summary.
+
+**Code owners:** registered hook in
+[`claude/settings.json`](../../claude/settings.json#L58), wrapper
+[`pre-compact-continuity.sh`](../../claude/hooks/pre-compact-continuity.sh),
+and [`main`](../../claude/hooks/src/pre-compact-continuity.ts#L18).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> FindLedger
+    FindLedger --> Reminder: no continuity ledger / continue with reminder
+    FindLedger --> AutoTranscript: trigger=auto and transcript exists
+    FindLedger --> AutoFallback: trigger=auto and transcript missing
+    FindLedger --> ManualReminder: trigger is not auto
+    AutoTranscript --> Handoff: parse transcript / write timestamped auto-handoff
+    Handoff --> SummaryAppend: generated summary is non-empty
+    Handoff --> Done: no brief summary available
+    AutoFallback --> SummaryAppend: generated summary is non-empty
+    AutoFallback --> Done: summary unavailable
+    SummaryAppend --> Done: append summary to newest ledger
+    Reminder --> [*]
+    ManualReminder --> [*]
+    Done --> [*]: return continue=true
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| FindLedger | PreCompact event arrives | No ledger exists | Return `continue: true` with a create-ledger reminder. |
+| FindLedger | Trigger is `auto` | Transcript path exists | Parse transcript, write timestamped handoff, then append summary if available. |
+| FindLedger | Trigger is `auto` | Transcript absent | Try legacy summary and append when non-empty. |
+| FindLedger | Trigger is manual | Ledger exists | Return reminder to update ledger; do not block compaction. |
+
+`claude/settings.json` also registers the separate v4.7 writer for this same
+event; see [v4.7 pre-compact writer](claude-precompact-v47.md). Both active
+handlers can emit their own message and handoff file.
+
+The [shared handoff-base resolver](../../claude/hooks/src/shared/project-state.ts#L20)
+puts automatic handoffs under `$TMPDIR/thoughts/shared/handoffs` when both
+`HERDR_PROJECTS_ID` and `TMPDIR` are set, otherwise under the project.
+[Summary generation](../../claude/hooks/src/pre-compact-continuity.ts#L100)
+reads edited-file history from `${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/claude-tsc-cache/<session>`.
+Legacy continuity ledgers remain under `<project>/thoughts/ledgers`.

+# Claude v4.7 PreCompact writer
+
+The v4.7 hook is independently registered alongside the continuity hook. It
+writes a timestamped handoff from a transcript, or tells the user when it
+cannot.
+
+**Code owners:** registration in
+[`claude/settings.json`](../../claude/settings.json#L58) and
+[`main`](../../claude/hooks/v4.7/pre-compact.mjs#L156).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> ReadInput
+    ReadInput --> WriteHandoff: trigger=auto and transcript path exists
+    ReadInput --> NoTranscript: trigger=auto and transcript path absent
+    ReadInput --> ManualReminder: trigger is not auto
+    WriteHandoff --> Done: create session directory and timestamped file
+    NoTranscript --> Done: return manual-handoff suggestion
+    ManualReminder --> Done: return pre-compact reminder
+    Done --> [*]: continue=true
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| ReadInput | Automatic compaction | Transcript path exists | Parse transcript and write `auto-handoff-<timestamp>.md`. |
+| ReadInput | Automatic compaction | No transcript path or path missing | Return a message suggesting manual handoff. |
+| ReadInput | Manual compaction | Any transcript state | Return reminder to run `/create_handoff`. |
+| Done | Hook output emitted | All paths | Return `continue: true`; this hook does not block compaction. |

+uses `$TMPDIR/thoughts/shared/handoffs` when both `HERDR_PROJECTS_ID` and
+`TMPDIR` are set, otherwise the project directory. The output message names
+the resolved directory where the handoff was written.

+# Claude session-end cleanup and extractor launcher
+
+The SessionEnd hook updates the newest continuity ledger, removes old agent
+cache outputs, and optionally launches a detached Braintrust learning
+extractor. A PID/timestamp lock suppresses a second live extractor.
+
+**Code owners:** registration in
+[`claude/settings.json`](../../claude/settings.json#L251),
+lock handling in [`isExtractorRunning`](../../claude/hooks/src/session-end-cleanup.ts#L20),
+and launch flow in [`main`](../../claude/hooks/src/session-end-cleanup.ts#L68).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> UpdateLocalState
+    UpdateLocalState --> Done: no Braintrust API key
+    UpdateLocalState --> Done: analyzer script unavailable
+    UpdateLocalState --> SkipExisting: fresh lock PID is alive
+    UpdateLocalState --> Launch: no lock, malformed lock, dead PID, or stale lock
+    Launch --> Detached: spawn uv process and write PID/timestamp lock
+    Launch --> Done: spawn has no PID or launch setup fails
+    Detached --> Done: hook returns without waiting for child
+    SkipExisting --> Done: existing extractor is expected to process recent sessions
+    Done --> [*]: SessionEnd remains non-blocking
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| UpdateLocalState | Session ends | Continuity ledger exists | Update timestamp and prune agent output files older than seven days. |
+| UpdateLocalState | Braintrust key absent | No extraction can authenticate | Return without launching extractor. |
+| UpdateLocalState | Analyzer missing | Neither project nor global script exists | Return. |
+| UpdateLocalState | Lock exists | PID is alive and lock younger than five minutes | Skip duplicate extraction. |
+| UpdateLocalState | Lock is stale or unreadable | Age exceeds five minutes, PID is dead, or contents cannot be parsed | Remove lock and continue to launch. |
+| Launch | Analyzer available | `uv` process starts | Spawn detached process, write PID/time lock, unref child, and return. |
+| Any state | Local work fails | SessionEnd wrapper catches error | Return `continue`; session end is not blocked. |
+
+The child does not remove the lock in this module. A later invocation clears it
+when the process has ended or the five-minute age limit is exceeded.

+# Claude continuity session-start loader
+
+The registered matcher is `resume|compact|clear`. The hook first searches
+handoffs for an embedded `## Ledger` section. It checks legacy ledger files
+only when that search did not select a Ledger. Startup is implemented but is
+not included in the repository matcher.
+
+Code owners: [registration](../../claude/settings.json#L87),
+[main and handoff scan](../../claude/hooks/src/session-start-continuity.ts#L284),
+[newest file per session directory](../../claude/hooks/src/session-start-continuity.ts#L125),
+[legacy fallback](../../claude/hooks/src/session-start-continuity.ts#L385),
+and [output](../../claude/hooks/src/session-start-continuity.ts#L511).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> ScanHandoffs
+    ScanHandoffs --> HandoffSelected: newest file in each session directory inspected; newest candidate containing Ledger wins
+    ScanHandoffs --> LegacyLookup: no eligible Ledger, missing handoff base, or scan error before selection
+    HandoffSelected --> StartupNotice: startup / availability message only
+    HandoffSelected --> ResumeNotice: resume / goal and focus message only
+    HandoffSelected --> HandoffContext: compact or clear / full extracted Ledger and full file path
+    LegacyLookup --> Silent: legacy directory absent / continue without context
+    LegacyLookup --> Silent: directory has no matching ledger and startup
+    LegacyLookup --> Reminder: directory has no matching ledger and not startup
+    LegacyLookup --> PruneLegacy: matching ledger exists / choose newest by mtime
+    PruneLegacy --> StartupNotice: startup / availability and optional latest handoff summary
+    PruneLegacy --> ResumeNotice: resume / goal and focus message only
+    PruneLegacy --> LegacyContext: compact or clear / full legacy ledger and optional handoff preview
+    HandoffContext --> ContextReady: optional unmarked-outcome notice
+    LegacyContext --> ContextReady: optional unmarked-outcome notice and handoff list
+    StartupNotice --> [*]
+    ResumeNotice --> [*]
+    Silent --> [*]
+    Reminder --> [*]
+    ContextReady --> [*]: emit SessionStart additionalContext
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| ScanHandoffs | Session starts | `source` is truthy, otherwise legacy `type` | Resolve event type and scan `getAutoHandoffsBase(projectDir)`. |
+| ScanHandoffs | Inspect session subdirectories | Newest `.md` file in a directory contains `## Ledger` | Among those candidates, select the greatest file mtime. Older files in the same directory are not searched when its newest file lacks a Ledger. |
+| HandoffSelected | Compact or clear | An embedded Ledger was selected | Inject the entire extracted Ledger section, optional unmarked outcomes, and full handoff path. This branch has no 2000-character cap and needs no `thoughts/ledgers` directory. |
+| HandoffSelected | Startup or resume | Embedded Ledger selected | Startup gives an availability notice; resume gives the selected filename, goal and focus. Neither injects additional context. |
+| LegacyLookup | No selected handoff Ledger | Legacy directory absent | Emit only `result: continue`, for every event type. |
+| LegacyLookup | Legacy directory exists | No `CONTINUITY_CLAUDE-*.md` file | Non-startup events get a create-ledger reminder; startup stays silent. |
+| PruneLegacy | Matching legacy files exist | Select newest by mtime | Remove Session Ended entries and retain the last ten agent reports before reading the ledger. |
+| LegacyContext | Compact or clear | A legacy ledger exists | Inject the full legacy ledger. Optionally append unmarked outcomes and the latest task/auto-handoff; only that appended handoff is truncated to its first 2000 characters, followed by a truncation notice. List other handoffs when present. |
+| PruneLegacy | Startup or resume | Legacy ledger selected | Return availability or goal/focus message without additional context. |
+| ContextReady | Emit output | Context is non-empty | Set `hookSpecificOutput.hookEventName: SessionStart` and `additionalContext`; messages populate both `message` and `systemMessage`. |
+
+[Handoff-base resolution](../../claude/hooks/src/shared/project-state.ts#L20)
+uses `$TMPDIR/thoughts/shared/handoffs` when both `HERDR_PROJECTS_ID` and
+`TMPDIR` are set, otherwise the project directory. Legacy ledgers always
+remain under `<project>/thoughts/ledgers`. A scan exception warns and falls
+back when no handoff Ledger has been selected. Other uncaught failures reach
+the final `main().catch(console.error)` handler; the chart does not promise
+context on filesystem or input errors.

+# Claude protected-config stop guardian
+
+The active Stop hook blocks exit when configured linter files have changed,
+unless the session is already continuing after a block or the content hashes
+match a prior user approval.
+
+**Code owners:** registration in
+[`claude/settings.json`](../../claude/settings.json#L217),
+[`plankton-stop-guardian.sh`](../../claude/hooks/plankton-stop-guardian.sh#L17),
+and approval hash writer
+[`plankton-approve-configs.sh`](../../claude/hooks/plankton-approve-configs.sh#L18).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> Inspect
+    Inspect --> Approved: stop_hook_active=true
+    Inspect --> Approved: no protected file changed
+    Inspect --> Approved: every changed file hash matches guard
+    Inspect --> Blocked: changed file hash differs / remove stale guard
+    Inspect --> Blocked: changed protected file and no guard
+    Blocked --> Approved: user chooses Keep and approval helper writes current hashes
+    Blocked --> Approved: user restores files and next Stop finds no changes
+    Blocked --> Blocked: user asks to see diff / another decision still required
+    Approved --> [*]
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| Inspect | Stop hook runs | `stop_hook_active` is true | Approve to prevent an infinite block loop. |
+| Inspect | Protected file scan | No unstaged or staged changes | Approve session end. |
+| Inspect | Guard file found | Every changed file's SHA-256 matches stored hash | Approve session end. |
+| Inspect | Guard file found | Any hash differs | Remove stale approval and block for a new user decision. |
+| Inspect | Protected files changed | No matching approval | Block and request Keep, Restore, or Show diff. |
+| Blocked | User chooses Keep | Approval helper called with file list | Write current hashes; next Stop can approve only while content remains identical. |
+| Blocked | User restores files | Changes disappear | Next Stop approves. |
+
+The approval file is scoped by the hook guard PID and stores hashes, not a
+permanent approval for future content.

+# Claude context handoff stop gate
+
+This active Stop hook reads the context percentage written by the status
+display. It blocks only at the configured threshold and returns no decision
+when the value is missing.
+
+**Code owners:** registration in
+[`claude/settings.json`](../../claude/settings.json#L234) and
+[`auto-handoff-stop.mjs`](../../claude/hooks/v4.7/auto-handoff-stop.mjs#L20).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> ReadStop
+    ReadStop --> Allow: stop_hook_active is true
+    ReadStop --> Allow: context file absent/unreadable or pct < 85
+    ReadStop --> Block: context pct >= 85 / suggest create_handoff
+    Allow --> [*]
+    Block --> [*]
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| ReadStop | Stop hook runs | Stop hook already active | Emit empty output and allow continuation. |
+| ReadStop | Session context resolved | Context file absent, unreadable, unparsable, or below 85% | Emit empty output; do not block. |
+| ReadStop | Session context resolved | Percentage is at least 85% | Return block decision with `/create_handoff` suggestion. |
