+# Claude web-search backend retries
+
+The Claude-side copy has its own backend and cache implementation. Its
+per-backend retry loop makes one retry after empty results or an exception;
+later enabled backends are tried in order.
+
+**Code owners:** retry helper
+[`call_backend`](../../claude/scripts/web-search.py#L354) and selection in
+[`search`](../../claude/scripts/web-search.py#L425).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> CacheLookup
+    CacheLookup --> Cached: fresh valid cache and cache enabled
+    CacheLookup --> BackendOne: cache miss or --no-cache
+    BackendOne --> Results: backend returns results
+    BackendOne --> Wait: empty result or exception on attempt one
+    Wait --> BackendTwo: randomized 0.4-1.2s delay
+    BackendTwo --> Results: backend returns results
+    BackendTwo --> NextBackend: empty result or exception
+    NextBackend --> Results: a later backend returns results
+    NextBackend --> Empty: all configured backends exhausted
+    Results --> Enrich: reader option enabled
+    Results --> Done: reader option disabled
+    Enrich --> Done: page fetch completes or fails
+    Cached --> Done
+    Empty --> Done
+    Done --> [*]
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| CacheLookup | Query starts | Cache enabled and entry is fresh/valid | Return cached results and backend. |
+| CacheLookup | Cache miss or bypass | Query needs live search | Try enabled backends in order. |
+| BackendOne | Backend call | Results non-empty | Return results and optionally cache them. |
+| BackendOne | Backend call | Empty result or exception | Wait a random 0.4–1.2 seconds, then call same backend once more. |
+| BackendTwo | Second attempt ends empty or throws | Another backend remains | Continue with next backend. |
+| Results | Search succeeded | `--reader` enabled | Fetch selected pages concurrently; per-page failures are ignored. |
+| NextBackend | No backend remains | Every backend produced no results | Return empty list. |
+
+This is a separate owner from
+[runtime web-search](runtime-web-search.md); checked-in copies can drift.

+# Daily session review
+
+The scheduled review runner locks a run, builds a session digest, asks an
+agent to prepare changes in a worktree, then either stops without publishing,
+advances the cutoff when no change exists, or creates a PR and may auto-merge
+documentation-only changes.
+
+**Code owner:** lock and digest flow in
+[`run-daily-review.sh`](../../runtime/codex/skills/llmwiki-daily-review/scripts/run-daily-review.sh#L33),
+with publish decisions beginning at [line 132](../../runtime/codex/skills/llmwiki-daily-review/scripts/run-daily-review.sh#L132).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> Lock
+    Lock --> ExitBusy: another run holds lock
+    Lock --> Digest: lock acquired
+    Digest --> Done: no sessions in window
+    Digest --> Done: dry-run
+    Digest --> Prepare: sessions found and publish enabled
+    Prepare --> Worktree: fetch open review diffs and create review branch
+    Worktree --> ReviewBatches: run each batch
+    ReviewBatches --> FailedKept: any agent batch fails / keep worktree, do not advance cutoff
+    ReviewBatches --> KeptNoPublish: --no-publish / keep worktree, do not advance cutoff
+    ReviewBatches --> NoChanges: worktree clean
+    ReviewBatches --> Publish: worktree has changes
+    NoChanges --> Done: remove worktree/branch and advance cutoff
+    Publish --> PullRequest: commit, push, open PR and add batch comments
+    PullRequest --> AutoMerge: changed paths are documentation-only
+    PullRequest --> NeedsReview: protected paths changed
+    AutoMerge --> Done: merge and advance cutoff
+    NeedsReview --> Done: comment and advance cutoff
+    ExitBusy --> [*]
+    FailedKept --> [*]
+    KeptNoPublish --> [*]
+    Done --> [*]
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| Lock | Run starts | Lock directory cannot be created | Exit successfully without starting another run. |
+| Digest | Digest generated | No matching session or dry-run requested | Exit without worktree or cutoff update. |
+| Worktree | Open wiki review PRs collected | Digest has sessions and publishing is enabled | Fetch origin, record open PR diffs, and create a branch worktree. |
+| ReviewBatches | Agent fails | Any batch returns nonzero | Keep worktree, leave cutoff unchanged, exit failure. |
+| ReviewBatches | All batches finish | `--no-publish` | Keep worktree and report; do not commit, push, create PR, or advance cutoff. |
+| ReviewBatches | Worktree has no changes | Publishing enabled | Remove worktree/branch and advance cutoff. |
+| Publish | Worktree has changes | All batches succeed | Commit, push, open PR, and post additional batch comments. |
+| PullRequest | Changed paths are documentation-only | No path matches protected-path set | Merge PR, then advance cutoff. |
+| PullRequest | Protected paths changed | At least one path is outside documentation set | Leave PR open for review, then advance cutoff. |
+
+Failures before successful PR handling preserve the last-success cutoff so the
+same session window can be reviewed again. This scheduled automation was
+inspected but not run.

+# Direct worker circuit admission
+
+This is the persisted provider-health gate used by the direct worker
+supervisor. Missing state means a fresh circuit. Existing unreadable or
+malformed state, a non-object JSON value, or an unavailable lock refuses the
+request before dispatch.
+
+**Code owners:** [`locked_json`](../../runtime/codex/scripts/direct-codex-supervisor.py#L53),
+[`circuit_decision`](../../runtime/codex/scripts/direct-codex-supervisor.py#L73),
+[`record_circuit`](../../runtime/codex/scripts/direct-codex-supervisor.py#L108),
+and the supervisor admission call at
+[`main`](../../runtime/codex/scripts/direct-codex-supervisor.py#L381).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> Decide
+    Decide --> Refused: lock or existing state read/validation fails / exit 75, no dispatch
+    Decide --> Closed: file missing bootstraps {} or failure count below threshold
+    Decide --> Open: threshold reached and cooldown/probe window remains
+    Decide --> HalfOpen: cooldown elapsed and no live probe / persist probe_started_at
+    Closed --> Closed: successful run or non-provider failure / clear failure counters
+    Closed --> Open: qualifying global or model failure reaches threshold / persist opened_at
+    Open --> Open: cooldown active or probe already active / return retry_after
+    Open --> HalfOpen: cooldown elapsed and probe timed out or absent / set half_open
+    HalfOpen --> Closed: exact health-probe output or successful production run / clear timestamps
+    HalfOpen --> ProbeRejected: any non-exact or failed probe / refuse production dispatch
+    ProbeRejected --> Closed: non-counting class or affected entry below threshold / request remains refused
+    ProbeRejected --> Open: an affected entry was half-open or reaches its threshold / request remains refused
+    ProbeRejected --> HalfOpen: unclassified failure or failed state update / request remains refused
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| Decide | Supervisor starts | State file absent | `locked_json` supplies `{}` and admission begins closed. |
+| Decide | Read or lock fails | Existing JSON is malformed/non-object or filesystem/lock raises `OSError` | Return 75 before worker process launch. |
+| Closed | Provider result recorded | Success, worker-output failure, or non-counting failure class | Success resets counters; non-counting classes do not open the provider circuit. |
+| Closed | Provider result recorded | Global failure threshold is 1, or model threshold is reached | Record event and `opened_at`; state becomes open. |
+| Open | Admission checks time | Cooldown or half-open probe timeout remains | Refuse and report remaining retry time. |
+| Open | Admission checks time | Cooldown elapsed and no live probe | Mark half-open and record `probe_started_at`. |
+| Half-open | Health probe finishes | Output exactly matches the expected probe response | Record recovery, close circuit, then allow production dispatch. |
+| Half-open | Health probe finishes | Any other result | Refuse this request; persisted state depends on failure class and affected key. The global and model entries update separately. Non-counting `worker` or invalid-output classes record as success; a counted failure opens an entry only when its threshold is reached or that entry was half-open; an unclassified or unrecordable result may leave half-open state. |
+
+`--force` skips the admission decision for diagnostics. Setting
+`CODEX_WORKER_CIRCUIT=0` disables both circuit reads and updates. These are
+supervisor behaviors; `direct-codex-orchestrator.py` has a separate
+preselection read described in
+[direct worker orchestration](direct-worker-orchestration.md).
+
+The persisted global key and per-model key are independent. A rejected
+half-open probe always refuses this request, even when its failure class only
+adds a below-threshold count to another key and leaves effective admission
+closed for a later request.

@@ -0,0 +1,48 @@
+# Direct worker execution
+
+The supervisor owns the request from brief validation through process timeout,
+output validation, health recording, telemetry, and exit status.
+
+**Code owners:** [`run_codex`](../../runtime/codex/scripts/direct-codex-supervisor.py#L245),
+admission and probe branches in
+[`main`](../../runtime/codex/scripts/direct-codex-supervisor.py#L374), and the
+persisted circuit transitions in
+[`record_circuit`](../../runtime/codex/scripts/direct-codex-supervisor.py#L108).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> Validate
+    Validate --> Refused: blank brief / exit 2
+    Validate --> Admission: non-empty brief
+    Admission --> Refused: circuit state unavailable or open / exit 75, no production dispatch
+    Admission --> Probe: half_open decision
+    Admission --> Execute: closed, forced, or circuit disabled
+    Probe --> Refused: wrong output or probe failure / record probe, no production dispatch
+    Probe --> Execute: exact expected output / record recovery
+    Execute --> Success: process exits 0 with acceptable final text
+    Execute --> InvalidOutput: empty final text or short future-intent acknowledgement
+    Execute --> TimedOut: first event misses startup deadline or total deadline expires
+    Execute --> Failed: launch error or nonzero process result
+    Success --> [*]: record circuit and telemetry; exit 0
+    InvalidOutput --> [*]: record failure class and telemetry; exit 65
+    TimedOut --> [*]: terminate process group and record result
+    Failed --> [*]: classify and record result
+    Refused --> [*]
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| Validate | Brief read | Blank after trimming | Exit 2 before circuit access or dispatch. |
+| Admission | Circuit decision | State cannot be locked/read/validated, or state is open | Exit 75; do not launch the production worker. |
+| Probe | Probe process ends | Exact expected output and `status == ok` | Record circuit recovery; proceed to the requested production run. |
+| Probe | Probe process ends | Any other result | Record probe failure and telemetry with `production_dispatched: false`; exit 127 for launch failure, otherwise 75. |
+| Execute | Process polling | No first event by startup deadline | Kill process group; mark `startup_timeout`. |
+| Execute | Process polling | Total timeout expires | Kill process group; mark `timeout`. |
+| Execute | Process returns zero | Output empty, or short response matches future-intent pattern | Mark `invalid_output` with `empty_output` or `future_intent`. |
+| Execute | Process returns | Launch or nonzero failure | Classify failure; persist circuit result where enabled. |
+| Any terminal state | Finish | Telemetry append fails | Suppress telemetry write error; do not change the already determined result. |
+
+The probe is read-only and separate from the production brief. A missing
+provider-health file initializes the circuit; an existing corrupt or
+unavailable file is a refusal, as shown in
+[direct worker circuit admission](direct-worker-circuit.md).

+# Direct worker orchestration
+
+This runner validates and partitions a goal, chooses a primary or configured
+fallback worker, executes read-only chunks in parallel or workspace-write
+chunks in order, and reports aggregate completion.
+
+**Code owners:** [`circuit_is_open`](../../runtime/codex/scripts/direct-codex-orchestrator.py#L286),
+and orchestration flow in
+[`main`](../../runtime/codex/scripts/direct-codex-orchestrator.py#L306).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> Validate
+    Validate --> Refused: empty goal, invalid groups, or missing write groups
+    Validate --> Partition: valid goal and file arguments
+    Partition --> SelectWorker: explicit groups or balanced read-only chunks
+    SelectWorker --> Refused: primary appears open and no configured healthy fallback
+    SelectWorker --> DispatchPrimary: primary not marked open
+    SelectWorker --> DispatchFallback: primary marked open and fallback appears available
+    DispatchPrimary --> RunChunks: selection complete
+    DispatchFallback --> RunChunks: record fallback reason
+    RunChunks --> Aggregate: all chunks finish or shared deadline expires
+    Aggregate --> Complete: every chunk succeeds and no fallback was used
+    Aggregate --> Degraded: at least one chunk succeeds, or fallback was used
+    Aggregate --> Failed: no chunk succeeds
+    Complete --> [*]: append orchestration ledger when writable; exit 0
+    Degraded --> [*]: emit per-chunk report; exit 0 if any chunk succeeded
+    Failed --> [*]: emit failure report; exit 1
+    Refused --> [*]: exit 64 or 75
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| Validate | Arguments and stdin read | Empty goal | Exit 2. |
+| Validate | Chunk options checked | `workspace-write` without explicit non-overlapping groups, or invalid chunk specification | Exit 64 before child launches. |
+| Partition | Files assigned to chunks | Explicit groups supplied | Use those groups; otherwise use bounded balanced chunks. |
+| SelectWorker | Primary circuit precheck | Primary marked open and configured fallback is not marked open | Refuse with exit 75. |
+| SelectWorker | Primary circuit precheck | Primary marked open and fallback options are complete and fallback is not marked open | Select fallback and label result degraded. |
+| RunChunks | Sandbox is `read-only` | Chunks remain and deadline is live | Run up to the clamped parallelism limit of three. |
+| RunChunks | Sandbox is `workspace-write` | Chunks remain and deadline is live | Run explicit chunks sequentially. |
+| RunChunks | Deadline expires before launch | Chunk remains | Record that chunk as timed out without dispatch. |
+| Aggregate | All results return | Any success | Store per-run and chunk summary; status is `ok`, `degraded`, or `failed`. |
+
+`circuit_is_open` is a routing precheck. It returns false when reading or
+parsing provider state raises `OSError` or `ValueError`; it is not the final
+admission decision. Each selected child goes through the direct supervisor,
+which enforces persisted circuit admission before production dispatch. Treat
+the preselector's read-only gap as a next-run follow-up, not as a confirmed
+dispatch bypass.

+# Fable chunk orchestration
+
+The orchestrator slices source into bounded prompts, runs chunks under one
+shared deadline, and reports success per chunk and for the whole run.
+
+**Code owners:** [`run_chunk`](../../runtime/codex/scripts/fable-orchestrator.py#L96)
+and [`main`](../../runtime/codex/scripts/fable-orchestrator.py#L153).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> BuildChunks
+    BuildChunks --> Refused: source or chunk construction error / exit 64
+    BuildChunks --> Dispatch: all prompts fit the per-chunk cap
+    Dispatch --> Running: launch up to three chunks under shared deadline
+    Running --> Collect: child exits with text, fails, or times out
+    Collect --> Aggregate: all futures return
+    Aggregate --> Succeeded: every chunk has non-empty successful output
+    Aggregate --> Degraded: some chunks succeed
+    Aggregate --> Failed: no chunk succeeds
+    Succeeded --> [*]: print ordered results; exit 0
+    Degraded --> [*]: print successes and failures; exit 0
+    Failed --> [*]: print failures; exit 1
+    Refused --> [*]
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| BuildChunks | Goal and source paths loaded | Read, split, or chunk construction raises `OSError` or `ValueError` | Print error and exit 64. |
+| BuildChunks | Prompts assembled | Any prompt exceeds `--max-context-chars` | Refuse before launching children. |
+| Dispatch | Chunks ready | Any valid chunk set | Clamp parallelism to `1..3` and give each child the same deadline. |
+| Running | Child result | Deadline already spent or `communicate` times out | Mark that chunk failed with deadline exhausted; timeout path terminates its process group. |
+| Running | Child exits | Return code is zero and stdout is non-empty | Mark chunk successful. |
+| Aggregate | All results collected | Success count equals total | Status `ok`, exit 0. |
+| Aggregate | All results collected | Some, but not all, succeed | Status `degraded`, exit 0. |
+| Aggregate | All results collected | No chunk succeeds | Status `failed`, exit 1. |
+
+The orchestrator's aggregate exit code is zero when at least one chunk succeeds;
+consumers that need complete coverage must inspect the printed per-chunk
+results, not only the exit code.

+# Fable endpoint request
+
+The Fable worker tries configured VibeProxy endpoints in order under one total
+request deadline. This is separate from the chunk scheduler in
+[Fable orchestration](fable-orchestration.md).
+
+**Code owner:** [`run_chat_request`](../../runtime/codex/scripts/fable-worker.sh#L198)
+and response validation at
+[`fable-worker.sh`](../../runtime/codex/scripts/fable-worker.sh#L266).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> SelectEndpoint
+    SelectEndpoint --> Request: an endpoint remains and total deadline is live
+    SelectEndpoint --> Failed: deadline exhausted or no endpoints remain
+    Request --> Success: curl succeeds, HTTP 2xx, response non-empty
+    Request --> SelectEndpoint: endpoint fails and another endpoint remains
+    Request --> Failed: final endpoint fails
+    Success --> ValidateText: parse response
+    ValidateText --> Complete: text exists and finish reason is not length
+    ValidateText --> Failed: truncated response or no final text
+    Complete --> [*]: return response text
+    Failed --> [*]: return nonzero and print failure
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| SelectEndpoint | Request begins | Remaining total time is positive | Start the next configured endpoint; the first endpoint can have a shorter timeout cap. |
+| SelectEndpoint | Deadline check | Remaining time is zero or less | Return deadline error without another call. |
+| Request | HTTP response | Curl exit is zero, status is 2xx, body is non-empty | Return body to response validation. |
+| Request | Endpoint failure | Another configured endpoint remains | Record a warning and try that endpoint within remaining time. |
+| Request | Final endpoint failure | No configured endpoint remains | Return the last failure code. |
+| ValidateText | Parsed response | `finish_reason == length` or extracted text is empty | Exit 1; do not present truncated or absent text as a result. |
+| ValidateText | Parsed response | Non-empty text and not truncated | Print response and exit successfully. |
+
+The code iterates endpoints; it does not retry each endpoint independently.

@@ -0,0 +1,57 @@
+# Fusion execution
+
+Fusion owns a run-level lifecycle: preflight, optional single-worker bypass,
+cache reuse, panel work, quorum, judge and synthesis, then persisted run
+metadata. Panel workers and fallbacks are nested operations inside the run.
+
+**Code owner:** [`main`](../../runtime/codex/scripts/fusion.py#L2749), with
+preflight beginning at [line 2875](../../runtime/codex/scripts/fusion.py#L2875),
+dispatch at [line 2992](../../runtime/codex/scripts/fusion.py#L2992),
+cache handling at [line 3069](../../runtime/codex/scripts/fusion.py#L3069),
+and aggregation at [line 3169](../../runtime/codex/scripts/fusion.py#L3169).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> Initializing
+    Initializing --> Blocked: missing required context or secret-like input
+    Initializing --> Decompose: scope exceeds safe cap and override is absent
+    Initializing --> Running: preflight passes / set shared deadline and run metadata
+    Running --> Bypass: FUSION_BYPASS=1 and one prompt chunk
+    Running --> CacheHit: valid run cache hit
+    Running --> Panel: cache miss
+    Bypass --> Complete: primary succeeds or allowed fallback succeeds
+    Bypass --> Failed: all permitted dispatches fail
+    CacheHit --> Complete: reuse validated cached panel/judge/synth result
+    Panel --> QuorumMet: successful panel count reaches required quorum
+    Panel --> QuorumMissed: quorum not reached / skip judge and synthesis
+    QuorumMet --> Judge: judge configured
+    QuorumMet --> Complete: no judge configured and single JSON result qualifies
+    Judge --> Synthesize: valid judgment and synth configured
+    Judge --> Complete: valid judgment, no synth configured
+    Judge --> Failed: judge result invalid after permitted fallback
+    Synthesize --> Complete: synth succeeds
+    Synthesize --> Degraded: synth fails; final answer omitted
+    QuorumMissed --> Degraded: preserve partial results
+    Complete --> [*]: log ok/degraded and return
+    Degraded --> [*]: log partial result and return failure where quorum/judge contract fails
+    Failed --> [*]: log failed
+    Blocked --> [*]: log blocked; exit 2
+    Decompose --> [*]: emit decomposition plan; exit 64
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| Initializing | Context rendered | Required file missing or invalid | Log `blocked` preflight and refuse. |
+| Initializing | Prompt scanned | Secret-like material found and explicit allowance absent | Log `blocked`; refuse before provider dispatch. |
+| Initializing | Scope measured | Above mode cap and large-scope override absent | Log `needs_decomposition`, emit plan, exit 64. |
+| Running | Bypass selected | `FUSION_BYPASS=1` and exactly one chunk | Dispatch primary; use fallback only when configured and failure class permits. |
+| Running | Cache lookup | Cache entry fails current quality contract | Ignore it and continue as cache miss. |
+| Panel | Workers finish | Successful panel count below quorum | Preserve partial outputs; skip judge and synthesis. |
+| Panel | Workers finish | Quorum reached | Continue to judge when configured. |
+| Judge | Primary judge fails or returns invalid analysis | Different fallback exists and failure class permits cross-provider fallback | Retry judge with fallback. |
+| Judge | Judgment valid | Synthesis configured and quorum remains met | Run final writer. |
+| Any running state | Keyboard interrupt | Interrupt reaches entrypoint | Append `interrupted` run record and exit 130. |
+
+`degraded` records incomplete context, missing quorum, partial panel results,
+or recovery. A failed exit can still preserve partial answers; do not infer
+success from emitted text alone.

+# GLM API request retries
+
+This is the GLM worker's own HTTP retry loop.
+
+**Code owner:** [`glm-worker.sh`](../../runtime/codex/scripts/glm-worker.sh#L159).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> Request
+    Request --> RetryWait: retryable transport/status/body failure and attempt <= RETRIES
+    Request --> Interpret: successful HTTP response or non-retryable response
+    RetryWait --> Request: delay expires / exponential delay capped at RETRY_MAX_DELAY
+    Interpret --> Complete: response contains usable final text
+    Interpret --> Failed: curl/HTTP/provider error, truncated or unusable output
+    Complete --> [*]
+    Failed --> [*]
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| Request | Curl and provider response collected | Retryable transport, HTTP status, or provider message and `attempt <= RETRIES` | Sleep, double delay up to its configured cap, then request again. |
+| Request | Response collected | Non-retryable failure or retries exhausted | Leave retry loop and report failure. |
+| Request | 2xx response collected | Provider body has a retryable error message and retry budget remains | Retry using the same bounded backoff. |
+| Interpret | Response parsed | Content passes worker output checks | Emit content and exit 0. |
+| Interpret | Response parsed | API error, truncation, or invalid output | Emit error and exit nonzero. |
+
+With the default retry count of three, the loop permits up to four total
+requests: the initial attempt plus three retries. The retry classifier and
+backoff settings belong to this script.

+# Claude handoff metadata and indexing
+
+The active PostToolUse Write hook recognizes handoff Markdown, adds available
+Braintrust identifiers, records terminal-to-session affinity, then launches
+the single-file artifact indexer asynchronously. Metadata and affinity errors
+do not block the hook; indexing can finish after the hook returns.
+
+**Code owners:** registration in
+[`claude/settings.json`](../../claude/settings.json#L177), wrapper
+[`handoff-index.sh`](../../claude/hooks/handoff-index.sh#L1), transition logic
+in [`handoff-index.ts`](../../claude/hooks/src/handoff-index.ts#L132), and
+the hook's indexer mode in
+[`artifact_index.py`](../../claude/scripts/artifact_index.py#L432).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> InspectEvent
+    InspectEvent --> Continue: tool is not Write / path is not handoff Markdown / file absent
+    InspectEvent --> EnrichMetadata: existing handoff file
+    EnrichMetadata --> EnrichMetadata: Braintrust state absent, invalid, or already linked
+    EnrichMetadata --> RecordAffinity: metadata added atomically or skipped
+    RecordAffinity --> LaunchIndexer: terminal PID and session name available or unavailable
+    LaunchIndexer --> Continue: index script missing or launch fails
+    LaunchIndexer --> Indexing: detached single-file index child starts
+    Indexing --> Indexed: database schema ready and upsert succeeds
+    Indexing --> IndexFailed: child returns failure
+    Continue --> [*]: hook returns continue
+    Indexed --> [*]
+    IndexFailed --> [*]: hook has already returned continue
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| InspectEvent | PostToolUse arrives | Tool is not Write, target is not a handoff `.md`, or file is absent | Return `continue` without indexing. |
+| EnrichMetadata | Handoff file exists | `root_span_id` is absent and Braintrust state parses | Add root span, turn span, and session ID through temp-file rename. |
+| EnrichMetadata | State unavailable, invalid, or metadata already present | Any condition prevents safe enrichment | Leave content as is and continue. |
+| RecordAffinity | Handoff session name and terminal shell PID are known | SQLite is writable | Upsert terminal PID to session name with current timestamp. |
+| LaunchIndexer | Handoff file resolved | Project `scripts/artifact_index.py` exists | Spawn detached `uv run python ... --file <handoff>` and return from hook. |
+| Indexing | Child handles the file | Schema initialization and file parse succeed | Upsert handoff data into the context database. |
+| Any hook step | An outer operation throws | Hook catches the error | Return `continue`; do not block the tool action. |
+| Indexing | Index script cannot parse or store the file | Single-file indexing returns failure | Child exits nonzero; hook already returned. |
+
+The indexer's bulk `--all` mode is a separate manual reindex path; this chart
+documents only the single-file path launched by the active hook.

+# Load backstop service lifecycle
+
+The service owns a nonblocking file lock while sampling and acting on jobs.
+Its persisted pressure/job machine is documented in
+[load backstop records](load-backstop.md).
+
+Code owners: [load state](../../runtime/codex/scripts/load_backstop.py#L451),
+[resume all](../../runtime/codex/scripts/load_backstop.py#L495),
+[loop and cleanup](../../runtime/codex/scripts/load_backstop.py#L530),
+[installation](../../runtime/codex/scripts/load_backstop.py#L602),
+and [CLI control](../../runtime/codex/scripts/load_backstop.py#L646).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> Installed: install / copy service and write LaunchAgent plist
+    Installed --> Sampling: resume / enable and bootstrap launchd service; acquire lock
+    [*] --> Sampling: run / acquire exclusive nonblocking lock
+    [*] --> Refused: run or once while lock is held
+    [*] --> TickOnce: once / acquire lock
+    TickOnce --> Exited: apply and persist one tick; no shutdown resume
+    Sampling --> Sampling: tick / load prior state, decide, signal, persist, wait interval
+    Sampling --> Cleanup: SIGTERM, SIGINT, tick exception, or service pause
+    Cleanup --> Exited: census succeeds / continue matching recorded and current descendants; reset state
+    Cleanup --> Failed: census fails or cleanup raises
+    Exited --> Sampling: next run / reload persisted state under lock
+    Failed --> Sampling: later run / reload surviving persisted state under lock
+    Refused --> [*]
+    Exited --> [*]
+    Failed --> [*]
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| Installed | `install` | macOS and valid config | Copy files into service home, create config if absent and write KeepAlive/RunAtLoad plist. Does not start the service. |
+| Sampling | `resume` or direct `run` | Config valid; service loop gets `load-backstop.lock` | Resume enables/bootstrap service. Direct run enters loop. Existing state is reread every tick, retaining timers and paused records across restarts. |
+| Refused | Lock acquisition | Another loop holds lock | Raise error without a tick. |
+| TickOnce | `once` | Lock acquired | Run one signal-applying tick and return. The continuous-loop cleanup block is not entered; paused records can remain. |
+| Sampling | Tick finishes | Stop event unset | Wait for remaining interval, at least 0.5 seconds. Tick exceptions enter cleanup through `finally`. |
+| Cleanup | SIGTERM/SIGINT or `pause` bootout | Loop is leaving | Ignore further stop signals, attempt `resume_all`, then log stop and release lock. `pause` disables the LaunchAgent before bootout. |
+| Cleanup | Process census succeeds | PID start matches recorded identity or discovered live job matches recorded key | Attempt SIGCONT for recorded survivors and discovered descendants, atomically reset paused/timer state and log counts/errors. Signal permission errors do not prevent state reset. |
+| Failed | Resume census fails | `ps` command fails | Raise before state reset; successful resumption is not guaranteed. |
+
+The separate `resume-all` command runs cleanup directly; `status` only reads
+state. `simulate` executes fixtures without installing a service or signalling
+processes. This task exercises simulation only. Service installation, live
+signals, lock contention and shutdown recovery are described from source,
+not claimed as exercised live behavior.

@@ -0,0 +1,63 @@
+# Load backstop pressure and job records
+
+The backstop keeps pressure timers and one paused record per job identity
+`root:start`. Global pressure and each job record change independently.
+The chart describes persisted decisions and attempted signals, not confirmed
+process suspension or exit.
+
+Code owners: [trip reasons](../../runtime/codex/scripts/load_backstop.py#L79),
+[recovery guard](../../runtime/codex/scripts/load_backstop.py#L103),
+[decide](../../runtime/codex/scripts/load_backstop.py#L119),
+[signal application](../../runtime/codex/scripts/load_backstop.py#L432),
+and [tick persistence](../../runtime/codex/scripts/load_backstop.py#L456).
+See [service lifecycle](load-backstop-service.md) for restart and shutdown.
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    state Monitoring {
+        state Pressure {
+            [*] --> Clear
+            Clear --> Tripped: any trip reason / set trip_since
+            Tripped --> Tripped: trip continues / reset recovery timer; track continuous memory pressure
+            Tripped --> ClearHold: no trip reasons and recovered / set clear_since
+            ClearHold --> Tripped: trip returns or recovery guard fails / reset clear_since
+            ClearHold --> Clear: recovery held for clear_hold_seconds / remove trip timers
+        }
+        --
+        state JobRecord {
+            [*] --> Running
+            Running --> PauseRecorded: tripped and pause interval elapsed / newest running job first
+            PauseRecorded --> PauseRecorded: new descendants discovered / stop_new and record start identities
+            PauseRecorded --> TermRequested: no running jobs; memory hold elapsed; no pending term / newest eligible paused job
+            TermRequested --> KillRequested: still tripped and kill grace elapsed
+            PauseRecorded --> Running: clear and resume interval elapsed / oldest eligible paused job first
+            PauseRecorded --> Dropped: job root no longer discovered / continue surviving recorded PIDs
+            TermRequested --> Dropped: job root no longer discovered
+            KillRequested --> Dropped: job root no longer discovered
+            Dropped --> [*]
+        }
+    }
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| Clear | Sample | Collector stalled, critical pressure, pressure with sufficient swap, load/core threshold, or uninterruptible-process threshold | Set `trip_since`, emit `trip`, discard `clear_since`. Memory reasons start or retain `memory_since`; other reasons discard it. |
+| Tripped | Sample without trip reasons | No stalled collector or memory trip, and load/core strictly below clear threshold | Start `clear_since`. Clear only after its hold duration; interrupted recovery resets the timer. |
+| Monitoring | Process census unavailable | `jobs is None` | Update pressure timers and return before changing any paused job record. |
+| Running | Tripped tick | Pause interval elapsed and at least one running job | Select greatest `(started, root)`, persist PID/start identities and `paused_at`, emit `pause`, update `last_pause`. |
+| PauseRecorded | Census changes | Recorded root remains live; new descendant identities appear | Add descendants to record and emit `stop_new`. If root disappears, emit `drop` for still-matching recorded identities and delete the record. |
+| PauseRecorded | Memory pressure persists | No running jobs, memory hold elapsed, and no term awaiting kill | Choose newest record without `term_at`; set `term_at`, reset memory timer, emit `term`. Load alone never enables this transition. |
+| TermRequested | Tripped tick | Kill grace elapsed and `kill_at` absent | Set `kill_at` and emit `kill`, even if the memory reason has since ceased but the trip remains active. |
+| PauseRecorded | Clear tick | Resume interval elapsed and record has no `term_at` | Choose least `(started, root)`, emit `resume`, delete paused record, set `last_resume`. Records with `term_at` are excluded from automatic resume. |
+| Apply | Actions computed | Action name | `pause`/`stop_new`: SIGSTOP children first. `resume`/`drop`: SIGCONT root first. `term`: SIGTERM then SIGCONT root first. `kill`: SIGKILL children first. PID 1 and the backstop itself are skipped. |
+| Persist | Signal attempts finish | Tick proceeds without an uncaught error | Atomically replace state, append action/error logs and periodic heartbeat. Permission errors are logged; a persisted record does not prove a signal succeeded. |
+
+The [checkout config](../../runtime/codex/scripts/load_backstop.json) sets
+load trip/clear thresholds to 3.0/1.5 per core, recovery hold to 60 seconds,
+pause/resume intervals to 10/30 seconds, memory termination hold to 120 seconds,
+and kill grace to 10 seconds. These are service policy values; this task's
+own load/core stop limit remains 1. Stored PID start identities protect
+recorded orphans from PID reuse. Newly discovered descendants come from the
+current census. [Simulation](../../runtime/codex/scripts/load_backstop.py#L560)
+runs the real `decide` function and checks fixture actions/PIDs without
+calling `apply` or signalling processes.

+# Looper generated runner
+
+The checked-in `run-loop.py` is a template rendered by `looper.py`. It records
+run and gate status in the generated workspace, then loops over delivery and
+review until pass or a configured stop condition.
+
+**Code owners:** [`run_gate`](../../runtime/codex/skills/looper/templates/run-loop.py#L415),
+[`run`](../../runtime/codex/skills/looper/templates/run-loop.py#L503), and
+template rendering in
+[`looper.py`](../../runtime/codex/skills/looper/scripts/looper.py#L724).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> Start
+    Start --> Plan: save running state and gather context
+    Plan --> PlanGate: plan artifact exists or is generated
+    PlanGate --> Delivery: plan checks pass
+    PlanGate --> RevisePlan: checks or verdict request revision
+    RevisePlan --> PlanGate: revised artifact saved
+    PlanGate --> Failed: no-progress stop or max revisions reached
+    Delivery --> DeliveryGate: write next delivery artifact
+    DeliveryGate --> Passed: gate has no remaining failures
+    DeliveryGate --> ReviseDelivery: checks or verdict request revision
+    ReviseDelivery --> DeliveryGate: revised artifact saved
+    DeliveryGate --> Failed: no-progress stop, budget, or max revisions reached
+    DeliveryGate --> Delivery: gate passes but next iteration remains
+    Passed --> [*]
+    Failed --> [*]
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| Start | Runner starts | Valid resolved spec | Persist `running`, log start, gather context. |
+| Plan | Plan artifact missing | Host can produce plan | Generate `plan.md`; then evaluate plan gate. |
+| Any gate | Criteria checked | Programmatic/human failures absent and policy yields pass | Persist gate-passed state and continue. |
+| Any gate | Criteria checked | Failures or judge says revise | Write review artifact and evaluate repeated-blocker signature. |
+| Any gate | Same failures repeat | Count reaches configured no-progress threshold | Stop as failed, unless `human_checkpoint` receives `continue`, which resets the count for one more revision. |
+| Any gate | Revision requested | Revision count remains below maximum | Ask host to revise artifact, persist revision state, and reevaluate. |
+| Any gate | Revision requested | Revision maximum reached | Persist failed state and stop. |
+| Any gate | Required remote-member consent absent | User does not grant consent | Runner stops before sending the member prompt. |
+| DeliveryGate | Delivery passes | Pass verdict returned | Persist `passed`, name final delivery, exit 0. |
+| DeliveryGate | Iteration ends without pass | Maximum iterations reached | Persist `failed` with `max_iterations_reached`. |
+| Any active state | Wall-clock budget expires | Budget configured | Persist failure and stop. |
+
+Generated runner copies can diverge from this template. The interactive
+current-session path is rendered as a prompt; this chart describes the durable
+Python runner only.

+# MiniMax API request retries
+
+This chart covers the retry loop in the MiniMax worker. It does not cover the
+direct Codex supervisor circuit.
+
+**Code owner:** [`minimax-worker.sh`](../../runtime/codex/scripts/minimax-worker.sh#L159).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> Request
+    Request --> RetryWait: retryable transport/status/body failure and attempt <= RETRIES
+    Request --> Interpret: successful HTTP response or non-retryable response
+    RetryWait --> Request: delay expires / exponential delay capped at RETRY_MAX_DELAY
+    Interpret --> Complete: response contains usable final text
+    Interpret --> Failed: curl/HTTP/provider error, truncated or unusable output
+    Complete --> [*]
+    Failed --> [*]
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| Request | Curl and provider response collected | Retryable transport, HTTP status, or provider message and `attempt <= RETRIES` | Sleep, double delay up to its configured cap, then request again. |
+| Request | Response collected | Non-retryable failure or retries exhausted | Leave retry loop and report failure. |
+| Request | 2xx response collected | Provider body has a retryable error message and retry budget remains | Retry using the same bounded backoff. |
+| Interpret | Response parsed | Content passes worker output checks | Emit content and exit 0. |
+| Interpret | Response parsed | API error, truncation, or invalid output | Emit error and exit nonzero. |
+
+With the default retry count of three, the loop permits up to four total
+requests: the initial attempt plus three retries. The script clamps the
+exponential delay at `RETRY_MAX_DELAY`.

+# Nightly learning extraction
+
+This batch runner selects recent Claude session JSONL files, skips processed
+sessions unless forced, extracts learning records, writes them to the database
+when enabled, then marks the session processed.
+
+**Code owners:** processed-state handling in
+[`already_processed`](../../claude/scripts/nightly-learning-extractor.py#L79),
+[`mark_processed`](../../claude/scripts/nightly-learning-extractor.py#L89),
+and processing loop in [`main`](../../claude/scripts/nightly-learning-extractor.py#L245).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> SelectSessions
+    SelectSessions --> Done: no recent sessions
+    SelectSessions --> Connect: sessions found and not dry-run
+    SelectSessions --> Process: dry-run or DB connection ready
+    Connect --> Failed: database unavailable
+    Connect --> Process: database connection established
+    Process --> SkipProcessed: already processed and force is false
+    Process --> MarkShort: transcript shorter than 200 characters
+    Process --> Extract: transcript long enough
+    Extract --> MarkNoOutput: Claude returns no output
+    Extract --> Store: parse learning records
+    Store --> MarkProcessed: insert records or dry-run
+    MarkShort --> Process: another session remains
+    MarkNoOutput --> Process: another session remains
+    MarkProcessed --> Process: another session remains
+    SkipProcessed --> Process: another session remains
+    Process --> Done: no sessions remain
+    Done --> [*]
+    Failed --> [*]
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| SelectSessions | Run starts | No session mtime is within lookback | Exit without opening the database. |
+| Connect | Sessions found | Not dry-run | Open the DB; connection/import failure exits before processing. |
+| Process | Session selected | Already processed and `--force` absent | Skip it. |
+| Process | Transcript extracted | Fewer than 200 characters | Mark processed without calling Claude. |
+| Extract | Claude call | Empty output or call failure | Mark processed and continue. |
+| Extract | Valid output parsed | DB enabled | Insert each learning with conflict-ignore behavior, commit, then mark processed. |
+| Extract | Valid output parsed | Dry-run | Do not write DB; mark processed after this run. |
+| Any session | Processing completes | More sessions remain | Continue until `--max-sessions` reached. |
+
+Empty model output and short transcripts are treated as processed. `--force`
+reprocesses session names, but deduplication in the database still uses
+`ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`.

+# Nightly Claude session sync
+
+This scheduled script turns recent Claude transcripts into Obsidian session
+notes, then snapshots Conductor worktrees and syncs their rules. The note file
+is the next-run signal: a real summary is skipped, while a placeholder is
+eligible for another summary attempt.
+
+**Code owner:** main session loop in
+[`nightly-session-sync.sh`](../../claude/scripts/nightly-session-sync.sh#L121),
+with summary generation beginning at [line 83](../../claude/scripts/nightly-session-sync.sh#L83).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> ValidateKey
+    ValidateKey --> Enumerate: API key present
+    ValidateKey --> Failed: API key absent
+    Enumerate --> Candidate: recent transcript found
+    Enumerate --> Snapshot: no candidates remain
+    Candidate --> Skip: subagent, too few messages, or existing real summary
+    Candidate --> Summarize: eligible transcript
+    Summarize --> WriteNote: summary succeeds
+    Summarize --> WritePlaceholder: summary fails or conversation is empty
+    WriteNote --> Candidate: next transcript
+    WritePlaceholder --> Candidate: next transcript
+    Skip --> Candidate: next transcript
+    Snapshot --> SyncRules: snapshot phase completes
+    SyncRules --> Done: rule sync attempted
+    Done --> [*]
+    Failed --> [*]
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| ValidateKey | Script starts | API key absent | Log error and exit 1. |
+| Enumerate | Recent JSONL files found | File is under subagent path | Skip. |
+| Candidate | Message count computed | Fewer than five user/assistant messages | Skip. |
+| Candidate | Target note inspected | A real summary already exists | Skip. |
+| Summarize | Transcript extracted | API returns summary | Write session note and increment success counts. |
+| Summarize | API fails or transcript is empty | No summary text | Write placeholder note; because it is not a real summary, a later run retries. |
+| Snapshot | Session loop finishes | Candidate set exhausted | Invoke Conductor snapshot hook for each matching worktree; ignore per-worktree errors. |
+| SyncRules | Snapshot phase ends | Always | Invoke external sync script; ignore its failure and finish. |
+
+The script has no separate durable run record. Session notes are the only
+per-session idempotency guard.

+# Post-build panel reminder gate
+
+The active Bash PostToolUse hook emits a reminder only for a successful,
+non-trivial, non-documentation commit that has not opted out in its commit
+message. It does not schedule or run a panel itself.
+
+**Code owners:** registration in
+[`claude/settings.json`](../../claude/settings.json#L193) and
+[`post-build-panel-trigger.sh`](../../claude/hooks/post-build-panel-trigger.sh#L12).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> InspectEvent
+    InspectEvent --> Ignore: command is not git commit or command failed
+    InspectEvent --> Ignore: previous commit unavailable or diff empty
+    InspectEvent --> Ignore: fewer than two files and fewer than twenty insertions
+    InspectEvent --> Ignore: docs/config-only changes
+    InspectEvent --> Ignore: commit message opts out
+    InspectEvent --> Reminder: successful qualifying commit
+    Ignore --> [*]: continue without reminder
+    Reminder --> [*]: emit /post-build-panel reminder
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| InspectEvent | Bash result arrives | Command is not `git commit` or exit code is nonzero | Return continue without reminder. |
+| InspectEvent | Commit diff read | No parent commit or empty file list | Return continue without reminder. |
+| InspectEvent | Diff measured | Fewer than two files and fewer than twenty insertions | Treat as trivial and skip. |
+| InspectEvent | Paths classified | Every change is documentation/config-only | Skip. |
+| InspectEvent | Commit message read | Contains skip-panel, skip-audit, wip, or no-review | Skip. |
+| InspectEvent | All guards pass | Successful non-trivial change includes non-documentation path | Emit reminder to run `/post-build-panel`. |
+
+This is a stateless one-event gate; it does not store panel completion status.

+# Claude PostToolUse tracking
+
+The active shell hook appends build/test outcomes to a branch-keyed JSONL log
+and records edited source files, affected repos, and candidate build/typecheck
+commands in a per-session cache.
+
+**Code owners:** active `PostToolUse` registration in
+[`claude/settings.json`](../../claude/settings.json#L183),
+[`post-tool-use-tracker.sh`](../../claude/hooks/post-tool-use-tracker.sh#L11),
+and build outcome append at [line 74](../../claude/hooks/post-tool-use-tracker.sh#L74).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> ReadToolEvent
+    ReadToolEvent --> BuildAttempt: Bash event matches build/test command
+    ReadToolEvent --> EditRecord: Edit/Write/MultiEdit with source path
+    ReadToolEvent --> Ignore: unsupported tool, missing path, or markdown edit
+    BuildAttempt --> AttemptLogged: known pass or fail
+    BuildAttempt --> Ignore: exit status remains unknown
+    EditRecord --> EditLogged: append file history and update unique repo/command cache
+    AttemptLogged --> [*]
+    EditLogged --> [*]
+    Ignore --> [*]
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| ReadToolEvent | PostToolUse arrives | Tool is Bash and command matches build/test patterns | Resolve exit code from hook fields, then transcript fallback if unknown. |
+| BuildAttempt | Exit resolved | Code is zero or known nonzero | Append `build_pass` or `build_fail` JSONL row under current branch. |
+| BuildAttempt | Exit unresolved | `unknown`/`null` after fallback | Do not append an attempt. |
+| ReadToolEvent | Edit/Write/MultiEdit arrives | Non-Markdown file maps to a known repo | Append edit line; append unique repo and build/typecheck commands to cache. |
+| ReadToolEvent | Other tool or unsupported edit | Guard fails | Exit without state update. |
+
+The Python tracker file is an unregistered duplicate in the current settings;
+the active owner is the shell hook.
+
+The [per-session cache](../../claude/hooks/post-tool-use-tracker.sh#L119)
+lives at `${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/claude-tsc-cache/${session_id:-default}`, rather
+than in the project's `.claude/tsc-cache` directory. The PreCompact summary
+reader uses the same temporary cache location.

+# Poteto decision gates
+
+Gates are persisted as open or resolved records. Parking an existing ID
+replaces it with an open record, including when the old record was resolved.
+
+**Code owner:** gate methods in
+[`openStore`](../../runtime/codex/skills/poteto-mode/scripts/orch/store.ts#L1501);
+CLI commands in [`orch.ts`](../../runtime/codex/skills/poteto-mode/scripts/orch/orch.ts#L434).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> Absent
+    Absent --> Open: gate park / save question, choices, default
+    Open --> Open: gate park same ID / replace record
+    Resolved --> Open: gate park same ID / reopen with new question
+    Open --> Resolved: gate resolve existing ID / save answer
+    Resolved --> Resolved: gate resolve existing ID / replace answer
+    Open --> Error: resolve unknown ID
+    Resolved --> Error: resolve unknown ID
+    Error --> [*]
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| Absent | `gate park` | Required ID, question, options, and default are present | Create open gate. |
+| Open or Resolved | `gate park` | Same ID exists | Replace the record with a fresh open gate; prior answer is removed. |
+| Open or Resolved | `gate resolve` | ID exists | Store supplied answer and mark resolved. |
+| Any state | `gate resolve` | ID does not exist | Raise not-found error. |
+
+`gate list` returns only open rows. The code does not require a gate to be
+open before resolving it.

+# Poteto frontier snapshot
+
+`frontier.set` stores a generation-numbered snapshot of GitHub PRs and the
+lowest open PR. It refreshes a view; it does not advance PRs through a merge
+lifecycle.
+
+**Code owner:** frontier methods in
+[`openStore`](../../runtime/codex/skills/poteto-mode/scripts/orch/store.ts#L1552)
+and [`orch.ts`](../../runtime/codex/skills/poteto-mode/scripts/orch/orch.ts#L475).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> Snapshot
+    Snapshot --> Resolving: frontier.set / resolve current PR list
+    Resolving --> Refused: duplicate or mismatched pinned PR list
+    Resolving --> Snapshot: resolution and optional pin check pass / generation + 1, replace snapshot
+    Snapshot --> Snapshot: frontier.show / return current snapshot
+    Refused --> [*]
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| Snapshot | `frontier.set` | Store writable, repo and forge valid | Resolve current PRs. |
+| Resolving | Optional `--prs` pin supplied | Duplicates or actual PR list differs | Raise error; keep previous snapshot. |
+| Resolving | Resolution and pin pass | Any valid PR result | Save generation plus one, PR rows, and first open PR or `null`. |
+| Snapshot | `frontier.show` | Store open | Return current JSON snapshot without changing it. |
+
+The actual queued PR progression is owned by
+[watch-pr queued-stack](watch-pr-queued.md).

@@ -0,0 +1,34 @@
+# Poteto inbox
+
+The inbox is a file-backed pointer queue. Draining atomically swaps the inbox
+directory, creates a new one, then removes the drained directory and returns
+the rows.
+
+**Code owner:** inbox methods in
+[`openStore`](../../runtime/codex/skills/poteto-mode/scripts/orch/store.ts#L1449);
+CLI in [`orch.ts`](../../runtime/codex/skills/poteto-mode/scripts/orch/orch.ts#L385).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> Empty
+    Empty --> Queued: inbox.push / atomically write one pointer file
+    Queued --> Queued: inbox.push / append another pointer file
+    Empty --> Draining: inbox.drain / rename directory aside
+    Queued --> Draining: inbox.drain / read rows then rename directory aside
+    Draining --> Empty: create replacement inbox, remove drained directory, return rows
+    Draining --> Queued: replacement mkdir fails / rename drained directory back and throw
+    Empty --> Empty: inbox.peek or count / read only
+    Queued --> Queued: inbox.peek or count / read only
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| Empty or Queued | `inbox.push` | Store initialized and pointer fields valid | Write one uniquely named TSV pointer file. |
+| Empty or Queued | `inbox.drain` | Store is writable | Read pointers, rename inbox to a unique drain directory, then create a new inbox. |
+| Draining | New inbox created | Directory swap succeeds | Delete drained directory and return the rows captured before swap. |
+| Draining | New inbox creation fails | Rename-back succeeds | Restore original directory and throw. |
+| Empty or Queued | `peek` or `count` | Store open | Read queue without draining it. |
+
+There is no acknowledgement stage. A process crash after renaming the inbox
+but before creating its replacement has no recovery transition in this store
+implementation.

@@ -0,0 +1,36 @@
+# Poteto store lock
+
+Opening the store is lazy: reads need no lock. `init` and writes acquire one
+exclusive PID lock; `close` releases it only while this process still owns it.
+
+**Code owners:** [`acquireLock`](../../runtime/codex/skills/poteto-mode/scripts/orch/store.ts#L382),
+write acquisition in [`openStore`](../../runtime/codex/skills/poteto-mode/scripts/orch/store.ts#L1272),
+and release at [`close`](../../runtime/codex/skills/poteto-mode/scripts/orch/store.ts#L1658).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> Unlocked
+    Unlocked --> Unlocked: read-only operation / no lock acquired
+    Unlocked --> Locked: init or write; lock file created with exclusive open
+    Unlocked --> Locked: existing PID is dead / stale owner removed and takeover succeeds
+    Unlocked --> Locked: force option / existing owner replaced
+    Unlocked --> Refused: live owner exists and force is false
+    Locked --> Locked: further writes reuse this process's lock
+    Locked --> Unlocked: close and lock file still names this PID / unlink lock
+    Locked --> Closed: close and no owned lock remains
+    Refused --> [*]
+    Closed --> [*]
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| Unlocked | Read | Store open | Read files without acquiring an exclusive lock. |
+| Unlocked | `init` or write | Store directory exists for write; lock is free | Create the lock file with `open(..., "wx")`. |
+| Unlocked | Lock already exists | Holder PID is dead | Notify stale-lock callback, remove old lock, and retry creation. |
+| Unlocked | Lock already exists | `force` enabled | Notify stolen-lock callback, remove lock, and retry creation. |
+| Unlocked | Lock already exists | Holder is live and `force` is false | Raise `UserError`; do not write. |
+| Locked | `close` | Lock file still names this process | Remove lock, then mark store closed. |
+| Locked | `close` | Lock no longer names this process | Do not remove another owner's lock; mark this handle closed. |
+
+If takeover races with another writer, the retry sees the new lock and raises
+`UserError`. Read operations remain available without the write lock.

+# Poteto unit records
+
+`units.add` creates a pending unit. `units.set` updates that row, but accepts
+any non-empty state string and imposes no transition graph or terminal-state
+rule.
+
+**Code owner:** unit methods in
+[`openStore`](../../runtime/codex/skills/poteto-mode/scripts/orch/store.ts#L1312);
+CLI surface in [`orch.ts`](../../runtime/codex/skills/poteto-mode/scripts/orch/orch.ts#L296).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> Absent
+    Absent --> Pending: units.add / reject duplicate ID
+    Pending --> AnyState: units.set with non-empty state
+    AnyState --> AnyState: units.set with non-empty state
+    Pending --> Error: set unknown ID or blank state
+    AnyState --> Error: set unknown ID or blank state
+    Error --> [*]
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| Absent | `units.add` | ID and track are non-empty; ID is not already present | Append a row with `state: "pending"` and blank branch/PR/SHA. |
+| Pending or any existing state | `units.set` | ID exists; state is non-empty | Replace state with caller-provided text; preserve fields not supplied. |
+| Any state | `units.set` | ID is absent or state is blank | Raise an error; no row transition. |
+
+Names such as `running`, `passed`, or `blocked` are caller conventions. The
+store does not validate them or prevent reopening a terminal-looking state.

+# Prompt extraction
+
+The SessionEnd prompt extractor scans synced project sessions for
+`SAVE_PROMPT:` markers. It tracks processed session basenames and extracted
+prompt names in a local JSON file.
+
+**Code owners:** active SessionEnd registration in
+[`claude/settings.json`](../../claude/settings.json#L267), state read/write in
+[`loadProcessedState`](../../claude/hooks/prompt-extractor/extract.ts#L40),
+and scan loop in [`main`](../../claude/hooks/prompt-extractor/extract.ts#L125).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> LoadState
+    LoadState --> Done: projects directory absent / ask for sync
+    LoadState --> Scan: project sessions available
+    Scan --> SkipKnown: basename already in processedFiles
+    Scan --> Extract: new file
+    Extract --> SkipPrompt: prompt name already extracted
+    Extract --> CreatePrompt: new SAVE_PROMPT marker
+    CreatePrompt --> MarkFile: prompt note written and name recorded
+    SkipPrompt --> MarkFile: file scan complete
+    MarkFile --> Scan: another file remains
+    MarkFile --> Save: no files remain
+    SkipKnown --> Scan: another file remains
+    SkipKnown --> Save: no files remain
+    Save --> Done: write lastRun and processed state
+    Done --> [*]: return continue=true
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| LoadState | Hook starts | Processed file missing or invalid JSON | Start with empty processed lists. |
+| LoadState | Projects directory absent | No synced sessions available | Return a sync instruction without updating state. |
+| Scan | Session basename already processed | Match found in `processedFiles` | Skip the file. |
+| Scan | New session file | File is readable | Search content for prompt markers. |
+| Extract | Marker found | Prompt name already recorded | Skip creating a duplicate note. |
+| Extract | Marker found | Prompt name is new | Write prompt markdown note and append its name. |
+| MarkFile | File scan ends | New file was examined | Add basename to processed list. |
+| Save | All files scanned | Any results | Write `lastRun`, `processedFiles`, and `extractedPrompts`. |
+
+The deduplication key is a basename, not a full project-relative path. This
+chart records that implementation detail; it does not establish that two
+projects cannot contain the same basename.

+# Qwen API request retries
+
+This chart covers the Qwen worker's request retry and output-validation path.
+
+**Code owner:** [`qwen-worker.sh`](../../runtime/codex/scripts/qwen-worker.sh#L246).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> Request
+    Request --> RetryWait: retryable transport/status/body failure and attempt <= RETRIES
+    Request --> Interpret: successful HTTP response or non-retryable response
+    RetryWait --> Request: delay expires / exponential delay capped at RETRY_MAX_DELAY
+    Interpret --> Complete: usable content and finish reason accepted
+    Interpret --> Failed: curl/HTTP/provider error, truncation, or missing final text
+    Complete --> [*]
+    Failed --> [*]
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| Request | Curl and provider response collected | Retryable transport, HTTP status, or provider message and `attempt <= RETRIES` | Sleep, double delay up to its configured cap, then request again. |
+| Request | Response collected | Non-retryable failure or retries exhausted | Exit with the provider or curl failure. |
+| Request | 2xx response collected | Body has a retryable provider error and retry budget remains | Retry using bounded exponential backoff. |
+| Interpret | Response parsed | `finish_reason` and content pass validation | Emit content and exit 0. |
+| Interpret | Response parsed | Truncated response, empty text, or API error | Exit nonzero with the failure. |
+
+With the default retry count of three, the loop permits up to four total
+requests. Retry settings and response validation are owned by this script.

+# Build-failure reaction queue
+
+The active PostToolUse collector writes failed build/test reactions to a
+pending directory. The active UserPromptSubmit injector consumes matching
+branch entries into a processed directory, up to three per prompt.
+
+**Code owners:** active event registrations in
+[`claude/settings.json`](../../claude/settings.json#L183),
+producer [`reaction-collector.sh`](../../claude/hooks/reaction-collector.sh#L9),
+and consumer [`reaction-injector.py`](../../claude/hooks/reaction-injector.py#L63).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> NoReaction
+    NoReaction --> Pending: recognized build/test command has known nonzero exit
+    NoReaction --> NoReaction: non-build command, success, or unknown exit
+    Pending --> Pending: prompt branch differs / leave file queued
+    Pending --> Processed: malformed JSON / move aside
+    Pending --> Processed: branch matches or is unavailable / inject message and move aside
+    Processed --> [*]
+    Pending --> Pending: prompt already consumed three reactions / remaining files wait
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| NoReaction | Bash tool completes | Command matches build/test patterns and exit code is known nonzero | Write JSON with command, output, branch, session, and recent edited-file context. |
+| NoReaction | Bash tool completes | Non-build command, success, or exit code unknown | Do not create reaction. |
+| Pending | User prompt submitted | Reaction JSON malformed/unreadable | Move file to processed without injecting it. |
+| Pending | User prompt submitted | Reaction branch differs from current branch | Keep file pending. |
+| Pending | User prompt submitted | Branch matches, or either branch is unavailable | Inject reaction and move file to processed. |
+| Pending | User prompt submitted | Three messages already injected | Stop; later sorted files remain pending. |
+
+`post-tool-use-tracker.sh` supplies edited-file history used to enrich producer
+records; its event log has a separate chart in
+[post-tool-use tracking](post-tool-use-tracking.md).

+# Reflect learning-count nudge
+
+The active SessionStart hook reads the last completed `/reflect` timestamp,
+counts newer archived session learnings, and prints a reminder at five or
+more. `/reflect` resets the timestamp after generating its report.
+
+**Code owners:** active registration in
+[`claude/settings.json`](../../claude/settings.json#L75), counter read in
+[`reflect-nudge.py`](../../claude/hooks/reflect-nudge.py#L27), and reset in
+[`reflect-reweave.py`](../../claude/scripts/reflect-reweave.py#L610).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> ReadCheckpoint
+    ReadCheckpoint --> Count: state file absent or timestamp loaded
+    Count --> Quiet: database unavailable or driver missing
+    Count --> Quiet: unreviewed learning count below 5
+    Count --> Nudge: unreviewed learning count is at least 5
+    Nudge --> ReadCheckpoint: /reflect completes / save new last_reflect time
+    Quiet --> [*]
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| ReadCheckpoint | Session starts | State missing or invalid | Use Unix epoch as last reflection time. |
+| Count | Database query succeeds | Count is below five | Print no reminder. |
+| Count | Database query succeeds | Count is at least five | Print reminder to run `/reflect`. |
+| Count | Driver import or database connection/query fails | Error caught by hook | Print no reminder; do not change checkpoint. |
+| Nudge | `/reflect` report completes | Reflect command reaches checkpoint write | Save current UTC time as `last_reflect`. |
+
+The nudge does not update its own checkpoint, so it can repeat until the
+reflect command writes one.

@@ -0,0 +1,39 @@
+# Runtime web-search backend retries
+
+The Codex runtime web-search entrypoint checks its cache, then tries enabled
+backends in order. Each backend gets two attempts with a short randomized wait
+after an empty result or exception.
+
+**Code owners:** backend retry in
+[`call_backend`](../../runtime/codex/scripts/web-search.py#L243) and backend
+selection/cache in [`search`](../../runtime/codex/scripts/web-search.py#L314).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> CacheLookup
+    CacheLookup --> Cached: fresh valid cache and cache enabled
+    CacheLookup --> BackendOne: cache miss or --no-cache
+    BackendOne --> Results: backend returns results
+    BackendOne --> Wait: empty result or exception on attempt one
+    Wait --> BackendTwo: randomized 0.4-1.2s delay
+    BackendTwo --> Results: backend returns results
+    BackendTwo --> NextBackend: empty result or exception
+    NextBackend --> Results: a later backend returns results
+    NextBackend --> Empty: all configured backends exhausted
+    Results --> Done: optional cache write
+    Cached --> Done
+    Empty --> Done
+    Done --> [*]
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| CacheLookup | Query starts | Cache enabled and entry is fresh/valid | Return cached results and backend. |
+| CacheLookup | Cache miss or bypass | Query needs live search | Try enabled backends in order. |
+| BackendOne | Backend call | Results non-empty | Return results and optionally cache them. |
+| BackendOne | Backend call | Empty result or exception | Wait a random 0.4–1.2 seconds, then call same backend once more. |
+| BackendTwo | Second attempt ends empty or throws | Another backend remains | Continue with next backend. |
+| NextBackend | No backend remains | Every backend produced no results | Return empty result list and no backend name. |
+
+The code retries the same backend once, regardless of whether the failure is
+an exception or an empty result. It does not persist retry state.

+# Claude session metrics capture
+
+The active Stop hook parses a transcript and branch build-attempt log, then
+replaces one SQLite row per session and rebuilds that session's tool-usage
+rows.
+
+**Code owners:** active registration in
+[`claude/settings.json`](../../claude/settings.json#L217), transcript parsing
+in [`session-metrics.py`](../../claude/hooks/session-metrics.py#L55), and
+idempotent storage in [`store_metrics`](../../claude/hooks/session-metrics.py#L251).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> ReadHookInput
+    ReadHookInput --> Done: transcript path absent or missing
+    ReadHookInput --> InitializeDB: transcript exists
+    InitializeDB --> Parse: schema ready
+    Parse --> Store: transcript counters and build attempts collected
+    Store --> Done: replace session row, rebuild tool rows, commit
+    Done --> [*]: return continue
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| ReadHookInput | Stop event arrives | Malformed/empty input | Use default session identifier and available environment paths. |
+| ReadHookInput | Transcript checked | Missing path or file | Return without database write. |
+| InitializeDB | Transcript exists | Directory/database writable | Create schema if needed. |
+| Parse | Transcript read | JSONL events parse | Count messages, tool calls/errors, modified files, subagents, and duration; read build attempts from current branch log. |
+| Store | Metrics computed | Session ID supplied | `INSERT OR REPLACE` session row, delete old tool rows, insert current rows, commit. |
+
+The database key makes a repeated Stop capture replace the same session row;
+the table writes occur in one SQLite transaction after parsing.

+# Claude session-monitor status projection and watch loop
+
+The monitor classifies each session from a bounded tail of JSONL events. With
+`--watch`, it refreshes the snapshot every five seconds until Ctrl+C. It does
+not persist the classification.
+
+**Code owners:** status projection in
+[`classify_session`](../../claude/scripts/session-monitor.py#L72), and CLI
+watch loop in [`main`](../../claude/scripts/session-monitor.py#L307).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> Snapshot
+    Snapshot --> Unknown: no events or no parseable state
+    Snapshot --> Idle: last activity older than 120 seconds
+    Snapshot --> WaitingInput: latest meaningful event is user/system or completed text
+    Snapshot --> Generating: assistant thinking, streaming, or recent text
+    Snapshot --> ToolUse: latest assistant block is tool_use
+    Unknown --> Snapshot: next five-second refresh
+    Idle --> Snapshot: next five-second refresh
+    WaitingInput --> Snapshot: next five-second refresh
+    Generating --> Snapshot: next five-second refresh
+    ToolUse --> Snapshot: next five-second refresh
+    Snapshot --> [*]: one-shot output or Ctrl+C in watch mode
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| Snapshot | Session files scanned | No events in bounded tail | Report `unknown`. |
+| Snapshot | Recent timestamp evaluated | Last event is older than 120 seconds | Report `idle`. |
+| Snapshot | Latest meaningful event inspected | User/system event, or assistant text followed by trailing event or older than ten seconds | Report `waiting_input`. |
+| Snapshot | Latest assistant content inspected | Thinking, empty stream, or recent assistant text | Report `generating`. |
+| Snapshot | Latest assistant content inspected | Last block is `tool_use` | Report `tool_use` with tool details. |
+| Any projection | Refresh or interrupt | `--watch` enabled | Clear and recompute after five seconds; Ctrl+C exits. |
+
+These are snapshots derived from recent events, not persisted transitions.
+Some status-writing hooks referenced by the environment are stored under
+`~/dotfiles` and are outside this repository.

+# Session vault note lifecycle
+
+SessionEnd writes a metadata stub only when today's note is absent. The
+nightly sync enriches that same note when it has no real summary; a real
+summary is preserved on later syncs.
+
+**Code owners:** active SessionEnd handler
+[`session-to-obsidian.sh`](../../claude/hooks/session-to-obsidian.sh#L8),
+and scheduled enrichment in
+[`nightly-session-sync.sh`](../../claude/scripts/nightly-session-sync.sh#L159).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> NoNote
+    NoNote --> Stub: SessionEnd / create metadata note
+    Stub --> RealSummary: nightly sync generates real summary and overwrites target
+    Stub --> Placeholder: nightly sync cannot summarize / overwrite with failure placeholder
+    Placeholder --> RealSummary: later nightly run retries summary and succeeds
+    Placeholder --> Placeholder: later nightly run retries and still fails
+    RealSummary --> RealSummary: later nightly sync / has_real_summary skips overwrite
+    Stub --> Stub: SessionEnd sees existing file / preserve it
+    Placeholder --> Placeholder: SessionEnd sees existing file / preserve it
+    RealSummary --> RealSummary: SessionEnd sees existing file / preserve it
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| NoNote | SessionEnd | Destination absent | Write metadata stub with “in progress” placeholder. |
+| Any existing note | SessionEnd | Destination exists | Do not overwrite. |
+| Stub or Placeholder | Nightly sync | Target has no real summary | Generate summary and replace note; on failure write placeholder. |
+| RealSummary | Nightly sync | Summary bullets pass `has_real_summary` | Skip note so the summary remains unchanged. |
+
+Both producers use the same project folder, date, and eight-character session
+ID naming rule.

@@ -0,0 +1,55 @@
+# Statechart generation and publication
+
+`statechart.mjs` accepts a TLA+ spec or Mermaid chart, checks it, renders
+artifacts in a temporary work folder, and replaces the output directory only
+after input fingerprints and output ownership checks pass.
+
+**Code owners:** [`fromSpec`](../../runtime/codex/skills/statechart/scripts/statechart.mjs#L877),
+[`fromChart`](../../runtime/codex/skills/statechart/scripts/statechart.mjs#L910),
+[`finish`](../../runtime/codex/skills/statechart/scripts/statechart.mjs#L652),
+and transactional [`publish`](../../runtime/codex/skills/statechart/scripts/statechart.mjs#L758).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> SelectMode
+    SelectMode --> SpecInput: from-spec
+    SelectMode --> ChartInput: from-chart
+    SpecInput --> Scaffold: map missing / write scaffold and stop
+    SpecInput --> Check: spec, config, and map available
+    ChartInput --> GenerateSpec: generated TLA+ module absent
+    ChartInput --> Check: generated module already present
+    GenerateSpec --> Check: write TLA+, config, and map
+    Check --> Refused: invalid input, missing tool, or broken model contract
+    Check --> Draw: TLC checks pass or expected breaks match
+    Draw --> Compare: from-chart
+    Draw --> ValidateInputs: from-spec
+    Compare --> ValidateInputs: compare generated overview with source chart
+    ValidateInputs --> NotPublished: any input fingerprint changed
+    ValidateInputs --> Stage: inputs unchanged
+    Stage --> Refused: output contains files this command does not own
+    Stage --> Swap: copy new output beside destination and recheck ownership
+    Swap --> Published: new output installed / remove previous output
+    Swap --> Restored: publish fails and previous output is restored
+    Swap --> NotPublished: rollback also fails / preserve recovery location
+    Published --> [*]
+    Restored --> [*]
+    NotPublished --> [*]
+    Refused --> [*]
+    Scaffold --> [*]
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| SpecInput | Map lookup | Map absent | Write a scaffold and stop before TLC so code labels can be filled in. |
+| ChartInput | Spec lookup | TLA+ module absent | Generate module/config/map from the Mermaid chart; then check it. |
+| Check | TLC completes | Required outcomes match expectations | Draw charts and stories in temporary work area. |
+| Check | TLC/model validation fails | Contract not satisfied | Stop; no output publication. |
+| Draw | Finish | Inputs changed during analysis | Refuse publication and leave previous output as-is. |
+| Stage | Output directory inspected | Foreign files exist | Refuse replacement because publication swaps the whole directory. |
+| Stage | Output is owned | Input fingerprints still match | Copy candidate output to a sibling staging folder and recheck. |
+| Swap | Replace succeeds | Old output was safely moved aside | Install candidate and remove old copy. |
+| Swap | Replace fails | Old output can be moved back | Restore old output and report failure. |
+| Swap | Rollback fails | Old output cannot be restored | Preserve recovery folder and report that state. |
+
+This chart records the CLI's control flow. No TLC or renderer was run during
+this inventory.

+# All-project session sync
+
+`sync-all-sessions.sh` processes configured project paths in order: invoke
+SpecStory, copy new session notes, create missing project indexes, split large
+sessions, then run prompt extraction.
+
+**Code owner:** project loop in
+[`sync-all-sessions.sh`](../../claude/scripts/sync-all-sessions.sh#L11),
+with final split/extract steps beginning at [line 93](../../claude/scripts/sync-all-sessions.sh#L93).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> ProjectList
+    ProjectList --> SyncProject: another configured path remains
+    ProjectList --> SplitSessions: all paths processed
+    SyncProject --> ProjectList: path absent or operations finish
+    SyncProject --> ProjectList: SpecStory/copy failures are ignored
+    SplitSessions --> ExtractPrompts: split command succeeds
+    SplitSessions --> Failed: split command fails under set -e
+    ExtractPrompts --> Done: prompt extractor returns success
+    ExtractPrompts --> Failed: prompt extractor fails under set -e
+    Done --> [*]
+    Failed --> [*]
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| ProjectList | Configured project path examined | Directory absent | Skip path. |
+| ProjectList | Configured project path examined | Directory exists | Create vault folders, run SpecStory, copy session markdown with `cp -n`, create index only if missing. |
+| SyncProject | SpecStory or copy command fails | Commands are guarded with `|| true` | Continue to next project. |
+| ProjectList | No configured paths remain | All project calls returned | Print project counts and run split step. |
+| SplitSessions | Split command succeeds | Exit status zero | Invoke prompt extractor. |
+| SplitSessions or ExtractPrompts | Command fails | `set -e` active | Exit immediately; later steps do not run. |
+
+This pipeline has no run checkpoint of its own. Copies are idempotent by
+destination filename; split and prompt extraction have their own file/state
+rules.
