+# Watch PR queued stack
+
+The queued runner first refreshes a whole stack, then polls only the lowest
+unmerged frontier between scheduled sweeps. It advances only when the previous
+frontier is observed merged.
+
+**Code owners:** queue planning and snapshots in
+[`planQueue`](../../runtime/codex/skills/poteto-mode/scripts/watch-pr/policy.ts#L535),
+[`applyQueueSnapshot`](../../runtime/codex/skills/poteto-mode/scripts/watch-pr/policy.ts#L574),
+[`evaluateQueue`](../../runtime/codex/skills/poteto-mode/scripts/watch-pr/policy.ts#L644),
+and [`runQueued`](../../runtime/codex/skills/poteto-mode/scripts/watch-pr/policy.ts#L707).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> Sweep
+    Sweep --> Evaluate: every non-merged PR has a fresh snapshot
+    Evaluate --> Complete: every queued PR is merged
+    Evaluate --> Blocked: any stack-wide merge blocker
+    Evaluate --> Advance: prior frontier became merged; next open PR exists
+    Evaluate --> Waiting: frontier still pending checks or stack merge is queued
+    Evaluate --> TimedOut: timeout reached with unmerged PRs
+    Advance --> Sweep: emit frontier advance and refresh stack
+    Waiting --> FrontierPoll: polling interval elapses before next whole-stack sweep
+    FrontierPoll --> Evaluate: refresh current lowest unmerged PR
+    FrontierPoll --> Sweep: scheduled sweep is due
+    Complete --> [*]
+    Blocked --> [*]
+    TimedOut --> [*]
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| Sweep | Queue state created or sweep due | Non-merged PRs remain | Read each non-merged PR in queue order and require a complete sweep before evaluation. |
+| Evaluate | Snapshot set complete | All PRs merged | Return terminal complete verdict. |
+| Evaluate | Snapshot set complete | Any conflict, review thread, failed check, or merge gate | Return terminal blocker verdict. |
+| Evaluate | Frontier changed | Old frontier is now merged and next open PR exists | Update frontier and emit `ADVANCE`. |
+| Evaluate | Frontier not ready | Pending checks or merge queue; timeout not reached | Emit waiting when wait key changes, then sleep. |
+| Evaluate | Frontier not ready | Run deadline reached | Return terminal queued-stack timeout. |
+| Waiting | Interval elapses | Whole-stack sweep is not due | Poll only current frontier. |
+| FrontierPoll | Snapshot applied | Sweep time reached | Start a new whole-stack sweep before further evaluation. |
+
+Query retries and status-query blockers are shared with the simple runner's
+[`pollUntilTerminal`](watch-pr-simple.md).

+# Watch PR simple and stack runner
+
+This runner polls a single PR or ordinary stack until the status-only response,
+a blocker, readiness, query failure, or deadline ends the run.
+
+**Code owners:** [`pollUntilTerminal`](../../runtime/codex/skills/poteto-mode/scripts/watch-pr/policy.ts#L365),
+[`runSimple`](../../runtime/codex/skills/poteto-mode/scripts/watch-pr/policy.ts#L417),
+and classification in [`classifyPr`](../../runtime/codex/skills/poteto-mode/scripts/watch-pr/policy.ts#L218).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> ReadStatus
+    ReadStatus --> StatusOnly: statusOnly requested
+    ReadStatus --> Blocked: conflict, review-thread, failing-check, or merge-gate blocker
+    ReadStatus --> Ready: PR ready/merged, or entire ordinary stack clear
+    ReadStatus --> Waiting: pending checks and no blocker
+    ReadStatus --> RetryWait: retryable status query error below error limit
+    ReadStatus --> QueryBlocked: non-retryable error or max query errors reached
+    Waiting --> ReadStatus: interval elapses before deadline
+    Waiting --> TimedOut: deadline reached with pending checks
+    RetryWait --> ReadStatus: bounded backoff elapses before deadline
+    RetryWait --> TimedOut: deadline reached while status unavailable
+    StatusOnly --> [*]
+    Blocked --> [*]
+    Ready --> [*]
+    QueryBlocked --> [*]
+    TimedOut --> [*]
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| ReadStatus | Snapshot read | Status-only mode | Return terminal status snapshot. |
+| ReadStatus | Snapshot classified | Conflict, unresolved review thread, failing check, or merge gate | Return a terminal blocker verdict. |
+| ReadStatus | Snapshot classified | Ready or merged | Return terminal ready verdict. |
+| ReadStatus | Snapshot classified | Open PR has pending checks and no blocker | Emit waiting state and sleep for polling interval. |
+| ReadStatus | Query throws | Retryable and below `maxQueryErrors` | Emit retry notice and sleep with exponential backoff capped at 300 seconds. |
+| ReadStatus | Query throws | Non-retryable or max errors reached | Return terminal status-query blocker. |
+| Waiting or RetryWait | Deadline check | Deadline elapsed | Return terminal timeout verdict. |
+
+The simple runner rejects `queued-stack` mode; that progression is a separate
+machine in [watch-pr queued stack](watch-pr-queued.md).

+# XERJ source snapshot publication
+
+`export_snapshot` validates a full Git commit and a new output path, scans and
+filters tree entries, copies verified blobs, then writes `.snapshot.json` as
+the final receipt. A failure after directory creation can leave a partial
+output without a receipt; because the output now exists, rerunning to that
+path is refused.
+
+**Code owners:** output validation in
+[`validate_output_path`](../../scripts/xerj_snapshot.py#L353), export flow in
+[`export_snapshot`](../../scripts/xerj_snapshot.py#L368), and receipt write at
+[line 475](../../scripts/xerj_snapshot.py#L475).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+    [*] --> Validate
+    Validate --> Refused: repository, full commit SHA, or new output path invalid
+    Validate --> ScanTree: all inputs pass and commit resolves
+    ScanTree --> Refused: Git/tree/read validation fails
+    ScanTree --> CreateOutput: exclusions, sensitive-content checks, and collision checks finish
+    CreateOutput --> ExportBlobs: create private output directory
+    ExportBlobs --> Partial: blob read, digest, path, or write fails
+    ExportBlobs --> Receipt: every eligible file written and executable mode restored
+    Receipt --> Published: write .snapshot.json last
+    Published --> [*]: return receipt and totals
+    Partial --> [*]: report error; partial directory remains without receipt
+    Refused --> [*]: return error before output creation
+```
+
+| State | Event | Guard | Effect |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| Validate | CLI starts | Repo is valid, commit is full SHA, output absent, parent exists, output outside worktree | Resolve commit, load exclusions, and read tree. |
+| ScanTree | Tree entry examined | Path/mode/type/size or exclusion pattern rejects it | Record exclusion. |
+| ScanTree | Candidate file read | Content is safe and no output-path collision exists | Record size, object ID, and digest for export. |
+| CreateOutput | Scan complete | Eligible set finalized | Create output directory with mode 0700. |
+| ExportBlobs | Blob copied | Blob size and digest match scan | Create file exclusively, preserve executable mode, append export receipt data. |
+| ExportBlobs | Any write or integrity failure | Output directory already exists | Stop; leave partial output in place without `.snapshot.json`. |
+| Receipt | All files exported | Export/exclusion totals sorted | Write `.snapshot.json` with exclusive create as final publication step. |
+
+The output is not installed by rename: its existence is reserved before blob
+copying, and the receipt is the completion marker.

bundles.title: JAR state charts and formal verification
bundles.description:
Keep this repo's state charts and formal verification current, find real bugs, and fix them.

1. State charts: load the statechart and state-machine-thinking skills. For every entity in this repo with a status, lifecycle, queue, retry loop or concurrent state change (orders and positions, jobs, syncs, deploys, sessions, approvals and the like), keep a state chart in docs/state-charts/ (one file per machine, Mermaid stateDiagram plus a short table of states, events, guards and side effects), linked from the repo docs index. Create the folder and index on the first run; on later runs, update only the charts whose code changed since the last run (git log since the previous chart commit) and add charts for new machines.
2. Formal verification: for the highest-risk machine that does not yet have a current spec, use /create-formal-verification-skill (and /maintain-formal-verification-skill for existing specs) as described in /Users/shyamsivakumar/Code/llmwiki/source/docs/how-to/formal-verification-with-tla.md. Model the real code paths, state the safety invariants (for example no double order, no trade from an unconsumed condition, no lost state on restart) and liveness properties, and run the model checker through heavy.
3. Bugs: every counterexample must be reproduced against the real code (a replay, a script on real data, or the existing test suite), never assumed. Fix each confirmed bug in this task, extending the existing owners; no new unit test files. Record unconfirmed or out-of-scope findings in the closing note.
4. Report: list the charts added or updated, specs added or updated with their invariants, model-checker results, bugs confirmed and fixed (with file:line and proof), and what the next run should cover.
Guardrails: one heavy command at a time through heavy; stop if load per core reaches 1; paper only for trading code; never deploy or change production from this task.

+# Account deletion
+
+Apple Sign in with Apple account removal (App Store 5.1.1(v)).
+
+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2
+  [*] --> Authenticated
+  Authenticated --> RevokingApple: deleteAccount action
+  RevokingApple --> Authenticated: Apple 429/5xx or network (retriable throw)
+  RevokingApple --> DeletingBackend: revoke OK, no token, or invalid_grant
+  RevokingApple --> DeletingBackend: revoke permanent failure (non-retriable)
+  DeletingBackend --> Gone: deleteUserData + sessions cleared
+  Gone --> [*]
+```
+
+| State | Meaning |
+| --- | --- |
+| Authenticated | Auth user + profile rows present |
+| RevokingApple | `revokeAppleToken` in flight |
+| DeletingBackend | `internal.users.deleteUserData` running |
+| Gone | Auth user, profile, and owned data removed |
+
+| Event | Guard | Side effects |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| `deleteAccount` | Signed in | Read `appleRefreshToken` via internal query |
+| Revoke success | HTTP 200 or `invalid_grant` on 400 | Mark revoked |
+| Revoke retriable | 429, 5xx, fetch error | Throw; **no** backend delete |
+| Revoke permanent fail | Other 4xx | Continue; `revoked: false` |
+| `deleteUserData` | Revoke step done | Cascade delete user data |
+
+**Invariants:**
+
+- No backend delete while a retriable revoke is pending.
+- After completion the auth user row is gone.
+
+**Verification:** `verification/tla/account-deletion/AccountDeletion.tla`

+
+Stored on `groups.status` (`active` \| `archived`, default `active`).

+```mermaid
+stateDiagram-v2

+  Archived --> [*]: deleteJar (admin)

+| --- | --- |
+| Active | Add/remove movies, votes, picks, movie nights, RSVPs |
+| Archived | Read history; admin metadata patch; **no** member mutations |
+
+| Event | Guard | Side effects |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| `createJar` | Authenticated | `status: active`, owner membership |
+| `archiveJar` | Admin | `status: archived` |
+| `reactivateJar` | Admin | `status: active` |
+| `deleteJar` | Admin | `deleteJarCascade` |
+| Member mutations | `requireActiveMembership` | Throw `Jar is archived` |
+
+**Invariant:** no movie or RSVP mutation succeeds while archived
+(`assertGroupActive`).
+

+#!/usr/bin/env node
+/**
+ * Smoke test for Apple revoke invalid_grant handling (JAR-4 reproduction).
+ * Mirrors __tests__/lib/apple-auth.test.ts cases without Jest.
+ */
+const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
+
+// Inline copy of appleRevokeErrorIsInvalidGrant (keep in sync with convex/appleAuth.ts)
+function appleRevokeErrorIsInvalidGrant(body) {
+  const trimmed = body.trim();
+  if (!trimmed) return false;
+  if (/invalid_grant/i.test(trimmed)) return true;
+  try {
+    const params = new URLSearchParams(trimmed);
+    return params.get('error') === 'invalid_grant';
+  } catch {
+    return false;
+  }
+}
+
+assert.equal(appleRevokeErrorIsInvalidGrant('error=invalid_grant'), true);
+assert.equal(appleRevokeErrorIsInvalidGrant('invalid_grant'), true);
+assert.equal(appleRevokeErrorIsInvalidGrant('invalid_client'), false);
+assert.equal(appleRevokeErrorIsInvalidGrant(''), false);
+
+console.log('test-apple-revoke-grant: ok (3 assertions)');

+---- MODULE AccountDeletion ----
+EXTENDS TLC
+
+(***************************************************************************
+  Models convex/users.ts deleteAccount (lines 166-197) and retry behavior.
+  Revoke outcomes are abstracted; deleteUserData is atomic.
+***************************************************************************)
+
+VARIABLES userData, phase, hasAppleToken
+
+vars == <<userData, phase, hasAppleToken>>
+
+UserData == {"present", "absent"}
+Phase == {"idle", "awaiting_retry", "done"}
+HasToken == {TRUE, FALSE}
+RevokeResult == {"ok", "retriable_fail", "permanent_fail"}
+
+TypeOK ==
+  /\ userData \in UserData
+  /\ phase \in Phase
+  /\ hasAppleToken \in HasToken
+
+Init ==
+  /\ userData = "present"
+  /\ phase = "idle"
+  /\ hasAppleToken \in HasToken
+
+AttemptDeleteWithToken(result) ==
+  /\ phase = "idle"
+  /\ hasAppleToken = TRUE
+  /\ \/ result = "retriable_fail"
+        /\ userData' = "present"
+        /\ phase' = "awaiting_retry"
+     \/ result \in {"ok", "permanent_fail"}
+        /\ userData' = "absent"
+        /\ phase' = "done"
+  /\ UNCHANGED hasAppleToken
+
+AttemptDeleteNoToken ==
+  /\ phase = "idle"
+  /\ hasAppleToken = FALSE
+  /\ userData' = "absent"
+  /\ phase' = "done"
+  /\ UNCHANGED hasAppleToken
+
+RetryAfterRetriable ==
+  /\ phase = "awaiting_retry"
+  /\ userData' = "absent"
+  /\ phase' = "done"
+  /\ UNCHANGED hasAppleToken
+
+Next ==
+  \/ \E result \in RevokeResult : AttemptDeleteWithToken(result)
+  \/ AttemptDeleteNoToken
+  \/ RetryAfterRetriable
+
+Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
+
+NoDeleteOnRetriable ==
+  phase = "awaiting_retry" => userData = "present"
+
+NoDataAfterDone ==
+  phase = "done" => userData = "absent"
+
+====

Formal verification: for the highest-risk machine that does not yet have a current spec, use /create-formal-verification-skill (and /maintain-formal-verification-skill for existing specs) as described in /Users/shyamsivakumar/Code/llmwiki/source/docs/how-to/formal-verification-with-tla.md. Model the real code paths, state the safety invariants (for example no double order, no trade from an unconsumed condition, no lost state on restart) and liveness properties, and run the model checker through heavy.
3. Bugs: every counterexample must be reproduced against the real code (a replay, a script on real data, or the existing test suite), never assumed. Fix each confirmed bug in this task, extending the existing owners; no new unit test files. Record unconfirmed or out-of-scope findings in the closing note.
4. Report: list the charts added or updated, specs added or updated with their invariants, model-checker results, bugs confirmed and fixed (with file:line and proof), and what the next run should cover.
Guardrails: one heavy command at a time through heavy; stop if load per core reaches 1; paper only for trading code; never deploy or change production from this task.

bundles.title: Build Hindu scripture scroll app for Android
bundles.description:
Shyam wants a "TikTok for scripture" app for Hindu texts on the Indian Google Play Store, as fast as possible, modelled on the format of Scroll The Bible (one verse per full screen, vertical swipe, to replace doomscrolling). A sibling research task (REA) covers the market, rights and Play rules; start the build now and adopt its findings as they land.

1. Create a new private repo ~/Code/<app-name> (pick a working name; Shyam can rename) with git and a private GitHub repo under shyamsivakumar. Stack: Expo / React Native, Android first, following the iOS Studio build guide and the Expo and Appllama skills in llmwiki (load expo-overview first).
2. MVP: full-screen vertical verse feed starting with the Bhagavad Gita (Sanskrit with transliteration, Hindi and English), using only public-domain or openly licensed translations, with the source and licence of every text recorded in the repo. Swipe, save/like, share as an image card, verse of the day notification, simple streak, offline first, fast cold start, works well on low-end Android phones. Hindi and English UI.
3. Shyam's way of working: 5 variations of the feed design and of the verse card with a small page to compare them, a recommendation with numbers (cold start time, scroll frame rate, APK size).
4. Release prep: Android App Bundle build with EAS (eas-app-stores skill), store listing draft (title, short and long description in English and Hindi, screenshots), privacy policy page, data safety answers, and the internal and closed testing tracks plan. Anything that needs Shyam's accounts or money (Google Play developer account and its fee, signing up for EAS paid plans, testers) is listed exactly as a checklist for him; never sign up for paid services yourself.
Proof: an end-to-end walkthrough and a screen recording of the app on an Android emulator, the AAB file, cold start and APK size numbers. Run builds and emulators one at a time through heavy.

## Play account (Shyam, 2026-10-27)
Shyam does not have a Google Play developer account yet and will create one. Plan for a new personal account unless CODE-4's research finds a faster compliant path: include the 12-testers-for-14-days closed test in the checklist, and have everything else ready (signed AAB, English and Hindi listing, privacy policy, data safety answers, a closed-test tester list template and an invite message) so the closed test can start the day the account exists.

+This is an Expo/React Native mobile application. Prioritize mobile-first patterns, performance, and cross-platform compatibility.
+
+## Expo has changed — do not trust your training data
+
+Expo ships breaking changes every SDK release. APIs you remember are likely renamed, moved, or removed. Before writing any code that touches an Expo, EAS, or React Native API:
+
+1. Read the major version of the `expo` package in `package.json`.
+2. Fetch the matching versioned docs: `https://docs.expo.dev/versions/v<major>.0.0/`
+3. For anything else, fetch https://docs.expo.dev/llms.txt — an index of all Expo docs with corrections to common LLM misconceptions. Follow its links to the specific page you need; never answer from memory.
+
+## Commands
+
+Use `bunx` instead of `npx` if the project uses bun (`bun.lock` present).
+
+```bash
+npx expo install <package>  # ALWAYS use instead of npm/yarn/pnpm/bun add — resolves SDK-compatible versions
+npx expo start              # start the dev server
+npx expo lint               # lint
+npx tsc --noEmit            # typecheck
+npx expo-doctor             # diagnose dependency and config issues
+npx expo install --fix      # fix incompatible package versions
+```
+
+Run lint and typecheck before declaring any task done.
+
+## Navigation & Routing
+
+- Use **Expo Router** for all navigation. Routes live in `src/app/` — every file there is a screen, `_layout.tsx` files define navigators. Keep non-route code (components, hooks, utils) outside `src/app/`.
+- Import `Link`, `router`, and `useLocalSearchParams` from `expo-router`.
+- Docs: https://docs.expo.dev/router/introduction.md
+
+## Building with EAS
+
+Use EAS to build, sign, and submit the app in the cloud (`eas build`, `eas submit`) and to ship over-the-air updates (`eas update`) — no local Xcode or Android Studio required. Run EAS CLI as `bunx eas-cli <command>` in Bun projects, or `npx eas-cli@latest <command>` otherwise; substitute that for bare `eas` in docs examples.
+Docs: https://docs.expo.dev/eas/index.md
+
+## Rules
+
+- If `ios/` and `android/` directories do not exist, they are generated (Continuous Native Generation). Never create or edit them by hand — configure native behavior in `app.json` and config plugins.
+- Expo Go only includes its bundled native modules. After adding a library with native code, the app needs a development build: `npx expo run:ios|android` locally, or `eas build --profile development`.
+- Prefer recommended Expo modules over third-party libraries, and check your available skills before adding dependencies. Docs: https://docs.expo.dev/versions/latest/index.md

+import { CARD_STYLES, FEED_THEMES } from '@/constants/design';

+import { usePreferences } from '@/context/preferences-context';
+import { useVerseActions } from '@/context/verse-actions-context';

+import { t, type UiLocale } from '@/lib/i18n';
+import { Link } from 'expo-router';
+import { Pressable, ScrollView, StyleSheet, Text, View } from 'react-native';
+
+export default function ProfileScreen() {
+  const { feedTheme, cardStyle, uiLocale, setUiLocale, setFeedTheme, setCardStyle } = usePreferences();
+  const { streak } = useVerseActions();
+  const palette = FEED_PALETTES[feedTheme];
+  const vod = getVerseOfDay();
+
+  const streakLabel =
+    streak.count > 0 ? t('streak', { count: streak.count }) : t('streakStart');
+
+  return (
+    <ScrollView style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: palette.background }} contentContainerStyle={styles.pad}>
+      <Text style={[styles.h1, { color: palette.text }]}>{t('verseOfDay')}</Text>
+      <Text style={{ color: palette.textMuted, marginBottom: 8 }}>
+        {vod.chapter}.{vod.verse}
+      </Text>
+      <Text style={{ color: palette.text, marginBottom: 24 }} numberOfLines={4}>
+        {uiLocale === 'hi' ? vod.hindi : vod.english}
+      </Text>
+
+      <Text style={[styles.h2, { color: palette.text }]}>{streakLabel}</Text>
+
+      <Text style={[styles.h2, { color: palette.text, marginTop: 24 }]}>{t('language')}</Text>
+      <View style={styles.row}>
+        {(['en', 'hi'] as UiLocale[]).map((loc) => (
+          <Chip
+            key={loc}
+            label={loc === 'en' ? t('english') : t('hindi')}
+            active={uiLocale === loc}
+            palette={palette}
+            onPress={() => setUiLocale(loc)}
+          />
+        ))}
+      </View>
+
+      <Text style={[styles.h2, { color: palette.text, marginTop: 24 }]}>{t('feedTheme')}</Text>
+      <View style={styles.wrap}>
+        {FEED_THEMES.map((theme) => (
+          <Chip
+            key={theme.id}
+            label={theme.label}
+            active={feedTheme === theme.id}
+            palette={palette}
+            onPress={() => setFeedTheme(theme.id)}
+          />
+        ))}
+      </View>
+
+      <Text style={[styles.h2, { color: palette.text, marginTop: 24 }]}>{t('cardStyle')}</Text>
+      <View style={styles.wrap}>
+        {CARD_STYLES.map((style) => (
+          <Chip
+            key={style.id}
+            label={style.label}
+            active={cardStyle === style.id}
+            palette={palette}
+            onPress={() => setCardStyle(style.id)}
+          />
+        ))}
+      </View>
+
+      <Link href="/design-lab" asChild>
+        <Pressable style={[styles.lab, { borderColor: palette.accent }]}>
+          <Text style={{ color: palette.accent, fontWeight: '600' }}>{t('designLab')}</Text>
+          <Text style={{ color: palette.textMuted, fontSize: 13 }}>{t('designLabHint')}</Text>
+        </Pressable>
+      </Link>
+
+      <Link href="/privacy" asChild>
+        <Pressable style={{ marginTop: 16 }}>

+import { VerseCard } from '@/components/verse/verse-card';
+import { FEED_PALETTES } from '@/constants/feed-palette';
+import { usePreferences } from '@/context/preferences-context';
+import { useVerseActions } from '@/context/verse-actions-context';
+import { getVerses } from '@/lib/gita';
+import { t } from '@/lib/i18n';
+import { Link } from 'expo-router';
+import { FlatList, Pressable, StyleSheet, Text, View } from 'react-native';
+
+export default function SavedScreen() {
+  const { feedTheme, cardStyle, uiLocale } = usePreferences();
+  const { saved, ready } = useVerseActions();
+  const palette = FEED_PALETTES[feedTheme];
+  const items = getVerses().filter((v) => saved.has(v.id));
+
+  if (!ready) return null;
+
+  if (items.length === 0) {
+    return (
+      <View style={[styles.empty, { backgroundColor: palette.background }]}>
+        <Text style={[styles.title, { color: palette.text }]}>{t('savedEmpty')}</Text>
+        <Text style={{ color: palette.textMuted }}>{t('savedEmptyHint')}</Text>
+        <Link href="/" asChild>
+          <Pressable style={[styles.cta, { backgroundColor: palette.accent }]}>
+            <Text style={styles.ctaText}>{t('tabFeed')}</Text>
+          </Pressable>
+        </Link>
+      </View>
+    );
+  }
+
+  return (
+    <View style={{ flex: 1, backgroundColor: palette.background }}>
+      <FlatList
+        data={items}
+        keyExtractor={(item) => String(item.id)}
+        contentContainerStyle={{ padding: 16 }}
+        renderItem={({ item }) => (
+          <View style={[styles.card, { backgroundColor: palette.panel }]}>
+            <VerseCard

+import { useFonts } from 'expo-font';
+import { DarkTheme, DefaultTheme, Stack, ThemeProvider } from 'expo-router';
+import * as SplashScreen from 'expo-splash-screen';
+import { useEffect } from 'react';
+import 'react-native-reanimated';
+
+import { useColorScheme } from '@/components/useColorScheme';
+import { PreferencesProvider } from '@/context/preferences-context';
+import { VerseActionsProvider } from '@/context/verse-actions-context';
+
+export {
+  // Catch any errors thrown by the Layout component.
+  ErrorBoundary,
+} from 'expo-router';
+
+export const unstable_settings = {
+  // Ensure that reloading on `/modal` keeps a back button present.
+  anchor: '(tabs)',
+};
+
+// Prevent the splash screen from auto-hiding before asset loading is complete.
+SplashScreen.preventAutoHideAsync();
+
+export default function RootLayout() {
+  const [loaded, error] = useFonts({
+    SpaceMono: require('../assets/fonts/SpaceMono-Regular.ttf'),
+  });
+
+  // Expo Router uses Error Boundaries to catch errors in the navigation tree.
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (error) throw error;
+  }, [error]);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (loaded) {
+      SplashScreen.hideAsync();
+    }
+  }, [loaded]);
+
+  if (!loaded) {
+    return null;
+  }
+
+  return <RootLayoutNav />;
+}
+
+function RootLayoutNav() {
+  const colorScheme = useColorScheme();
+
+  return (
+    <PreferencesProvider>
+      <VerseActionsProvider>
+        <ThemeProvider value={colorScheme === 'dark' ? DarkTheme : DefaultTheme}>
+          <Stack>
+            <Stack.Screen name="(tabs)" options={{ headerShown: false }} />
+            <Stack.Screen name="design-lab" options={{ title: 'Design lab' }} />
+            <Stack.Screen name="privacy" options={{ title: 'Privacy' }} />
+            <Stack.Screen name="modal" options={{ presentation: 'modal' }} />
+          </Stack>
+        </ThemeProvider>
+      </VerseActionsProvider>
+    </PreferencesProvider>
+  );
+}

युद्ध की इच्छावाले इस कुटुम्ब-समुदाय को अपने सामने उपस्थित देखकर मेरे अङ्ग शिथिल हो रहे हैं और मुख सूख रहा है तथा मेरे शरीर में कँपकँपी आ रही है एवं रोंगटे खड़े हो रहे हैं। हाथ से गाण्डीव धनुष गिर रहा है और त्वचा भी जल रही है। मेरा मन भ्रमित-सा हो रहा है और मैं खड़े रहने में भी असमर्थ हो रहा हूँ।"},{"id":29,"chapter":1,"verse":29,"label":"1.29","sanskrit":"सीदन्ति मम गात्राणि मुखं च परिशुष्यति।\nवेपथुश्च शरीरे मे रोमहर्षश्च जायते।।1.29।।","transliteration":"sīdanti mama gātrāṇi mukhaṁ cha pariśhuṣhyati\nvepathuśh cha śharīre me roma-harṣhaśh cha jāyate","english":"My limbs fail, my mouth is parched, my body quivers, and my hair stands on end.","hindi":"।।1.28 -- 1.30।। अर्जुन बोले - हे कृष्ण! What use is dominion to us, O Krishna, or pleasures or even life?","hindi":"।।1.32।। हे कृष्ण! मैं न तो विजय चाहता हूँ, न राज्य चाहता हूँ और न सुखों को ही चाहता हूँ। हे गोविन्द! हमलोगों को राज्य से क्या लाभ? भोगों से क्या लाभ? अथवा जीने से भी क्या लाभ?"},{"id":33,"chapter":1,"verse":33,"label":"1.33","sanskrit":"येषामर्थे काङ्क्षितं नो राज्यं भोगाः सुखानि च।\nत इमेऽवस्थिता युद्धे प्राणांस्त्यक्त्वा धनानि च।।1.33।।","transliteration":"yeṣhām arthe kāṅkṣhitaṁ no rājyaṁ bhogāḥ sukhāni cha\nta ime ’vasthitā yuddhe prāṇāṁs tyaktvā dhanāni cha","english":"Those for whose sake we desire kingdom, enjoyments, and pleasures stand here in battle, having renounced life and wealth.","hindi":"।।1.33।। जिनके लिये हमारी राज्य, भोग और सुखकी इच्छा है, वे ही ये सब अपने प्राणों की और धन की आशा का त्याग करके युद्ध में खड़े हैं।"},{"id":34,"chapter":1,"verse":34,"label":"1.34","sanskrit":"आचार्याः पितरः पुत्रास्तथैव च पितामहाः।\nमातुलाः श्चशुराः पौत्राः श्यालाः सम्बन्धिनस्तथा।।1.34।।","transliteration":"āchāryāḥ pitaraḥ putrās tathaiva cha pitāmahāḥ\nmātulāḥ śhvaśhurāḥ pautrāḥ śhyālāḥ sambandhinas tathā","english":"Teachers, fathers, sons, and grandfathers, maternal uncles, fathers-in-law, grandsons, brothers-in-law, and other relatives—","hindi":"।।1.34 -- 1.35।। (टिप्पणी प0 24.1) आचार्य, पिता, पुत्र और उसी प्रकार पितामह, मामा, ससुर, पौत्र, साले तथा अन्य जितने भी सम्बन्धी हैं, मुझ पर प्रहार करने पर भी मैं इनको मारना नहीं चाहता, और हे मधुसूदन! मुझे त्रिलोकी का राज्य मिलता हो, तो भी मैं इनको मारना नहीं चाहता, फिर पृथ्वी के लिये तो (मैं इनको मारूँ ही) क्या?"},{"id":35,"chapter":1,"verse":35,"label":"1.35","sanskrit":"एतान्न हन्तुमिच्छामि घ्नतोऽपि मधुसूदन।\nअपि त्रैलोक्यराज्यस्य हेतोः किं नु महीकृते।।1.35।।","transliteration":"etān na hantum ichchhāmi ghnato ’pi madhusūdana\napi trailokya-rājyasya hetoḥ kiṁ nu mahī-kṛite","english":"These I do not wish to kill, O Krishna, even though they kill me, for the sake of dominion over the three worlds; leave alone killing them for the sake of the earth.\"","hindi":"।।1.34 -- 1.35।। (टिप्पणी प0 24.1) आचार्य, पिता, पुत्र और उसी प्रकार पितामह, मामा, ससुर, पौत्र, साले तथा अन्य जितने भी सम्बन्धी हैं, मुझपर प्रहार करने पर भी मैं इनको मारना नहीं चाहता, और हे मधुसूदन! मुझे त्रिलोकी का राज्य मिलता हो, तो भी मैं इनको मारना नहीं चाहता, फिर पृथ्वीके लिये तो (मैं इनको मारूँ ही) क्या?"},{"id":36,"chapter":1,"verse":36,"label":"1.36","sanskrit":"निहत्य धार्तराष्ट्रान्नः का प्रीतिः स्याज्जनार्दन।\nपापमेवाश्रयेदस्मान्हत्वैतानाततायिनः।।1.36।।","transliteration":"nihatya dhārtarāṣhṭrān naḥ kā prītiḥ syāj janārdana\npāpam evāśhrayed asmān hatvaitān ātatāyinaḥ","english":"By killing these sons of Dhritarashtra, what pleasure could be ours, O Janardana? Only sin would accrue to us from killing these felons.","hindi":"।।1.36।। हे जनार्दन! इन धृतराष्ट्र-सम्बन्धियों को मारकर हमलोगों को क्या प्रसन्नता होगी? इन आततायियों को मारने से तो हमें पाप ही लगेगा।"},{"id":37,"chapter":1,"verse":37,"label":"1.37","sanskrit":"तस्मान्नार्हा वयं हन्तुं धार्तराष्ट्रान्स्वबान्धवान्।\nस्वजनं हि कथं हत्वा सुखिनः स्याम माधव।।1.37।।","transliteration":"tasmān nārhā vayaṁ hantuṁ dhārtarāṣhṭrān sa-bāndhavān\nsva-janaṁ hi kathaṁ hatvā sukhinaḥ syāma mādhava","english":"Therefore, we should not kill the sons of Dhritarashtra, our relatives; for how can we be happy by killing our own kin, O Madhava (Krishna)?","hindi":"।।1.37।। इसलिये अपने बान्धव इन धृतराष्ट्र-सम्बन्धियों को मारने के लिये हम योग्य नहीं हैं; क्योंकि हे माधव! कुल का नाश करने से होनेवाले दोष को ठीक-ठीक जाननेवाले हमलोग इस पाप से निवृत्त होने का विचार क्यों न करें?"},{"id":39,"chapter":1,"verse":39,"label":"1.39","sanskrit":"कथं न ज्ञेयमस्माभिः पापादस्मान्निवर्तितुम्।\nकुलक्षयकृतं दोषं प्रपश्यद्भिर्जनार्दन।।1.39।।","transliteration":"kathaṁ na jñeyam asmābhiḥ pāpād asmān nivartitum\nkula-kṣhaya-kṛitaṁ doṣhaṁ prapaśhyadbhir janārdana","english":"Why should we not, who clearly see the evil in the destruction of families, learn to turn away from this sin, O Janardana (Krishna)?","hindi":"।।1.38 -- 1.39।। यद्यपि लोभ के कारण जिनका विवेक-विचार लुप्त हो गया है, ऐसे ये (दुर्योधन आदि) कुल का नाश करने से होनेवाले दोष को और मित्रों के साथ द्वेष करने से होनेवाले पाप को नहीं देखते, (तो भी) हे जनार्दन! कुल का नाश करने से होनेवाले दोष को ठीक-ठीक जाननेवाले हमलोग इस पाप से निवृत्त होनेका विचार क्यों न करें?"},{"id":40,"chapter":1,"verse":40,"label":"1.40","sanskrit":"कुलक्षये प्रणश्यन्ति कुलधर्माः सनातनाः।\nधर्मे नष्टे कुलं कृत्स्नमधर्मोऽभिभवत्युत।।1.40।।","transliteration":"kula-kṣhaye praṇaśhyanti kula-dharmāḥ sanātanāḥ\ndharme naṣhṭe kulaṁ kṛitsnam adharmo ’bhibhavaty uta","english":"In the destruction of a family, the immemorial religious rites of that family perish; on the destruction of spirituality, impiety indeed, overwhelms the whole family.","hindi":"।।1.40।। कुल का क्षय होने पर सदा से चलते आये कुलधर्म नष्ट हो जाते हैं और धर्म का नाश होनेपर (बचे हुए) सम्पूर्ण कुल को अधर्म दबा लेता है।"},{"id":41,"chapter":1,"verse":41,"label":"1.41","sanskrit":"अधर्माभिभवात्कृष्ण प्रदुष्यन्ति कुलस्त्रियः।\nस्त्रीषु दुष्टासु वार्ष्णेय जायते वर्णसङ्करः।।1.41।।","transliteration":"adharmābhibhavāt kṛiṣhṇa praduṣhyanti kula-striyaḥ\nstrīṣhu duṣhṭāsu vārṣhṇeya jāyate varṇa-saṅkaraḥ","english":"O Krishna, by the prevalence of impiety, the women of the family become corrupt; and, when women are corrupted, O Varshenya (descendant of Vrishni), intermingling of castes arises.","hindi":"।।1.41।। हे कृष्ण! अधर्म के अधिक बढ़ जाने से कुल की स्त्रियाँ दूषित हो जाती हैं; (और) हे वार्ष्णेय! स्त्रियों के दूषित होने पर वर्णसंकर पैदा हो जाते हैं।"},{"id":42,"chapter":1,"verse":42,"label":"1.42","sanskrit":"सङ्करो नरकायैव कुलघ्नानां कुलस्य च।\nपतन्ति पितरो ह्येषां लुप्तपिण्डोदकक्रियाः।।1.42।।","transliteration":"saṅkaro narakāyaiva kula-ghnānāṁ kulasya cha\npatanti pitaro hy eṣhāṁ lupta-piṇḍodaka-kriyāḥ","english":"Confusion of castes leads to hell for the slayers of the family, for their forebears fall, deprived of the offerings of rice-balls and libations of water.","hindi":"।।1.42।। वर्णसंकर कुलघातियों को और कुल को नरक में ले जानेवाला ही होता है। श्राद्ध और तर्पण न मिलने से इन- (कुलघातियों-) के पितर भी अपने स्थान से गिर जाते हैं।"},{"id":43,"chapter":1,"verse":43,"label":"1.43","sanskrit":"दोषैरेतैः कुलघ्नानां वर्णसङ्करकारकैः।\nउत्साद्यन्ते जातिधर्माः कुलधर्माश्च शाश्वताः।।1.43।।","transliteration":"doṣhair etaiḥ kula-ghnānāṁ varṇa-saṅkara-kārakaiḥ\nutsādyante jāti-dharmāḥ kula-dharmāśh cha śhāśhvatāḥ","english":"By these evil deeds of the destroyers of the family, which cause confusion of castes, the eternal religious rites of the caste and the family are destroyed.","hindi":"।।1.43।। इन वर्णसंकर पैदा करनेवाले दोषोंसे कुलघातियों के सदा से चलते आये कुलधर्म और जातिधर्म नष्ट हो जाते हैं।"},{"id":44,"chapter":1,"verse":44,"label":"1.44","sanskrit":"उत्सन्नकुलधर्माणां मनुष्याणां जनार्दन।\nनरकेऽनियतं वासो भवतीत्यनुशुश्रुम।।1.44।।","transliteration":"utsanna-kula-dharmāṇāṁ manuṣhyāṇāṁ janārdana\nnarake ‘niyataṁ vāso bhavatītyanuśhuśhruma","english":"We have heard, O Janardana, that those men in whose families the religious practices have been destroyed are inevitably destined to dwell in hell for an unknown period.","hindi":"।।1.44।। हे जनार्दन! जिनके कुलधर्म नष्ट हो जाते हैं, उन मनुष्यों का बहुत काल तक नरकों में वापस होता है, ऐसा हम सुनते आये हैं।"},{"id":45,"chapter":1,"verse":45,"label":"1.45","sanskrit":"अहो बत महत्पापं कर्तुं व्यवसिता वयम्।\nयद्राज्यसुखलोभेन हन्तुं स्वजनमुद्यताः।।1.45।।","transliteration":"aho bata mahat pāpaṁ kartuṁ vyavasitā vayam\nyad rājya-sukha-lobhena hantuṁ sva-janam udyatāḥ","english":"Alas! We are involved in a great sin, for we are prepared to kill our kinsmen, out of greed for the pleasures of a kingdom.","hindi":"।।1.45।। यह बड़े आश्चर्य और खेद की बात है कि हमलोग बड़ा भारी पाप करने का निश्चय कर बैठे हैं, जो कि राज्य और सुख के लोभ से अपने स्वजनों को मारने के लिये तैयार हो गये हैं!"},{"id":46,"chapter":1,"verse":46,"label":"1.46","sanskrit":"यदि मामप्रतीकारमशस्त्रं शस्त्रपाणयः।\nधार्तराष्ट्रा रणे हन्युस्तन्मे क्षेमतरं भवेत्।।1.46।।","transliteration":"yadi mām apratīkāram aśhastraṁ śhastra-pāṇayaḥ\ndhārtarāṣhṭrā raṇe hanyus tan me kṣhemataraṁ bhavet","english":"If the sons of Dhritarashtra, with weapons in hand, should slay me in battle, unresisting and unarmed, that would be better for me.","hindi":"।।1.46।। अगर ये हाथों में शस्त्र-अस्त्र लिये हुए धृतराष्ट्र के पक्षपाती लोग युद्धभूमि में सामना न करनेवाले तथा शस्त्ररहित मुझ को मार भी दें, तो वह मेरे लिये बड़ा ही हितकारक होगा।"},{"id":47,"chapter":1,"verse":47,"label":"1.47","sanskrit":"सञ्जय उवाच\nएवमुक्त्वाऽर्जुनः संख्ये रथोपस्थ उपाविशत्।\nविसृज्य सशरं चापं शोकसंविग्नमानसः।।1.47।।","transliteration":"sañjaya uvācha\nevam uktvārjunaḥ saṅkhye rathopastha upāviśhat\nvisṛijya sa-śharaṁ chāpaṁ śhoka-saṁvigna-mānasaḥ","english":"Sanjaya said, Having thus spoken in the midst of the battlefield, Arjuna cast away his bow and arrow and, his mind overwhelmed with sorrow, sat down on the seat of the chariot.","hindi":"।।1.47।। संजय बोले - ऐसा कहकर शोकाकुल मनवाले अर्जुन बाणसहित धनुष का त्याग करके युद्धभूमि में रथके मध्यभाग में बैठ गये।"},{"id":48,"chapter":2,"verse":1,"label":"2.1","sanskrit":"सञ्जय उवाच\nतं तथा कृपयाऽविष्टमश्रुपूर्णाकुलेक्षणम्।\nविषीदन्तमिदं वाक्यमुवाच मधुसूदनः।।2.1।।","transliteration":"sañjaya uvācha\ntaṁ tathā kṛipayāviṣhṭamaśhru pūrṇākulekṣhaṇam\nviṣhīdantamidaṁ vākyam uvācha madhusūdanaḥ","english":"Sanjaya said: To him, who was thus overcome with pity, despondent, with eyes full of tears and agitated, Madhusudana (the destroyer of Madhu) or Krishna spoke these words.","hindi":"।।2.1।। संजय बोले - वैसी कायरता से आविष्ट उन अर्जुन के प्रति, जो कि विषाद कर रहे हैं और आँसुओं के कारण जिनके नेत्रों की देखने की शक्ति अवरुद्ध हो रही है, भगवान् मधुसूदन ये (आगे कहे जानेवाले) वचन बोले।"},{"id":49,"chapter":2,"verse":2,"label":"2.2","sanskrit":"श्री भगवानुवाच\nकुतस्त्वा कश्मलमिदं विषमे समुपस्थितम्।\nअनार्यजुष्टमस्वर्ग्यमकीर्तिकरमर्जुन।।2.2।।","transliteration":"śhrī bhagavān uvācha\nkutastvā kaśhmalamidaṁ viṣhame samupasthitam\nanārya-juṣhṭamaswargyam akīrti-karam arjuna","english":"The Blessed Lord said, \"From whence has this perilous strait come upon you, this dejection which is unworthy of you, disgraceful, and which will close the gates of heaven upon you, O Arjuna?\"","hindi":"।।2.2।। श्रीभगवान् बोले (टिप्पणी प0 38.1) - हे अर्जुन! इस विषम अवसरपर तुम्हें यह कायरता कहाँसे प्राप्त हुई, जिसका कि श्रेष्ठ पुरुष सेवन नहीं करते, जो स्वर्गको देनेवाली नहीं है और कीर्ति करनेवाली भी नहीं है।"},{"id":50,"chapter":2,"verse":3,"label":"2.3","sanskrit":"क्लैब्यं मा स्म गमः पार्थ नैतत्त्वय्युपपद्यते।\nक्षुद्रं हृदयदौर्बल्यं त्यक्त्वोत्तिष्ठ परन्तप।।2.3।।","transliteration":"klaibyaṁ mā sma gamaḥ pārtha naitat tvayyupapadyate\nkṣhudraṁ hṛidaya-daurbalyaṁ tyaktvottiṣhṭha parantapa","english":"Do not yield to impotence, O Arjuna, son of Pritha. It does not befit you. Cast off this mean weakness of the heart! Stand up, O conqueror of foes!","hindi":"।।2.3।। हे पृथानन्दन अर्जुन ! इस नपुंसकताको मत प्राप्त हो; क्योंकि तुम्हारेमें यह उचित नहीं है। हे परंतप ! हृदयकी इस तुच्छ दुर्बलताका त्याग करके युद्धके लिये खड़े हो जाओ।"},{"id":51,"chapter":2,"verse":4,"label":"2.4","sanskrit":"अर्जुन उवाच\nकथं भीष्ममहं संख्ये द्रोणं च मधुसूदन।\nइषुभिः प्रतियोत्स्यामि पूजार्हावरिसूदन।।2.4।।","transliteration":"arjuna uvācha\nkathaṁ bhīṣhmam ahaṁ sankhye droṇaṁ cha madhusūdana\niṣhubhiḥ pratiyotsyāmi pūjārhāvari-sūdana","english":"Arjuna said, \"O Madhusudana, how can I fight in battle with arrows against Bhishma and Drona, who are worthy of being worshipped, O destroyer of enemies?\"","hindi":"।।2.4।। अर्जुन बोले - हे मधुसूदन! मैं रणभूमिमें भीष्म और द्रोणके साथ बाणोंसे युद्ध कैसे करूँ? क्योंकि हे अरिसूदन! ये दोनों ही पूजाके योग्य हैं।"},{"id":52,"chapter":2,"verse":5,"label":"2.5","sanskrit":"गुरूनहत्वा हि महानुभावान्\nश्रेयो भोक्तुं भैक्ष्यमपीह लोके।\nहत्वार्थकामांस्तु गुरूनिहैव\nभुञ्जीय भोगान् रुधिरप्रदिग्धान्।।2.5।।","transliteration":"gurūnahatvā hi mahānubhāvān\nśhreyo bhoktuṁ bhaikṣhyamapīha loke\nhatvārtha-kāmāṁstu gurūnihaiva\nbhuñjīya bhogān rudhira-pradigdhān","english":"Better it is, indeed, in this world to accept alms than to slay the most noble teachers. But if I were to kill them, even in this world, all my enjoyments of wealth and fulfilled desires would be stained with their blood.","hindi":"।।2.5।। महानुभाव गुरुजनोंको न मारकर इस लोकमें मैं भिक्षाका अन्न खाना भी श्रेष्ठ समझता हूँ। क्योंकि गुरुजनोंको मारकर यहाँ रक्तसे सने हुए तथा धनकी कामनाकी मुख्यतावाले भोगोंको ही तो भोगूँगा!"},{"id":53,"chapter":2,"verse":6,"label":"2.6","sanskrit":"न चैतद्विद्मः कतरन्नो गरीयो\nयद्वा जयेम यदि वा नो जयेयुः।\nयानेव हत्वा न जिजीविषाम\nस्तेऽवस्थिताः प्रमुखे धार्तराष्ट्राः।।2.6।।","transliteration":"na chaitadvidmaḥ kataranno garīyo\nyadvā jayema yadi vā no jayeyuḥ\nyāneva hatvā na jijīviṣhāmas\nte ’vasthitāḥ pramukhe dhārtarāṣhṭrāḥ","english":"I can hardly tell which would be better, that we should conquer them or that they should conquer us. Even the sons of Dhritarashtra, whom we do not wish to slay, stand facing us.","hindi":"।।2.6।। हम यह भी नहीं जानते कि हमलोगोंके लिये युद्ध करना और न करना - इन दोनोंमेंसे कौन-सा अत्यन्त श्रेष्ठ है; और हमें इसका भी पता नहीं है कि हम उन्हें जीतेंगे अथवा वे हमें जीतेंगे। जिनको मारकर हम जीना भी नहीं चाहते, वे ही धृतराष्ट्रके सम्बन्धी हमारे सामने खड़े हैं।"},{"id":54,"chapter":2,"verse":7,"label":"2.7","sanskrit":"कार्पण्यदोषोपहतस्वभावः\nपृच्छामि त्वां धर्मसंमूढचेताः।\nयच्छ्रेयः स्यान्निश्िचतं ब्रूहि तन्मे\nशिष्यस्तेऽहं शाधि मां त्वां प्रपन्नम्।।2.7।।","transliteration":"kārpaṇya-doṣhopahata-svabhāvaḥ\npṛichchhāmi tvāṁ dharma-sammūḍha-chetāḥ\nyach-chhreyaḥ syānniśhchitaṁ brūhi tanme\nśhiṣhyaste ’haṁ śhādhi māṁ tvāṁ prapannam","english":"My heart is overpowered by the taint of pity; my mind is confused as to my duty. Therefore, knowing this to be so, you should not grieve.","hindi":"।।2.25।। यह देही प्रत्यक्ष नहीं दीखता, यह चिन्तनका विषय नहीं है और यह निर्विकार कहा जाता है। अतः इस देहीको ऐसा जानकर शोक नहीं करना चाहिये।"},{"id":73,"chapter":2,"verse":26,"label":"2.26","sanskrit":"अथ चैनं नित्यजातं नित्यं वा मन्यसे मृतम्।\nतथापि त्वं महाबाहो नैवं शोचितुमर्हसि।।2.26।।","transliteration":"atha chainaṁ nitya-jātaṁ nityaṁ vā manyase mṛitam\ntathāpi tvaṁ mahā-bāho naivaṁ śhochitum arhasi","english":"But even if thou thinkest of It as constantly being born and constantly dying, even then, O mighty-armed one, thou shouldst not grieve.","hindi":"।।2.26।। हे महाबाहो ! अगर तुम इस देहीको नित्य पैदा होनेवाला अथवा नित्य मरनेवाला भी मानो, तो भी तुम्हें इस प्रकार शोक नहीं करना चाहिये।"},{"id":74,"chapter":2,"verse":27,"label":"2.27","sanskrit":"जातस्य हि ध्रुवो मृत्युर्ध्रुवं जन्म मृतस्य च।\nतस्मादपरिहार्येऽर्थे न त्वं शोचितुमर्हसि।।2.27।।","transliteration":"jātasya hi dhruvo mṛityur dhruvaṁ janma mṛitasya cha\ntasmād aparihārye ’rthe na tvaṁ śhochitum arhasi","english":"For the born, death is certain, and for the dead, birth is certain; therefore, you should not grieve over the inevitable.","hindi":"।।2.27।। क्योंकि पैदा हुएकी जरूर मृत्यु होगी और मरे हुएका जरूर जन्म होगा। इस (जन्म-मरण-रूप परिवर्तन के प्रवाह) का परिहार अर्थात् निवारण नहीं हो सकता। अतः इस विषयमें तुम्हें शोक नहीं करना चाहिये।"},{"id":75,"chapter":2,"verse":28,"label":"2.28","sanskrit":"अव्यक्तादीनि भूतानि व्यक्तमध्यानि भारत।\nअव्यक्तनिधनान्येव तत्र का परिदेवना।।2.28।।","transliteration":"avyaktādīni bhūtāni vyakta-madhyāni bhārata\navyakta-nidhanānyeva tatra kā paridevanā","english":"Beings are unmanifest in their beginning, manifest in their middle state, O Arjuna, and unmanifest again in their end. What is there to grieve about?","hindi":"।।2.28।। हे भारत ! सभी प्राणी जन्मसे पहले अप्रकट थे और मरनेके बाद अप्रकट हो जायँगे, केवल बीचमें ही प्रकट दीखते हैं। अतः इसमें शोक करनेकी बात ही क्या है?"},{"id":76,"chapter":2,"verse":29,"label":"2.29","sanskrit":"आश्चर्यवत्पश्यति कश्चिदेन\nमाश्चर्यवद्वदति तथैव चान्यः।\nआश्चर्यवच्चैनमन्यः श्रृणोति\nश्रुत्वाप्येनं वेद न चैव कश्चित्।।2.29।।","transliteration":"āśhcharya-vat paśhyati kaśhchid enan\nāśhcharya-vad vadati tathaiva chānyaḥ\nāśhcharya-vach chainam anyaḥ śhṛiṇoti\nśhrutvāpyenaṁ veda na chaiva kaśhchit","english":"One sees this (the Self) as a wonder; another speaks of it as a wonder; another hears of it as a wonder; yet, having heard, none understands it at all.","hindi":"।।2.29।। कोई इस शरीरीको आश्चर्यकी तरह देखता है और वैसे ही अन्य कोई इसका आश्चर्यकी तरह वर्णन करता है तथा अन्य कोई इसको आश्चर्यकी तरह सुनता है; और इसको सुनकर भी कोई नहीं जानता। अर्थात यह शरीरी दुर्विज्ञेय है।"},{"id":77,"chapter":2,"verse":30,"label":"2.30","sanskrit":"देही नित्यमवध्योऽयं देहे सर्वस्य भारत।\nतस्मात्सर्वाणि भूतानि न त्वं शोचितुमर्हसि।।2.30।।","transliteration":"dehī nityam avadhyo ’yaṁ dehe sarvasya bhārata\ntasmāt sarvāṇi bhūtāni na tvaṁ śhochitum arhasi","english":"This indweller in the body of everyone is ever indestructible, O Arjuna; therefore, you should not grieve for any creature.","hindi":"।।2.30।। हे भरतवंशोद्भव अर्जुन! सबके देहमें यह देही नित्य ही अवध्य है। इसलिये सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंके लिये अर्थात् किसी भी प्राणीके लिये तुम्हें शोक नहीं करना चाहिये।"},{"id":78,"chapter":2,"verse":31,"label":"2.31","sanskrit":"स्वधर्ममपि चावेक्ष्य न विकम्पितुमर्हसि।\nधर्म्याद्धि युद्धाछ्रेयोऽन्यत्क्षत्रियस्य न विद्यते।।2.31।।","transliteration":"swa-dharmam api chāvekṣhya na vikampitum arhasi\ndharmyāddhi yuddhāch chhreyo ’nyat kṣhatriyasya na vidyate","english":"Further, having regard to your duty, you should not waver, for there is nothing higher for a Kshatriya than a righteous war.","hindi":"।।2.31।। अपने स्वधर्म (क्षात्रधर्म) को देखकर भी तुम्हें विकम्पित अर्थात् कर्तव्य-कर्मसे विचलित नहीं होना चाहिये; क्योंकि धर्ममय युद्धसे बढ़कर क्षत्रियके लिये दूसरा कोई कल्याणकारक कर्म नहीं है।"},{"id":79,"chapter":2,"verse":32,"label":"2.32","sanskrit":"यदृच्छया चोपपन्नं स्वर्गद्वारमपावृतम्।\nसुखिनः क्षत्रियाः पार्थ लभन्ते युद्धमीदृशम्।।2.32।।","transliteration":"yadṛichchhayā chopapannaṁ swarga-dvāram apāvṛitam\nsukhinaḥ kṣhatriyāḥ pārtha labhante yuddham īdṛiśham","english":"Happy are the Kshatriyas, O Arjuna! who are called to fight in such a battle that comes of its own accord as an open door to heaven.","hindi":"।।2.32।। अपने-आप प्राप्त हुआ युद्ध खुला हुआ स्वर्गका दरवाजा भी है। हे पृथानन्दन ! वे क्षत्रिय बड़े सुखी (भाग्यशाली) हैं, जिनको ऐसा युद्ध प्राप्त होता है।"},{"id":80,"chapter":2,"verse":33,"label":"2.33","sanskrit":"अथ चैत्त्वमिमं धर्म्यं संग्रामं न करिष्यसि।\nततः स्वधर्मं कीर्तिं च हित्वा पापमवाप्स्यसि।।2.33।।","transliteration":"atha chet tvam imaṁ dharmyaṁ saṅgrāmaṁ na kariṣhyasi\ntataḥ sva-dharmaṁ kīrtiṁ cha hitvā pāpam avāpsyasi","english":"But if you will not fight this righteous war, then having abandoned your own duty and reputation, you will incur sin.","hindi":"।।2.33।। अब अगर तू यह धर्ममय युद्ध नहीं करेगा, तो अपने धर्म और कीर्तिका त्याग करके पापको प्राप्त होगा।"},{"id":81,"chapter":2,"verse":34,"label":"2.34","sanskrit":"अकीर्तिं चापि भूतानि कथयिष्यन्ति तेऽव्ययाम्।\nसंभावितस्य चाकीर्तिर्मरणादतिरिच्यते।।2.34।।","transliteration":"akīrtiṁ chāpi bhūtāni\nkathayiṣhyanti te ’vyayām\nsambhāvitasya chākīrtir\nmaraṇād atirichyate","english":"People will also recount your everlasting dishonor; and for one who has been honored, dishonor is worse than death.","hindi":"।।2.34।। और सब प्राणी भी तेरी सदा रहनेवाली अपकीर्तिका कथन अर्थात निंदा करेंगे। वह अपकीर्ति सम्मानित मनुष्यके लिये मृत्युसे भी बढ़कर दुःखदायी होती है।"},{"id":82,"chapter":2,"verse":35,"label":"2.35","sanskrit":"भयाद्रणादुपरतं मंस्यन्ते त्वां महारथाः।\nयेषां च त्वं बहुमतो भूत्वा यास्यसि लाघवम्।।2.35।।","transliteration":"bhayād raṇād uparataṁ mansyante tvāṁ mahā-rathāḥ\nyeṣhāṁ cha tvaṁ bahu-mato bhūtvā yāsyasi lāghavam","english":"The great chariot-warriors will think that you have withdrawn from the battle out of fear, and you will be held in low esteem by those who have held you in high regard.","hindi":"।।2.35।। महारथीलोग तुझे भयके कारण युद्धसे उपरत (हटा) हुआ मानेंगे। जिनकी धारणामें तू बहुमान्य हो चुका है, उनकी दृष्टिमें तू लघुताको प्राप्त हो जायगा।"},{"id":83,"chapter":2,"verse":36,"label":"2.36","sanskrit":"अवाच्यवादांश्च बहून् वदिष्यन्ति तवाहिताः।\nनिन्दन्तस्तव सामर्थ्यं ततो दुःखतरं नु किम्।।2.36।।","transliteration":"avāchya-vādānśh cha bahūn vadiṣhyanti tavāhitāḥ\nnindantastava sāmarthyaṁ tato duḥkhataraṁ nu kim","english":"Your enemies, scoffing at your power, will speak many abusive words—what could be more painful than this?","hindi":"।।2.36।। तेरे शत्रुलोग तेरी सार्मथ्यकी निन्दा करते हुए न कहनेयोग्य बहुत-से वचन भी कहेंगे। उससे बढ़कर और दुःखकी बात क्या होगी?"},{"id":84,"chapter":2,"verse":37,"label":"2.37","sanskrit":"हतो वा प्राप्स्यसि स्वर्गं जित्वा वा भोक्ष्यसे महीम्।\nतस्मादुत्तिष्ठ कौन्तेय युद्धाय कृतनिश्चयः।।2.37।।","transliteration":"hato vā prāpsyasi swargaṁ jitvā vā bhokṣhyase mahīm\ntasmād uttiṣhṭha kaunteya yuddhāya kṛita-niśhchayaḥ","english":"Slain, you will obtain heaven; victorious, you will enjoy the earth; therefore, stand up, O son of Kunti, resolved to fight.","hindi":"।।2.37।। अगर युद्धमें तू मारा जायगा तो तुझे स्वर्गकी प्राप्ति होगी और अगर युद्धमें तू जीत जायगा तो पृथ्वीका राज्य भोगेगा। अतः हे कुन्तीनन्दन! तू युद्धके लिये निश्चय करके खड़ा हो जा।"},{"id":85,"chapter":2,"verse":38,"label":"2.38","sanskrit":"सुखदुःखे समे कृत्वा लाभालाभौ जयाजयौ।\nततो युद्धाय युज्यस्व नैवं पापमवाप्स्यसि।।2.38।।","transliteration":"sukha-duḥkhe same kṛitvā lābhālābhau jayājayau\ntato yuddhāya yujyasva naivaṁ pāpam avāpsyasi","english":"Having made pleasure and pain, gain and loss, victory and defeat equal, engage in battle for the sake of battle; thus, you shall not incur sin.","hindi":"।।2.38।। जय-पराजय, लाभ-हानि और सुख-दुःखको समान करके फिर युद्धमें लग जा। इस प्रकार युद्ध करनेसे तू पापको प्राप्त नहीं होगा।"},{"id":86,"chapter":2,"verse":39,"label":"2.39","sanskrit":"एषा तेऽभिहिता सांख्ये बुद्धिर्योगे त्विमां श्रृणु।\nबुद्ध्यायुक्तो यया पार्थ कर्मबन्धं प्रहास्यसि।।2.39।।","transliteration":"eṣhā te ’bhihitā sānkhye\nbuddhir yoge tvimāṁ śhṛiṇu\nbuddhyā yukto yayā pārtha\nkarma-bandhaṁ prahāsyasi","english":"This, which has been taught to you, is wisdom concerning Sankhya. Now listen to wisdom concerning Yoga, endowed with which, O Arjuna, you shall cast off the bonds of action.","hindi":"।।2.39।। हे पार्थ! यह समबुद्धि तेरे लिए पहले सांख्ययोगमें कही गयी, अब तू इसको कर्मयोगके विषयमें सुन; जिस समबुद्धिसे युक्त हुआ तू कर्मबन्धनका त्याग कर देगा।"},{"id":87,"chapter":2,"verse":40,"label":"2.40","sanskrit":"नेहाभिक्रमनाशोऽस्ति प्रत्यवायो न विद्यते।\nस्वल्पमप्यस्य धर्मस्य त्रायते महतो भयात्।।2.40।।","transliteration":"nehābhikrama-nāśho ’sti pratyavāyo na vidyate\nsvalpam apyasya dharmasya trāyate mahato bhayāt","english":"In this, there is no loss of effort, nor is there any harm produced, nor any transgression. Even a little of this knowledge protects one from great fear.","hindi":"।।2.40।। मनुष्यलोकमें इस समबुद्धिरूप धर्मके आरम्भका नाश नहीं होता, इसके अनुष्ठानका उलटा फल भी नहीं होता और इसका थोड़ासा भी अनुष्ठान (जन्म-मरणरूप) महान् भयसे रक्षा कर लेता है।"},{"id":88,"chapter":2,"verse":41,"label":"2.41","sanskrit":"व्यवसायात्मिका बुद्धिरेकेह कुरुनन्दन।\nबहुशाखा ह्यनन्ताश्च बुद्धयोऽव्यवसायिनाम्।।2.41।।","transliteration":"vyavasāyātmikā buddhir ekeha kuru-nandana\nbahu-śhākhā hyanantāśh cha buddhayo ’vyavasāyinām","english":"Here, O joy of the Kurus, there is only one single-pointed determination; many-branched and endless are the thoughts of the indecisive.","hindi":"।।2.41।। हे कुरुनन्दन! nor does he attain perfection by mere renunciation.","hindi":"।।3.4।। मनुष्य न तो कर्मोंका आरम्भ किये बिना निष्कर्मताको प्राप्त होता है और न कर्मोंके त्यागमात्रसे सिद्धिको ही प्राप्त होता है।"},{"id":124,"chapter":3,"verse":5,"label":"3.5","sanskrit":"न हि कश्िचत्क्षणमपि जातु तिष्ठत्यकर्मकृत्।\nकार्यते ह्यवशः कर्म सर्वः प्रकृतिजैर्गुणैः।।3.5।।","transliteration":"na hi kaśhchit kṣhaṇam api jātu tiṣhṭhatyakarma-kṛit\nkāryate hyavaśhaḥ karma sarvaḥ prakṛiti-jair guṇaiḥ","english":"Verily, no one can remain for even a moment without performing action; for everyone is made to act helplessly, indeed, by the qualities born of Nature.","hindi":"।।3.5।। कोई भी मनुष्य किसी भी अवस्थामें क्षणमात्र भी कर्म किये बिना नहीं रह सकता; क्योंकि (प्रकृतिके) परवश हुए सब प्राणियोंसे प्रकृतिजन्य गुण कर्म कराते हैं।"},{"id":125,"chapter":3,"verse":6,"label":"3.6","sanskrit":"कर्मेन्द्रियाणि संयम्य य आस्ते मनसा स्मरन्।\nइन्द्रियार्थान्विमूढात्मा मिथ्याचारः स उच्यते।।3.6।।","transliteration":"karmendriyāṇi sanyamya ya āste manasā smaran\nindriyārthān vimūḍhātmā mithyāchāraḥ sa uchyate","english":"He who, restraining the organs of action, sits thinking of the sense-objects in his mind, he of deluded understanding is called a hypocrite.","hindi":"।।3.6।। जो कर्मेन्द्रियों- (सम्पूर्ण इन्द्रियों-) को हठपूर्वक रोककर मनसे इन्द्रियोंके विषयोंका चिन्तन करता रहता है, वह मूढ़ बुद्धिवाला मनुष्य मिथ्याचारी (मिथ्या आचरण करनेवाला) कहा जाता है।"},{"id":126,"chapter":3,"verse":7,"label":"3.7","sanskrit":"यस्त्विन्द्रियाणि मनसा नियम्यारभतेऽर्जुन।\nकर्मेन्द्रियैः कर्मयोगमसक्तः स विशिष्यते।।3.7।।","transliteration":"yas tvindriyāṇi manasā niyamyārabhate ’rjuna\nkarmendriyaiḥ karma-yogam asaktaḥ sa viśhiṣhyate","english":"But whoever, controlling the senses by the mind, O Arjuna, engages himself in Karma Yoga with the organs of action, without attachment, he excels.","hindi":"।।3.7।। हे अर्जुन! जो मनुष्य मनसे इन्द्रियोंपर नियन्त्रण करके आसक्तिरहित होकर (निष्काम भावसे) समस्त इन्द्रियोंके द्वारा कर्मयोगका आचरण करता है, वही श्रेष्ठ है।"},{"id":127,"chapter":3,"verse":8,"label":"3.8","sanskrit":"नियतं कुरु कर्म त्वं कर्म ज्यायो ह्यकर्मणः।\nशरीरयात्रापि च ते न प्रसिद्ध्येदकर्मणः।।3.8।।","transliteration":"niyataṁ kuru karma tvaṁ karma jyāyo hyakarmaṇaḥ\nśharīra-yātrāpi cha te na prasiddhyed akarmaṇaḥ","english":"Perform your bounden duty, for action is superior to inaction, and even the maintenance of the body would not be possible for you through inaction.","hindi":"।।3.8।। तू शास्त्रविधिसे नियत किये हुए कर्तव्य-कर्म कर; do thou, therefore, O son of Kunti (Arjuna), perform actions for that sake alone, free from attachment.","hindi":"।।3.9।। यज्ञ (कर्तव्यपालन) के लिये किये जानेवाले कर्मोंसे अन्यत्र (अपने लिये किये जानेवाले) कर्मोंमें लगा हुआ यह मनुष्य-समुदाय कर्मोंसे बँधता है, इसलिये हे कुन्तीनन्दन ! तू आसक्ति-रहित होकर उस यज्ञके लिये ही कर्तव्य-कर्म कर।"},{"id":129,"chapter":3,"verse":10,"label":"3.10","sanskrit":"सहयज्ञाः प्रजाः सृष्ट्वा पुरोवाच प्रजापतिः।\nअनेन प्रसविष्यध्वमेष वोऽस्त्विष्टकामधुक्।।3.10।।","transliteration":"saha-yajñāḥ prajāḥ sṛiṣhṭvā purovācha prajāpatiḥ\nanena prasaviṣhyadhvam eṣha vo ’stviṣhṭa-kāma-dhuk","english":"The Creator, having in the beginning created mankind together with sacrifice, said, \"By this shall you propagate; let this be the milch cow of your desires—the cow that yields all the desired objects.\"","hindi":"।।3.10 -- 3.11।। प्रजापति ब्रह्माजीने सृष्टिके आदिकालमें कर्तव्य-कर्मोंके विधानसहित प्रजा-(मनुष्य आदि-) की रचना करके उनसे (प्रधानतया मनुष्योंसे) कहा कि तुमलोग इस कर्तव्यके द्वारा सबकी वृद्धि करो और वह कर्तव्य-कर्म-रूप यज्ञ तुमलोगोंको कर्तव्य-पालनकी आवश्यक सामग्री प्रदान करनेवाला हो। अपने कर्तव्य-कर्मके द्वारा तुमलोग देवताओंको उन्नत करो और वे देवतालोग अपने कर्तव्यके द्वारा तुमलोगोंको उन्नत करें। इस प्रकार एक-दूसरेको उन्नत करते हुए तुमलोग परम कल्याणको प्राप्त हो जाओगे।"},{"id":130,"chapter":3,"verse":11,"label":"3.11","sanskrit":"देवान्भावयतानेन ते देवा भावयन्तु वः।\nपरस्परं भावयन्तः श्रेयः परमवाप्स्यथ।।3.11।।","transliteration":"devān bhāvayatānena te devā bhāvayantu vaḥ\nparasparaṁ bhāvayantaḥ śhreyaḥ param avāpsyatha","english":"With this, nourish the gods, and may the gods nourish you; So, he who enjoys the objects given by the gods without offering anything in return is indeed a thief.","hindi":"।।3.12।। यज्ञसे भावित (पुष्ट) हुए देवता भी तुमलोगोंको (बिना माँगे ही) कर्तव्य-पालनकी आवश्यक सामग्री देते रहेंगे। इस प्रकार उन देवताओंसे प्राप्त हुई सामग्रीको दूसरोंकी सेवामें लगाये बिना जो मनुष्य स्वयं ही उसका उपभोग करता है, वह चोर ही है।"},{"id":132,"chapter":3,"verse":13,"label":"3.13","sanskrit":"यज्ञशिष्टाशिनः सन्तो मुच्यन्ते सर्वकिल्बिषैः।\nभुञ्जते ते त्वघं पापा ये पचन्त्यात्मकारणात्।।3.13।।","transliteration":"yajña-śhiṣhṭāśhinaḥ santo muchyante sarva-kilbiṣhaiḥ\nbhuñjate te tvaghaṁ pāpā ye pachantyātma-kāraṇāt","english":"The righteous who eat the remnants of the sacrifice are freed from all sins; from rain, food is produced; from sacrifice arises rain, and sacrifice is born of action.","hindi":"।।3.14 -- 3.15।। सम्पूर्ण प्राणी अन्नसे उत्पन्न होते हैं। अन्न वर्षासे होती है। वर्षा यज्ञसे होती है। यज्ञ कर्मोंसे निष्पन्न होता है। कर्मोंको तू वेदसे उत्पन्न जान और वेदको अक्षरब्रह्मसे प्रकट हुआ जान। इसलिये वह सर्वव्यापी परमात्मा यज्ञ (कर्तव्य-कर्म) में नित्य प्रतिष्ठित है।"},{"id":134,"chapter":3,"verse":15,"label":"3.15","sanskrit":"कर्म ब्रह्मोद्भवं विद्धि ब्रह्माक्षरसमुद्भवम्।\nतस्मात्सर्वगतं ब्रह्म नित्यं यज्ञे प्रतिष्ठितम्।।3.15।।","transliteration":"karma brahmodbhavaṁ viddhi brahmākṣhara-samudbhavam\ntasmāt sarva-gataṁ brahma nityaṁ yajñe pratiṣhṭhitam","english":"Know that action comes from Brahma, and Brahma comes from the Imperishable. Better is death in one's own duty; the duty of another is fraught with fear.","hindi":"।।3.35।। अच्छी तरह आचरणमें लाये हुए दूसरेके धर्मसे गुणोंकी कमीवाला अपना धर्म श्रेष्ठ है। अपने धर्ममें तो मरना भी कल्याणकारक है और दूसरेका धर्म भयको देनेवाला है।"},{"id":155,"chapter":3,"verse":36,"label":"3.36","sanskrit":"अर्जुन उवाच\nअथ केन प्रयुक्तोऽयं पापं चरति पूरुषः।\nअनिच्छन्नपि वार्ष्णेय बलादिव नियोजितः।।3.36।।","transliteration":"arjuna uvācha\natha kena prayukto ’yaṁ pāpaṁ charati pūruṣhaḥ\nanichchhann api vārṣhṇeya balād iva niyojitaḥ","english":"Arjuna said, \"But what compels man to commit sin, even against his wishes, O Varshneya (Krishna), as if constrained by force?\"","hindi":"।।3.36।। अर्जुन बोले - हे वार्ष्णेय ! इस अग्निके समान कभी तृप्त न होनेवाले और विवेकियोंके नित्य वैरी इस कामके द्वारा मनुष्यका विवेक ढका हुआ है।"},{"id":159,"chapter":3,"verse":40,"label":"3.40","sanskrit":"इन्द्रियाणि मनो बुद्धिरस्याधिष्ठानमुच्यते।\nएतैर्विमोहयत्येष ज्ञानमावृत्य देहिनम्।।3.40।।","transliteration":"indriyāṇi mano buddhir asyādhiṣhṭhānam uchyate\netair vimohayatyeṣha jñānam āvṛitya dehinam","english":"The senses, the mind, and the intellect are said to be its seat; through these, it deludes the embodied one, veiling their wisdom.","hindi":"।।3.40।। इन्द्रियाँ, मन और बुद्धि इस कामके वास-स्थान कहे गये हैं। यह काम इन- (इन्द्रियाँ, मन और बुद्धि-) के द्वारा ज्ञानको ढककर देहाभिमानी मनुष्यको मोहित करता है।"},{"id":160,"chapter":3,"verse":41,"label":"3.41","sanskrit":"तस्मात्त्वमिन्द्रियाण्यादौ नियम्य भरतर्षभ।\nपाप्मानं प्रजहि ह्येनं ज्ञानविज्ञाननाशनम्।।3.41।।","transliteration":"tasmāt tvam indriyāṇyādau niyamya bharatarṣhabha\npāpmānaṁ prajahi hyenaṁ jñāna-vijñāna-nāśhanam","english":"Therefore, O best of the Bharatas, control your senses first and then kill this sinful thing, which destroys knowledge and realization.","hindi":"।।3.41।। इसलिये हे भरतवंशियोंमें श्रेष्ठ अर्जुन ! तू सबसे पहले इन्द्रियोंको वशमें करके इस ज्ञान और विज्ञानका नाश करनेवाले महान् पापी कामको अवश्य ही बलपूर्वक मार डाल।"},{"id":161,"chapter":3,"verse":42,"label":"3.42","sanskrit":"इन्द्रियाणि पराण्याहुरिन्द्रियेभ्यः परं मनः।\nमनसस्तु परा बुद्धिर्यो बुद्धेः परतस्तु सः।।3.42।।","transliteration":"indriyāṇi parāṇyāhur indriyebhyaḥ paraṁ manaḥ\nmanasas tu parā buddhir yo buddheḥ paratas tu saḥ","english":"They say that the senses are superior to the body; the mind is superior to the senses; the intellect is superior to the mind; and He (the Self) is superior even to the intellect.","hindi":"।।3.42 -- 3.43।। इन्द्रियोंको (स्थूलशरीरसे) पर (श्रेष्ठ, सबल, प्रकाशक, व्यापक तथा सूक्ष्म) कहते हैं। इन्द्रियोंसे पर मन है, मनसे भी पर बुद्धि है औऱ जो बुद्धिसे भी पर है, वह (काम) है। इस तरह बुद्धिसे पर - (काम-) को जानकर अपने द्वारा अपने-आपको वशमें करके हे महाबाहो ! तू इस कामरूप दुर्जय शत्रुको मार डाल।"},{"id":162,"chapter":3,"verse":43,"label":"3.43","sanskrit":"एवं बुद्धेः परं बुद्ध्वा संस्तभ्यात्मानमात्मना।\nजहि शत्रुं महाबाहो कामरूपं दुरासदम्।।3.43।।","transliteration":"evaṁ buddheḥ paraṁ buddhvā sanstabhyātmānam ātmanā\njahi śhatruṁ mahā-bāho kāma-rūpaṁ durāsadam","english":"Thus, knowing Him who is superior to the intellect and restraining the self by the Self, slay thou, O mighty-armed Arjuna, the enemy in the form of desire, hard to conquer.","hindi":"।।3.42 -- 3.43।। इन्द्रियोंको (स्थूलशरीरसे) पर (श्रेष्ठ, सबल, प्रकाशक, व्यापक तथा सूक्ष्म) कहते हैं। इन्द्रियोंसे पर मन है, मनसे भी पर बुद्धि है औऱ जो बुद्धिसे भी पर है वह (काम) है। इस तरह बुद्धिसे पर - (काम-) को जानकर अपने द्वारा अपने-आपको वशमें करके हे महाबाहो ! तू इस कामरूप दुर्जय शत्रुको मार डाल।"},{"id":163,"chapter":4,"verse":1,"label":"4.1","sanskrit":"श्री भगवानुवाच\nइमं विवस्वते योगं प्रोक्तवानहमव्ययम्।\nविवस्वान् मनवे प्राह मनुरिक्ष्वाकवेऽब्रवीत्।।4.1।।","transliteration":"śhrī bhagavān uvācha\nimaṁ vivasvate yogaṁ proktavān aham avyayam\nvivasvān manave prāha manur ikṣhvākave ’bravīt","english":"The Blessed Lord said, \"I taught this imperishable Yoga to Vivasvan; he then told it to Manu; Manu proclaimed it to Ikshvaku.","hindi":"।।4.1।। श्रीभगवान् बोले - मैंने इस अविनाशी योगको सूर्यसे कहा था। फिर सूर्यने (अपने पुत्र) वैवस्वत मनुसे कहा और मनुने (अपने पुत्र) राजा इक्ष्वाकुसे कहा।"},{"id":164,"chapter":4,"verse":2,"label":"4.2","sanskrit":"एवं परम्पराप्राप्तमिमं राजर्षयो विदुः।\nस कालेनेह महता योगो नष्टः परन्तप।।4.2।।","transliteration":"evaṁ paramparā-prāptam imaṁ rājarṣhayo viduḥ\nsa kāleneha mahatā yogo naṣhṭaḥ parantapa","english":"This, handed down in regular succession by the royal sages, was known. This Yoga, however, has been lost here over time, O Parantapa (burner of the foes).","hindi":"।।4.2।। हे परंतप ! इस तरह परम्परासे प्राप्त इस कर्मयोग को राजर्षियोंने जाना। परन्तु बहुत समय बीत जानेके कारण वह योग इस मनुष्यलोकमें लुप्तप्राय हो गया।"},{"id":165,"chapter":4,"verse":3,"label":"4.3","sanskrit":"स एवायं मया तेऽद्य योगः प्रोक्तः पुरातनः।\nभक्तोऽसि मे सखा चेति रहस्यं ह्येतदुत्तमम्।।4.3।।","transliteration":"sa evāyaṁ mayā te ’dya yogaḥ proktaḥ purātanaḥ\nbhakto ’si me sakhā cheti rahasyaṁ hyetad uttamam","english":"That same ancient yoga has been today taught to you by me, for you are my devotee and my friend; it is the supreme secret.","hindi":"।।4.3।। तू मेरा भक्त और प्रिय सखा है, इसलिये वही यह पुरातन योग आज मैंने तुझसे कहा है; क्योंकि यह बड़ा उत्तम रहस्य है।"},{"id":166,"chapter":4,"verse":4,"label":"4.4","sanskrit":"अर्जुन उवाच\nअपरं भवतो जन्म परं जन्म विवस्वतः।\nकथमेतद्विजानीयां त्वमादौ प्रोक्तवानिति।।4.4।।","transliteration":"arjuna uvācha\naparaṁ bhavato janma paraṁ janma vivasvataḥ\nkatham etad vijānīyāṁ tvam ādau proktavān iti","english":"Arjuna said, \"Later was Thy birth, and prior to it was the birth of Vivasvan (the Sun); how am I to understand that Thou hast taught this Yoga from the beginning?\"","hindi":"।।4.4।। अर्जुन बोले - आपका जन्म तो अभीका है और सूर्यका जन्म बहुत पुराना है; अतः आपने ही सृष्टिके आदिमें सूर्यसे यह योग कहा था - यह बात मैं कैसे समझूँ?"},{"id":167,"chapter":4,"verse":5,"label":"4.5","sanskrit":"श्री भगवानुवाच\nबहूनि मे व्यतीतानि जन्मानि तव चार्जुन।\nतान्यहं वेद सर्वाणि न त्वं वेत्थ परन्तप।।4.5।।","transliteration":"śhrī bhagavān uvācha\nbahūni me vyatītāni janmāni tava chārjuna\ntānyahaṁ veda sarvāṇi na tvaṁ vettha parantapa","english":"The Blessed Lord said, \"Many births of Mine have passed, as well as of thine, O Arjuna; I know them all, but thou knowest not, O Parantapa (scorcher of foes).\"","hindi":"।।4.5।। श्रीभगवान् बोले -- हे परन्तप अर्जुन ! मेरे और तेरे बहुत-से जन्म हो चुके हैं। उन सबको मैं जानता हूँ, पर तू नहीं जानता।"},{"id":168,"chapter":4,"verse":6,"label":"4.6","sanskrit":"अजोऽपि सन्नव्ययात्मा भूतानामीश्वरोऽपि सन्।\nप्रकृतिं स्वामधिष्ठाय संभवाम्यात्ममायया।।4.6।।","transliteration":"ajo ’pi sannavyayātmā bhūtānām īśhvaro ’pi san\nprakṛitiṁ svām adhiṣhṭhāya sambhavāmyātma-māyayā","english":"Though I am unborn and of imperishable nature, and though I am the Lord of all beings, yet, governing my own nature, I am born by my own Maya.","hindi":"।।4.6।। मैं अजन्मा और अविनाशी-स्वरूप होते हुए भी तथा सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंका ईश्वर होते हुए भी अपनी प्रकृतिको अधीन करके अपनी योगमायासे प्रकट होता हूँ।"},{"id":169,"chapter":4,"verse":7,"label":"4.7","sanskrit":"यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत।\nअभ्युत्थानमधर्मस्य तदाऽऽत्मानं सृजाम्यहम्।।4.7।।","transliteration":"yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānir bhavati bhārata\nabhyutthānam adharmasya tadātmānaṁ sṛijāmyaham","english":"Whenever there is a decline of righteousness and an increase of unrighteousness, O Arjuna, then I manifest Myself.","hindi":"।।4.7।। हे भरतवंशी अर्जुन! 2. MVP: full-screen vertical verse feed starting with the Bhagavad Gita (Sanskrit with transliteration, Hindi and English), using only public-domain or openly licensed translations, with the source and licence of every text recorded in the repo. +This is an Expo/React Native mobile application. Prioritize mobile-first patterns, performance, and cross-platform compatibility.
+
+## Expo has changed — do not trust your training data
+
+Expo ships breaking changes every SDK release. APIs you remember are likely renamed, moved, or removed. Before writing any code that touches an Expo, EAS, or React Native API:
+
+1. Read the major version of the `expo` package in `package.json`.
+2. Fetch the matching versioned docs: `https://docs.expo.dev/versions/v<major>.0.0/`
+3. For anything else, fetch https://docs.expo.dev/llms.txt — an index of all Expo docs with corrections to common LLM misconceptions. Follow its links to the specific page you need; never answer from memory.
+
+## Commands
+
+Use `bunx` instead of `npx` if the project uses bun (`bun.lock` present).
+
+```bash
+npx expo install <package>  # ALWAYS use instead of npm/yarn/pnpm/bun add — resolves SDK-compatible versions
+npx expo start              # start the dev server
+npx expo lint               # lint
+npx tsc --noEmit            # typecheck
+npx expo-doctor             # diagnose dependency and config issues
+npx expo install --fix      # fix incompatible package versions
+```
+
+Run lint and typecheck before declaring any task done.
+
+## Navigation & Routing
+
+- Use **Expo Router** for all navigation. Routes live in `src/app/` — every file there is a screen, `_layout.tsx` files define navigators. Keep non-route code (components, hooks, utils) outside `src/app/`.
+- Import `Link`, `router`, and `useLocalSearchParams` from `expo-router`.
+- Docs: https://docs.expo.dev/router/introduction.md
+
+## Building with EAS
+
+Use EAS to build, sign, and submit the app in the cloud (`eas build`, `eas submit`) and to ship over-the-air updates (`eas update`) — no local Xcode or Android Studio required. Run EAS CLI as `bunx eas-cli <command>` in Bun projects, or `npx eas-cli@latest <command>` otherwise; substitute that for bare `eas` in docs examples.
+Docs: https://docs.expo.dev/eas/index.md
+
+## Rules
+
+- If `ios/` and `android/` directories do not exist, they are generated (Continuous Native Generation). Never create or edit them by hand — configure native behavior in `app.json` and config plugins.
+- Expo Go only includes its bundled native modules. After adding a library with native code, the app needs a development build: `npx expo run:ios|android` locally, or `eas build --profile development`.
+- Prefer recommended Expo modules over third-party libraries, and check your available skills before adding dependencies. Docs: https://docs.expo.dev/versions/latest/index.md

+import { VerseFeed } from '@/components/verse/verse-feed';
+import { getVerseOfDayIndex } from '@/lib/verse-of-day';
+import { usePreferences } from '@/context/preferences-context';
+import { scheduleVerseOfDayNotification } from '@/lib/notifications';
+import { useEffect } from 'react';
+import { AppState } from 'react-native';
+import { ActivityIndicator, View } from 'react-native';
+
+export default function FeedScreen() {
+  const { ready, uiLocale } = usePreferences();
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (!ready) return;
+    void scheduleVerseOfDayNotification(7, 0, uiLocale);
+    const sub = AppState.addEventListener('change', (state) => {
+      if (state === 'active') {
+        void scheduleVerseOfDayNotification(7, 0, uiLocale);
+      }
+    });
+    return () => sub.remove();
+  }, [ready, uiLocale]);
+
+  if (!ready) {
+    return (
+      <View style={{ flex: 1, justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center' }}>
+        <ActivityIndicator />
+      </View>
+    );
+  }
+
+  return <VerseFeed initialIndex={getVerseOfDayIndex()} />;
+}

+// This file is web-only and used to configure the root HTML for every
+// web page during static rendering.

+// do not have access to the DOM or browser APIs.
+export default function Root({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
+  return (
+    <html lang="en">
+      <head>
+        <meta charSet="utf-8" />
+        <meta httpEquiv="X-UA-Compatible" content="IE=edge" />
+        <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, shrink-to-fit=no" />

+        {/*
+          Disable body scrolling on web. This makes ScrollView components work closer to how they do on native.
+          However, body scrolling is often nice to have for mobile web. If you want to enable it, remove this line.
+        */}
+        <ScrollViewStyleReset />
+
+        {/* Using raw CSS styles as an escape-hatch to ensure the background color never flickers in dark-mode. */}
+        <style dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: responsiveBackground }} />
+        {/* Add any additional <head> elements that you want globally available on web... */}
+      </head>
+      <body>{children}</body>
+    </html>
+  );
+}

+const responsiveBackground = `

+  background-color: #fff;
+}

+}`;

+import { useFonts } from 'expo-font';
+import { DarkTheme, DefaultTheme, Stack, ThemeProvider } from 'expo-router';
+import * as SplashScreen from 'expo-splash-screen';
+import { useEffect } from 'react';
+import 'react-native-reanimated';
+
+import { useColorScheme } from '@/components/useColorScheme';
+import { PreferencesProvider } from '@/context/preferences-context';
+import { VerseActionsProvider } from '@/context/verse-actions-context';
+
+export {
+  // Catch any errors thrown by the Layout component.
+  ErrorBoundary,
+} from 'expo-router';
+
+export const unstable_settings = {
+  // Ensure that reloading on `/modal` keeps a back button present.
+  anchor: '(tabs)',
+};
+
+// Prevent the splash screen from auto-hiding before asset loading is complete.
+SplashScreen.preventAutoHideAsync();
+
+export default function RootLayout() {
+  const [loaded, error] = useFonts({
+    SpaceMono: require('../assets/fonts/SpaceMono-Regular.ttf'),
+  });
+
+  // Expo Router uses Error Boundaries to catch errors in the navigation tree.
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (error) throw error;
+  }, [error]);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (loaded) {
+      SplashScreen.hideAsync();
+    }
+  }, [loaded]);
+
+  if (!loaded) {
+    return null;
+  }
+
+  return <RootLayoutNav />;
+}
+
+function RootLayoutNav() {
+  const colorScheme = useColorScheme();
+
+  return (
+    <PreferencesProvider>
+      <VerseActionsProvider>
+        <ThemeProvider value={colorScheme === 'dark' ? DarkTheme : DefaultTheme}>
+          <Stack>
+            <Stack.Screen name="(tabs)" options={{ headerShown: false }} />
+            <Stack.Screen name="design-lab" options={{ title: 'Design lab' }} />
+            <Stack.Screen name="privacy" options={{ title: 'Privacy' }} />
+            <Stack.Screen name="modal" options={{ presentation: 'modal' }} />
+          </Stack>
+        </ThemeProvider>
+      </VerseActionsProvider>
+    </PreferencesProvider>
+  );
+}

where: runtime/tla/plaid-sync-cursor/PlaidSyncCursorFixed.tla:16-49

bundles.title: Design Accounting Automation Metrics pipeline and dashboard

Design the end-to-end pipeline and Omni dashboard for the Notion page Accounting Automation Metrics: https://app.notion.com/p/useascend/Accounting-Automation-Metrics-3f72941eedcb81508120e72afcfcfd4b

Steps:
1. Read the Notion page in full: every metric, its definition, its SQL (toggles included), filters, grain and any charts. List each metric with its exact definition.
2. Inventory what exists in Omni (slash-eureka/omni repo and the Omni instance): topics, views and dashboards that already cover any of these metrics (for example the Payables v2 topics from OMN-1 / omni PR #9 and the Cash App Metrics topic from OMN-2).
3. Inventory the dbt repo (slash-eureka/dbt, BigQuery ascend-production-wh): marts and aggregates that can be reused as is, reused with small changes, or are missing (for example payables aggregates, extraction_metrics_daily, automation_events, posting_attempts_daily, cash_app_payer_matching_metrics_daily).
4. For each metric: source tables, the dbt model that should own it (existing or new), its grain, the Omni topic and measure, and the dashboard tile.
5. Design the pipeline end to end (sources, staging, intermediate, marts, Omni topics, dashboard layout) and the build order as a short list of follow-up tasks (dbt PRs, then Omni PRs), each with how to check it.

Proof: for at least the key metrics, run the Notion SQL and the proposed dbt or Omni query read-only in BigQuery on the same date range and show the numbers side by side, so the design is proven to tie out where existing models are reused.

+# Reference this view as dbt_prod_base__accounting_automation_month_spine
+schema: dbt_prod_base
+sql: |-
+  WITH
+
+  months AS (
+      SELECT
+          accounting_month
+      FROM
+          UNNEST(GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY(DATE_SUB(DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), MONTH), INTERVAL 23 MONTH), DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), MONTH), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) AS accounting_month
+  ),
+
+  org_domain AS (
+      SELECT DISTINCT
+          organization_id
+      FROM
+          `ascend-production-wh.dbt_prod_cash_app_aggregates.cash_app_automation_metrics_monthly`
+      WHERE
+          1=1
+          AND organization_id IS NOT NULL
+
+      UNION DISTINCT
+
+      SELECT DISTINCT
+          organization_id
+      FROM
+          `ascend-production-wh.dbt_prod_dba.dba_automation_metrics_monthly`
+      WHERE
+          1=1
+          AND organization_id IS NOT NULL
+
+      UNION DISTINCT
+
+      SELECT DISTINCT
+          organization_id
+      FROM
+          `ascend-production-wh.dbt_prod_payables_aggregates.payables_automation_metrics_monthly`
+      WHERE
+          1=1
+          AND organization_id IS NOT NULL
+
+      UNION DISTINCT
+
+      SELECT DISTINCT
+          organization_id
+      FROM
+          `ascend-production-wh.dbt_prod_base.accounting_automation_utility_monthly`
+      WHERE
+          1=1
+          AND organization_id IS NOT NULL
+  )
+
+  SELECT
+      o.organization_id,
+      m.accounting_month,
+      m.accounting_month = DATE_TRUNC(CURRENT_DATE(), MONTH) AS is_current_month,
+      m.accounting_month = DATE_TRUNC(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), MONTH) AS is_latest_ended_month,
+      m.accounting_month IN (DATE_TRUNC(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), MONTH), DATE_TRUNC(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 2 MONTH), MONTH)) AS is_last_two_ended_months
+  FROM
+      months m
+      CROSS JOIN org_domain o
+
+dimensions:
+  accounting_month:
+    description: First day of the accounting month. Spine covers the 24 months ending at the current month.
+
+  organization_id:
+    format: ID
+    hidden: true
+
+  is_current_month:
+    description: True for the current, still open accounting month
+
+  is_latest_ended_month:
+    description: True for the most recent fully ended accounting month
+
+  is_last_two_ended_months:
+    description: True for the two most recent fully ended accounting months. Used by headline tiles to compare the latest ended month with the month before it.
+
+custom_compound_primary_key_sql: [ organization_id, accounting_month ]

+def ensure_branch(c: httpx.Client) -> str:

+    record = r.json()["records"][0]
+    for branch in record.get("branches") or []:
+        if branch.get("name") == BRANCH_NAME:
+            return branch["id"]
+    r = call(
+        c,
+        "POST",
+        "/api/unstable/models",
+        json={
+            "connectionId": record["connectionId"],
+            "modelKind": "BRANCH",
+            "baseModelId": MODEL_ID,
+            "modelName": BRANCH_NAME,
+        },
+    )
+    r.raise_for_status()
+    return (r.json().get("model") or r.json())["id"]

+def get_yaml(c: httpx.Client, file_name: str, branch_id: str) -> tuple[str, str] | None:
+    r = call(
+        c,
+        "GET",
+        f"/api/v1/models/{MODEL_ID}/yaml",
+        params={"fileName": file_name, "mode": "combined", "includeChecksums": "true", "branchId": branch_id},
+    )
+    r.raise_for_status()
+    data = r.json()
+    files = data.get("files") or {}
+    if file_name not in files:
+        return None
+    return files[file_name], (data.get("checksums") or {}).get(file_name, "")
+

+def put_yaml(c: httpx.Client, branch_id: str, file_name: str, content: str, checksum: str | None) -> dict:
+    body = {
+        "fileName": file_name,
+        "yaml": content,
+        "mode": "combined",
+        "branchId": branch_id,
+        "commitMessage": f"OMN-8: {file_name}",
+    }
+    if checksum:
+        body["previousChecksum"] = checksum
+    r = call(c, "POST", f"/api/v1/models/{MODEL_ID}/yaml", json=body)
+    if r.status_code >= 400:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"put {file_name}: {r.status_code} {r.text[:1500]}")
+    return r.json()

+def push_model(c: httpx.Client) -> None:

+    results = {}
+    for local, remote in MODEL_FILES:
+        content = (MODEL_DIR / local).read_text()
+        current = get_yaml(c, remote, branch_id)
+        if current and squash(current[0]) == squash(content):
+            results[remote] = {"skipped": "branch already matches worktree"}
+            continue
+        results[remote] = put_yaml(c, branch_id, remote, content, current[1] if current else None)
+    results["_refresh_schema"] = refresh_schema(c, branch_id)
+
+    equality = {"branch_name": BRANCH_NAME, "branch_id": branch_id, "files": {}}
+    for local, remote in MODEL_FILES:
+        remote_text, _ = get_yaml(c, remote, branch_id)
+        path = MODEL_DIR / local
+        equal = squash(remote_text) == squash(path.read_text())
+        if not equal:
+            path.write_text(remote_text)
+        equality["files"][remote] = {"equal": equal, "worktree_rewritten_with_omni_version": not equal}
+    equality["all_equal_after_sync"] = all(
+        squash(get_yaml(c, remote, branch_id)[0]) == squash((MODEL_DIR / local).read_text())
+        for local, remote in MODEL_FILES
+    )
+    save("model-yaml-put-results.json", results)
+    save("branch-yaml-equality.json", equality)

+def bq_run(sql: str, job_id: str) -> dict:
+    proc = subprocess.run(
+        [
+            "bq",
+            "query",
+            "--project_id=ascend-production-wh",
+            "--use_legacy_sql=false",
+            "--format=json",
+            "--max_rows=1000",
+            f"--job_id={job_id}",
+            sql,
+        ],
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+        check=False,
+    )
+    if proc.returncode != 0:
+        return {"error": (proc.stderr or proc.stdout).strip(), "job_id": job_id}
+    return {"rows": json.loads(proc.stdout or "[]"), "job_id": job_id}

+def mart_sums_sql(alias: str) -> str:
+    mart = MARTS[alias]
+    sums = ",\n".join(f"    SUM({col}) AS {name}" for name, (_, col) in mart["sums"].items())
+    return f"""SELECT
+    accounting_month,
+{sums}
+FROM
+    {BQ_PREFIX}{mart["table"]}`
+WHERE
+    1=1
+    AND accounting_month IN (DATE_TRUNC(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), MONTH), DATE_TRUNC(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 2 MONTH), MONTH))
+GROUP BY
+    accounting_month
+ORDER BY
+    accounting_month"""
